raw.description:
Bounteous is a global AI Services firm where agentic engineering and human experience converge to deliver transformative business outcomes for the enterprise. We help organizations design, build, and scale AI-driven products, platforms, and processes. With more than 5,000 team members worldwide, Bounteous delivers AI that sticks, powering adoption and outcomes that move organizations from experimentation to true transformation. Bounteous is backed by New Mountain Capital, a New York-based growth-oriented investment firm that emphasizes business building.

CyberArk Architect

3+ months rolling contract

Newbury, UK

 

About the role

We are seeking a CyberArk Architect to lead solution design for a large-scale, TSA-regulated Privileged Access Management (PAM) migration and merger consolidation programme. This is a hands-on architecture role spanning vault migration design, identity federation, and application onboarding strategy for an estate spanning thousands of accounts and 250+ dependent applications, delivered against a fixed regulatory deadline.

 

Key responsibilities

Migration & vault architecture

  • Design the end-to-end migration architecture from CyberArk v12.2 to v14.2, covering entity extraction (REST API primary, PACLI fallback), transformation, reconciliation, and staged loading into the target vault.
  • Define the staged-ingestion model: disabled import → CPM soft-verification → dual-run mirroring → forced rotation at cutover — ensuring no credential is exposed to a script or human during migration.
  • Own name-collision resolution, platform normalisation, and policy reconciliation rules between source and target environments.
  • Produce migration runbooks, RAID logs, and effort-sizing models across Safes, Accounts, Platforms, and Policies.

 

Application & credential provider (CP/CCP) strategy

  • Lead discovery to segment the 250+ dependent applications by integration pattern (CP agent, CCP centralised, Conjur, direct SSO) — the primary driver of onboarding sequencing and timeline risk.
  • Design the CP/CCP re-onboarding approach, including AppID re-provisioning, certificate/mTLS re-issuance, and phased cutover waves.
  • Define rollback and dual-run strategy per wave, including the read-only fallback window on the source vault.

 

Identity federation & MFA

  • Design PVWA federation to Entra ID via SAML/OIDC, including claims mapping from Entra groups to CyberArk Vault Users and Safe membership.
  • Architect the RSA SecurID → Entra MFA migration as a re-enrolment exercise, covering Conditional Access policy design and non-web/legacy client bridging (PrivateArk, PACLI, RADIUS-dependent flows).
  • Ensure High Side / Low Side segregation is preserved across all federation and migration data flows, with no entitlement detail crossing the DMZ boundary.

Governance, compliance & stakeholder leadership

  • Own architecture decisions and trade-offs; present designs to client security, compliance, and PAM leadership for sign-off.
  • Ensure all migration and access-control designs produce audit evidence sufficient for TSA compliance reporting.
  • Evaluate and position complementary tooling (e.g. Hydden for continuous identity discovery) against native CyberArk capability.
  • Define acceptance criteria and go/no-go gates for pilot and production wave sign-off.
  • Mentor and provide technical direction to CyberArk Senior Engineers delivering the build.

 

Required experience & skills

  • 10+ years in Identity and Access Management, with 5+ years specifically in CyberArk PAM architecture and design.
  • Deep hands-on knowledge of CyberArk EPV, PVWA, CPM, PSM, AAM/CCP, and Vault architecture across on-prem and Privilege Cloud deployments.
  • Proven experience leading a CyberArk version migration (v10/v11/v12 → v13/v14) at enterprise scale.
  • Strong working knowledge of SAML 2.0 and OIDC federation design, including experience integrating CyberArk PVWA with an enterprise IdP (Entra ID, Okta, or equivalent).
  • Experience with credential provider architectures (CP, CCP) and application onboarding at scale (100+ application estates).
  • Familiarity with MFA migration projects (e.g. RSA SecurID to a cloud MFA/Conditional Access model).
  • Experience operating in regulated environments (financial services, telecom, or government) with formal change control and audit evidence requirements.
  • Strong client-facing communication skills; able to present architecture to both technical and executive stakeholders.

Information Security Responsibilities
  • Promote and enforce awareness of key information security practices, including acceptable use of information assets, malware protection, and password security protocols
  • Identify, assess, and report security risks, focusing on how these risks impact the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of information assets
  • Understand and evaluate how data is stored, processed, or transmitted, ensuring compliance with data privacy and protection standards (GDPR, CCPA, etc.)
  • Ensure data protection measures are integrated throughout the information lifecycle to safeguard sensitive information

raw.description:
OUR MISSION

To become the car-changing destination of choice. By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we've turned how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars on its head.

What started as a simple reviews site is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service.

In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia - creators of AutoExpress and Evo magazines - doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with almost 10m subscribers and over 1.1 billion annual views, while we sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million.

And we’re a long way from done!

THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Senior Analytics Engineer / BI Analyst to bridge the gap between data engineering and business insight. You’ll take ownership of transforming raw data into trusted, well modelled datasets and deliver impactful reporting that drives decision making across the business. This role combines strong technical data modelling skills with stakeholder-facing analytics and BI development.

 

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable data models using dbt on Google Cloud Platform (BigQuery)

  • Create and maintain dashboards and explores in Looker, enabling self-serve analytics

  • Translate business requirements into clear data models, metrics, and visualisations

  • Define and maintain core business metrics and data definitions in partnership with stakeholders and the wider analytics team

  • Implement data quality checks, testing, and documentation within dbt

  • Partner with stakeholders across all parts of the business including commercial, product, marketing, finance, and operations

  • Optimise query performance and manage cost efficiency in BigQuery

  • Mentor junior analysts and promote best practices in analytics engineering across the wider analytics team

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

  • Previous experience in analytics engineering, BI or data analytics roles

  • Strong SQL skills (expert level, performance tuning experience preferred)

  • Experience working with modern cloud data platforms and distributed data warehouses (e.g. BigQuery, Snowflake)

  • Proven experience with dbt (modelling, testing, documentation)

  • Experience building dashboards in Looker (LookML is a strong plus)

  • Solid understanding of data modelling concepts (star schema, dimensional modelling)

  • Experience working with large-scale datasets

  • Strong communication skills with the ability to work with non-technical stakeholders

NICE TO HAVE

  • Hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform, especially BigQuery

  • Experience with orchestration tools (e.g. Airflow)

  • Knowledge of data governance and data quality frameworks

  • Exposure to reverse ETL tools (e.g. Hightouch)

  • Familiarity with AI coding assistants and a habit of integrating them into day-to-day analytics workflows

SUCCESS IN THIS ROLE LOOKS LIKE

  • Clean, well-documented, and trusted data models used across the company

  • High adoption of Looker dashboards and self-serve analytics

  • Reduced time-to-insight for stakeholders with the use of AI tooling to accelerate delivery

  • Clear, consistent definitions of key business metrics

  • Improved data reliability and fewer reporting discrepancies

    WHAT YOU'LL OWN

  • The transformation layer (dbt) and semantic layer (Looker)

  • Core business metrics and reporting definitions

  • Data quality and testing frameworks

  • BI best practices and documentation standards

    WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU

  • Hybrid working

  • Competitive salary to fund that dream holiday to Bali

  • Matched pension contributions for a peaceful retirement

  • Share options - when we thrive, so do you!

  • Vitality Private Healthcare, for peace of mind, plus eyecare vouchers

  • Life Assurance for (even more) peace of mind

  • Monthly coaching sessions with Spill - our mental wellbeing partner

  • Enhanced holiday package, plus Bank Holidays

    • 28 days annual leave

    • For your third year anniversary, get 30 days of annual leave per year

    • For your tenth year anniversary, get 35 days of annual leave per year

    • Option to buy 3 extra days of holiday per year

  • Work from abroad for a month

  • Bubble childcare support and discounted nanny fees for little ones

  • The latest tech (Macbook or Surface) to power your gif-sending talents

  • Regular social events: tech lunches, coffee with the exec sessions, lunch 8 learns, book clubs, social events/anything else you pester us for

raw.title: Financial Risk Advisory - Director
raw.description:
Position Overview:
 
Risk Advisory Directors are critically important project leaders who help our clients navigate the complexities of SOX, deliver internal controls focused projects, and coach and develop our people. Our clients represent a broad range of public or soon-to-be public companies, from new IPOs, mid and large cap companies, and Fortune 1000s.
 
Principal Duties and Responsibilities:
 
Project Delivery:
 
·       Leads multiple concurrent SOX projects in various maturity stages (new implementation, recurring projects, and limited/defined scope projects).
·       Executes projects with minimal supervision by more senior individuals.
·       Sets realistic deadlines with the client and internally with the team.
·       Seen as the principle point of contact by the client and CFGI leadership for each project.
 
Engagement Management:
 
·       Schedules and manages teams/individuals of various staff level(s) based upon project need and scope.
·       Effectively manages the workload of the various teams/individuals, while making progress towards project milestones to deliver work on-time and on-budget.
·       Actively manages project budgets and evaluates whether there have been changes to budgetary assumptions; obtains client approval to perform any additional services in advance of incurring time.
·       Ensures the team member timecards are submitted timely and accurately; responsible for the review of budget-to-actuals and review of invoices.
·       Communicates project status frequently (via email, phone, virtually, and/or in person) to the client and to the project’s Partner.
 
Technical Acumen:
 
·       Fluency in implementing SOX for newly public companies, including the design of age/stage appropriate controls, providing practical guidance and controls implementation and the management of/remediation of gaps and deficiencies.
·       Expert proficiency in drafting and reviewing control design language, flowcharts, narratives, IPE, and determining system(s) and application(s) scoping.
·       Advanced understanding of Big 4 sampling, testing, and deficiency evaluation methodologies.
·       In-depth experience in the review of SOC-1 Type II reports and relevant CUEC mapping, including sub-service organizations.
·       Working proficiency and understanding of IT General Controls, SEC guidance as it pertains to the SOX requirements for different filer types, PCAOB, and AICPA audit standards.
 
People Development:
 
·       Leads by example.
·       Provides constructive, in-the-moment feedback and formal written feedback.
·       Identifies development opportunities for individuals and strategically schedules people in those roles.
·       Responsible for the morale of their teams.
 
Education and Experience Requirements:
 
·       10+ years of direct, client service/ client facing experience in commercial audit, risk advisory, or technical accounting, with at a minimum 6 years at a Big Four or a large national firm.
·       Undergraduate degree in accounting or similar field from an accredited university.
·       CPA and/or MBA combined with solid accounting experience are preferred but not required.
·       Strong project management skills with the ability to multi-task between responsibilities, prioritize and manage multiple requests.
·       Excellent interpersonal, written, and oral communication skills, and ability to assimilate easily into teams.
·       Strong analytical and critical thinking abilities.
·       Excellent communication and presentation skills, both verbal and written.
·       Exceptional virtual and in-person executive presence.
·       Entrepreneurial nature, self-motivated, ethical, and dependable.
·       As a professional, you must understand the unique pressures of client service and the occasional challenges of unpredictable working hours to meet project deadlines and/or client requests for travel, as necessary.

raw.title: Recruiter, Sales and GTM EMEA/APAC- (Fixed Term Contract) - 6 months
raw.description:
Recruiter, Sales and GTM - (Fixed Term Contract)

The Talent Acquisition team at Chainalysis is responsible for scaling the most important ingredient to our success – people. Our mission is to build and execute a talent acquisition strategy that is inclusive, rigorous, and repeatable around the world.

We’re looking for a Recruiter (Fixed Term Contract) to support hiring across our EMEA and APAC go-to-market teams during an exciting period of growth. In this role, you’ll partner directly with business leaders across enterprise and public sector teams to attract and hire exceptional talent who are helping build trust in the blockchain ecosystem.

This is an opportunity to join a mission-driven company operating at the intersection of cryptocurrency, technology, and financial crime investigations, while working closely with a collaborative global Talent Acquisition team.

Contract Details

  • Fixed term contract (6 mths)

  • Hybrid working – 1 day per week in our London office

  • Immediate impact supporting high-priority GTM hiring across EMEA & APAC

In this role, you’ll:

  • Own full-cycle recruiting for go-to-market roles across EMEA, including enterprise sales, account management, and customer-facing roles

  • Build and execute proactive sourcing strategies to engage top talent across SaaS, fintech, and emerging crypto markets

  • Partner closely with hiring managers and senior leaders to define hiring strategies and identify the right profiles for their teams

  • Manage candidates through the full interview process, delivering a high-touch, transparent candidate experience

  • Provide market insight and hiring guidance to stakeholders, acting as a trusted recruiting partner

  • Maintain strong pipelines of diverse talent across multiple geographies

  • Collaborate with the global Talent Acquisition team to share best practices and improve recruiting processes

We’re looking for candidates who have:

  • A track record of successfully recruiting sales and go-to-market talent, particularly quota-carrying roles

  • Experience recruiting within SaaS, fintech, cybersecurity, or other high-growth technology environments

  • A strong interest in cryptocurrency, blockchain, or the digital assets ecosystem

  • Experience working closely with senior stakeholders in fast-paced environments

  • Excellent sourcing and talent mapping skills, with the ability to generate strong pipelines independently

  • A structured and organised approach to managing multiple searches simultaneously

  • A collaborative mindset and a strong sense of ownership over hiring outcomes

Nice to have experience:

  • Experience recruiting across EMEA markets

  • Previous exposure to crypto, blockchain, or Web3 companies

  • Experience hiring for professional services or customer-facing technical roles

  • Experience working in high-growth or pre-IPO environments

  • Familiarity with Ashby ATS and sourcing tools

AI at Chainalysis
AI is not a feature at Chainalysis - it is a new way of working. One that turns instructions into work done, and helps us move faster than the threats we're built to counter, and we expect our employees to take ownership of the output and ensure quality. As the world's most trusted blockchain analytics platform, Chainalysis sits at a rare intersection of proprietary data, regulatory relationships and crypto expertise that makes it uniquely placed to shape and lead the next era of AI-driven intelligence - and we expect everyone here, regardless of role, to be an active part of it.

AI fluency is tied directly to how we measure performance and how we plan to win. There is no substitute for your own curiosity. We provide the tools, workflows, and space to experiment - but the expectation is that you develop these capabilities yourself, bring ideas, and collaborate across teams to reinvent the way work gets done. We are not using AI to do less. We are using it to do what was never possible before.

About Chainalysis

Chainalysis is the blockchain data platform, making it easy to connect the movement of digital assets to real-world services. Powered by deep blockchain data and AI, organizations can investigate illicit activity, manage risk exposure, and develop innovative market solutions built on the industry's most trusted blockchain intelligence. Our mission is to build trust in blockchains, blending safety and security with an unwavering commitment to growth and innovation.

You belong here. 

At Chainalysis, we believe that diversity of experience and thought makes us stronger. With both customers and employees around the world, we are committed to ensuring our team reflects the unique communities around us. We’re ensuring we keep learning by committing to continually revisit and reevaluate our diversity culture.

We encourage applicants across any race, ethnicity, gender/gender expression, age, spirituality, ability, experience and more. If you need any accommodations to make our interview process more accessible to you due to a disability, don't hesitate to let us know. You can learn more here. We can’t wait to meet you.

This is a full-cycle closing role: you'll run discovery, demo and negotiation yourself, with support from the CRO on the harder deals while you build that muscle.

You'll carry mid-market opportunities to start, working alongside SDR-sourced pipeline as well as your own prospecting, with a clear path to Senior Account Executive as your quota, deal complexity and independence grow.

What you'll do

  • Run full-cycle new-logo opportunities from qualified meeting through discovery, demo and close, sourced by SDR, Marketing and your own prospecting.

  • Generate some of your own pipeline alongside SDR support, prospecting into a clearly defined ideal customer profile.

  • Run structured discovery calls solo, identifying pain and priorities for your primary buyer.

  • Close mid-market deals with negotiation support from the CRO as you build experience with more complex procurement.

  • Maintain your own weekly pipeline and forecast, developing commit accuracy over time.

  • Work SDR and Customer Success handoffs as directed, keeping CRM records clean and up to date.


What you'll bring

  • 3–5 years' full-cycle closing experience in B2B SaaS, or a strong track record in an adjacent commercial role (for example SDR) ready to step up.

  • A track record at or near 100% of quota (around £500k–£750k) in at least one of the last two years.

  • Real consultative selling instinct: you'd rather understand a prospect's problem than run a script at them.

  • Drawn to a business where new challenges show up daily; you want to take ownership of them and lean in, rather than needing everything mapped out in advance.

  • Comfortable taking yourself out of your comfort zone when a deal or a buyer is unfamiliar territory.

What you'll get

  • Time off that works for you: Unlimited holiday policy, including a guaranteed 33 days plus your birthday off

  • Healthcare that goes further: After one year’s service, access private healthcare through Vitality, including dental, optical, hearing and therapy cover.

  • Support for growing families: Enhanced maternity and paternity leave.

About Cytix

Software never stops changing. Teams ship new code every day, through tickets, pull requests, releases, and increasingly with AI in the mix, but the way security keeps up with all that change hasn't really moved on.

That's the problem we're solving. Cytix helps organisations understand which software changes actually matter, what should happen next, and how to prove the right call was made. Security understood, in other words.

We're a small team with big plans, so every person we hire genuinely shapes what Cytix becomes. That's why we're upfront about our five values: we interview for all of them, and they matter to us more than a perfect CV. They're things you do, not things you are, so have a read and see if they sound like you.

Make the first move. When the goal is clear but the path isn't, you get moving rather than waiting for perfect instructions. If you're blocked, you make a sensible call, say what you're assuming, and explain how you'd course-correct. We'd rather you act and be slightly wrong than sit still.

Find the smarter path. You ask why before how. You dig into what the real problem is instead of just building what the spec says, and you're happy to question 'that's how it's always been done' when the reason behind it has gone stale.

See it through. When something's yours, it lands. No loose ends, no surprises for whoever picks it up next. You keep people posted when things change, and if something falls between roles, you catch it.

Raise the bar. You do the best job possible in the time you've got, whether that's a day or a month. Sometimes that means deep craft; sometimes the smartest move is quick and scrappy. It's about good judgement, and we hold each other to it without blame or politics.

Play to win. You care about the mission but don't take yourself too seriously. You say 'I' when things go wrong and 'we' when they go right, trust teammates to do things their own way, and bring a bit of humour when the pressure's on.

raw.title: Head of Product Growth
raw.description:
Meet DeepL

DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation.
Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures.

Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.

What sets us apart

What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.

When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.

What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL onLinkedIn,Instagram, and our Blog.

 

Meet the team behind this journey

DeepL runs product-led growth alongside our sales-led motion, with media translation as the strategic wedge. This role is responsible for turning DeepL into the default platform for translation worldwide driving adoption through product usage, and converting that usage into strong Product Qualified Leads (PQLs) tha convert into revenues and strengthen our sales pipeline. This role drives adoption of our core DeepL Translate features (e.g. Customization Hub, TQE) and cross-sell into adjacent products like DeepL Voice. You will start with a focus on Media Translation.

Your Mission: Put DeepL Translate in the hands of everyone, everywhere and use that reach to grow adoption across DeepL's broader product surface, turning usage into a reliable, high-quality source of PQLs for the business.

 

Your responsibilities

  • Use case strategy: prioritize the highest-value use cases for media translation, and and build the growth loops and product surface to drive adoption of them.

  • Distribution on the DeepL platform (main channel): drive media translation adoption directly within web, browser extension, and apps. Work closely with the API/MCP track.

  • PLG/PQL engine: define what qualifies as a strong PQL for media translation (usage signals, account characteristics, intent signals) , build the instrumentation to detect it, and design a clean handoff into sales.

  • Growth plays for feature/product discovery: design and run growth loops that help users discover and adopt more features and products beyond their initial media translation use case, expanding usage depth and breadth.

  • Cross-functional coordination:

    • Close collaboration with the Marketing team on funnel design, messaging, and PQL feedback loop.

    • Coordination with Sales/Sales Ops on PQL definition and handoff.

    • Iterate with Pricing & Packaging team on P&P strategy and optoimization

  • Metrics ownership: define and report on leading indicators (platform usage, feature adoption, cross-sell conversion, open-source adoption), and rigorously attribute product usage and these metrics to business outcomes (pipeline, revenue, retention) not just track activity, but prove and quantify its impact.

 

Qualities we look for

  • A builder, first and foremost someone who can build with AI, prototype fast, test with real users, and scale what works. This is a hands-on role, not a strategy-only one.

  • Track record building or scaling a PLG motion that feeds a sales organization ideally with direct experience owning PQL definition and handoff.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management this role sits at the intersection of Product, Sales, Marketing, and Engineering, and needs to align each of them without owning their roadmaps.

  • Experience growing adoption within a core consumer/prosumer product (web, extension, or app), not just developer-facing surfaces.

  • Experience designing growth loops for feature/product discovery and expansion, not just top-of-funnel acquisition.

  • Experience with open-source community strategy has shipped or grown an OSS project, ideally in ML/AI.

  • Comfortable working in a hybrid PLG + SLG model and operating cross-functionally with teams whose roadmaps this role doesn't own.

 

What we offer

  • Diverse and internationally distributed team: joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network.

  • Open communication, regular feedback: as a language-focused company, we value the importance of clear, honest communication. We value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and growth mindset makes us better together.

  • Hybrid work, flexible hours: we offer a hybrid work schedule, with team members coming into the office twice a week. This allows you to engage directly with your team and experience the unique energy of our workspace, while still enjoying the flexibility and comfort of working from home. With flexible working hours and trust in your productivity, we are in sync with your team’s general locations and time zones to foster effective and seamless collaboration.

  • Virtual Shares - An ownership mindset in every role. We believe everyone should share in our success, and that’s why every employee receives Virtual Shares, linking your contribution directly to DeepL’s growth and rewarding you with a stake in our future.

  • Regular in-person team events: we bond over vibrant events that are as unique as our team, from local team and business unit gatherings, to new-joiner onboardings, to company-wide events that bring us all together–literally.

  • Monthly full-day hacking sessions: every month, we have Hack Fridays, where you can spend your time diving into a project you're passionate about and get the opportunity to work with other teams–we value your initiatives, impact, and creativity.

  • 30 days of annual leave: we value your peace of mind. With 30 days off (excluding public holidays) and access to mental health resources, we make sure you're as strong mentally as you are professionally.

  • Competitive benefits: just as our team spans the globe, so does our benefits package. We've crafted it to reflect the diversity of our team and tailored it to align with your unique location, to ensure you feel supported every step of the way.

 

If this role and our mission resonate with you, but you're hesitant because you don't check all the boxes, don't let that hold you back. At DeepL, it's all about the value you bring and the growth we can foster together. Go ahead, apply—let's discover your potential together. We can't wait to meet you!

#LI-JB1

We are an equal opportunity employer

You are welcome at DeepL for who you are - we appreciate authenticity here. Our product is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all succeed, contribute, and think forward! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our diversity that we will find the power to break down language barriers in the world.

You will lead the Production Inference team — the group responsible for the systems that serve DeepL's language AI models reliably and efficiently at scale. We sit at the intersection of research-grade technical ambition and production-grade operational discipline: our work determines whether DeepL's models reach users with the latency, reliability, and cost profile that makes commercial deployment viable. The team owns the full model serving stack — from GPU-resident inference runtimes and deployment infrastructure through to the developer platform that enables every other research team to bring their models to production. We operate within the Research organisation, with close ties to DeepL's infrastructure and platform functions, and our architectural decisions affect every product DeepL ships. The broader Research organisation publishes regularly at ACL, NeurIPS, and EMNLP, and the Production Inference team brings that same culture of rigour and innovation to the systems layer of AI.

 

Your responsibilities

As Engineering Manager for the Production Inference team, you will own both people leadership and technical direction for a team of research scientists and ML engineers working on performance-critical model serving systems. While this is not a hands-on coding role, you will be deeply involved in technical reviews, architecture decisions, and research direction for the inference stack.

 

You will:

  • Lead and develop a high-performing team of research scientists and ML engineers, building strong development plans, fostering a candid and non-retaliatory feedback culture, and maintaining high standards of technical rigour and delivery.

  • Own the team's research and development roadmap for production inference systems, in close collaboration with senior ICs and cross-functional stakeholders, balancing near-term reliability commitments with longer-horizon research bets on inference efficiency and architecture.

  • Act as the primary technical interface between the Production Inference team and adjacent functions — including foundational models research, voice research, applied research, infrastructure, and product — ensuring research output is well-scoped, well-communicated, and delivered without creating downstream bottlenecks.

  • Drive the reliability, efficiency, and cost performance of DeepL's model serving stack, including strategic decisions around serving infrastructure evolution (load balancing, autoscaling, runtime selection, and hardware utilisation).

  • Operate with a high degree of autonomy, defining the team's direction and pushing for results in an environment where requirements from product or commercial stakeholders can be ambiguous or evolving.

  • Play an active role in identifying, assessing, and recruiting research and engineering talent as the team continues to develop.

 

Qualities we look for

  • You have proven experience leading a team of researchers or ML engineers, with a track record of developing talent, maintaining delivery rigour, and holding the balance between research quality and production reliability.

  • You have a strong background Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, or a comparable quantitative discipline, or possess a strong ML/systems background with equivalent research depth.

  • You have a strong foundation in production ML systems, inference optimisation, or model serving at scale — direct experience with LLM inference, speculative decoding, quantisation, or serving infrastructure is a meaningful differentiator.

  • You are comfortable operating across the full model lifecycle — from training handoff through to production deployment, monitoring, and efficiency improvement — and understand infrastructure and compute constraints without needing to own them directly.

  • You have excellent communication skills and the ability to translate complex technical direction into clear goals for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • You are solution-oriented and decisive, able to define direction and drive outcomes without waiting for direction from above.

Location - London (Hybrid)

Employment Type - 6 months FTC

About the Role:

Delta Capita is seeking an experienced Senior Data Remediation Project Manager to lead a high-profile regulatory and customer remediation programme within the financial services sector. The successful candidate will be responsible for driving complex data remediation initiatives, coordinating multiple delivery workstreams, and ensuring the successful execution of large-scale remediation activities impacting customer data, operational processes, and technology landscapes.

This is a highly visible role requiring exceptional stakeholder management capabilities, strong programme governance experience, and a deep understanding of data, technology, and regulatory remediation environments.


Key Responsibilities:

• Lead the delivery of a large-scale data remediation programme within a regulated financial services environment.

• Consolidate multiple data-related workstream plans into a single integrated delivery roadmap, ensuring clear dependencies, milestones, risks, and governance are maintained.

• Drive execution across business, data, technology, operations, and change teams to ensure delivery objectives are met.

• Engage and influence senior stakeholders, including Executive leadership, Programme Sponsors, Risk, Compliance, Technology, and Operations teams.

• Assess and manage data remediation impacts across systems, data architecture, operating models, controls, and manual processes.

• Provide strong programme governance, tracking delivery progress, risks, issues, and remediation plans.

• Identify opportunities to leverage AI and emerging technologies to improve remediation effectiveness, customer outcomes, and operational efficiency.

• Collaborate with technical teams to understand data lineage, data quality issues, system dependencies, and remediation approaches.

• Ensure remediation activities are aligned with regulatory expectations, governance standards, and customer outcome requirements.

• Support decision-making through robust reporting, stakeholder communications, and programme documentation.

Required Experience:

• Proven experience leading large-scale data remediation or regulatory remediation programmes within financial services.

• Strong project or programme management background with experience delivering complex, multi-workstream initiatives.

• Demonstrated ability to manage senior stakeholders and operate effectively within highly visible and regulated environments.

• Strong understanding of data remediation methodologies, data quality management, and data governance principles.

• Experience working across business, technology, data, and operational teams.

• Good understanding of technology architecture, system landscapes, data flows, and remediation impacts.

• Ability to build and manage integrated delivery plans across multiple parallel workstreams.

• Experience managing programme risks, dependencies, governance forums, and regulatory scrutiny.


Desirable Experience:

• Experience delivering customer remediation programmes within banking, lending, or retail financial services organisations.

• Knowledge of regulatory remediation, customer data management, conduct risk, or operational risk frameworks.

• Experience working on large-scale customer contact and claims remediation programmes, including PPI, complaints remediation, redress, or similar customer outcome initiatives.

• Understanding of AI use cases, automation opportunities, and advanced analytics within remediation and operational environments.

• Exposure to data lineage, data governance, and enterprise data management programmes.

Key Skills:

• Data Remediation

• Regulatory Remediation

• Programme & Project Management

• Senior Stakeholder Management

• Data Governance & Data Quality

• Delivery Planning & Execution

• Risk & Issue Management

• Financial Services Transformation

• AI & Innovation

• Technology & Data Architecture Awareness

• Customer Remediation Programmes

• Change Management

raw.title: Talent Partner (EU/UK Based - Remote)
raw.description:
About the role

Duvo helps large enterprises map, optimise and execute the long-running, messy operational work that runs across their systems: ERPs, portals, email, spreadsheets, calls. We sell into Heads of Operations, Supply Chain, Finance and IT at large retailers and FMCG brands. New deals land at €100k–€250k ARR and grow materially through expansion.

We're about to grow fast across engineering and go-to-market, and into new European markets, without lowering the bar. Agencies alone can't get us there. We're hiring a Talent Partner who goes out and finds the people themselves, owns a set of roles and EU markets end to end, and works with our hiring managers as a partner, not a scheduling desk.

You'll report to Marko, who leads talent at Duvo, and work directly with our founders and hiring managers.

What you'll do

Own your roles and markets. You'll take a portfolio of roles across engineering and GTM, plus the European markets we're pushing hardest into. Open the role, build the pipeline, run the process, close the offer. You're accountable for the hire landing, not for the funnel looking busy.

Source directly. Most of the people we want will never apply. You'll run outbound on LinkedIn and beyond, work referrals properly, and use AI to find candidates nobody else is talking to. When a role opens, you've got people on the phone that week.

Own the screen. Every candidate who reaches a hiring manager has been through you first. Strong screening calls, clear written notes, an honest pass or fail. You'd rather reject a maybe than waste a loop.

Partner with hiring managers. Agree the bar before the first CV, calibrate in writing, chase feedback until it lands, and push back when a process or a requirement doesn't make sense.

Keep the agencies honest. For your markets, brief agency partners properly, hold them to our bar, and cut the ones that send noise.

Run a tight, automated process. Scheduling, trial days, logistics, candidate comms. Nothing falls through the cracks, and anything you do twice gets automated. We build AI agents for a living and we run hiring the same way: Ashby underneath, AI across screening, research and interview prep, and agents handling scheduling and chasing. You'll use that system every day and help build the next parts of it.

Look after candidates. Everyone who talks to us knows where they stand, quickly, whether it's a yes or a no.


Who you are

  • 3+ years in recruiting, in-house at a startup or scale-up or at a tech-focused agency, with full-cycle ownership.

  • A real sourcer. You can show us pipelines you built from zero for hard roles, not just inbound you processed.

  • Experience hiring engineers, plus comfort with commercial roles like AEs, partner managers or consultants.

  • Experience hiring across European markets.

  • Technically literate. You can read a GitHub profile, understand a stack and hold a credible first conversation with an engineer. You don't need to code, but you can't be bluffing in that call.

  • A bar-raiser. You'll make the pass or fail call and stand behind it.

raw.title: Junior Data Scientist & Marketing Effectiveness - Jan-March 2027 Start date
raw.description:
London – Junior Consultant, Data Science & Marketing Effectiveness
Multiple Start Dates available for Jan-March 2027 Start date
£40,500 + Bonus + benefits. 
 
Ekimetrics is a leader in Marketing Effectiveness, Data Science and AI-powered solutions. We are one of the world’s largest independent analytics and consulting firms, pioneering the use of AI and advanced data science for over 16 years. 
 
Our goal: Combine high-impact AI and data science solutions for long-term sustainable business performance
 
Key figures about Eki
·        400 data science experts globally
·        1000+ diverse projects for more than 350 clients
·        5 offices: Paris, Hong Kong, London, New York & Shanghai
·        $1 billion in profits generated for our clients
·        7000 tons of CO2 prevented by our clients in 2022.
·        UK data company of the year 2023
·        Shortlisted Best STEM company to work for Women 2024
·        Voted Great Place to Work 2023
·        Voted as a leader in “Marketing Measurement and Optimisation” by Forrester Wave 2023.
 
Here in the UK, at our London-based office, we engage across four business offerings: MMM (mixed market modelling), customer analytics, data science transformations, and AI4 sustainability. We have clients across multiple industries such as retail, consumer goods, luxury fashion, insurance, banking, private equity, tech partners and many more.
 
About the Role
As a Junior Consultant, this is an exciting opportunity to develop a dual profile – The data scientist and strategic consultant. You will be working on challenging data science projects with international clients across multiple industries, building bespoke marketing analytics solutions to answer our clients’ key questions.
 
What you’ll be doing as a Junior Consultant:
·        Apply econometrics using data science and AI for business problems.
·        Understand clients’ business context and collaborate in a fast-paced environment.
·        Work on Marketing Mix Modelling (MMM) and Customer Analytics projects end-to-end, from gathering and analysing data to building statistical machine learning models and delivering presentations.
·        Work on 1-3 projects across global markets and industries such as retail, consumer goods, luxury fashion, insurance, banking, private equity, tech partners and many more.
·        Contribute to Ekimetrics R&D to support the development of new methodologies and build data Engineering/Architecture capabilities in the office.
·        Contribute to Eki.Life culture initiatives, well-being and help drive our CSR commitments
 
This is a great opportunity to join a growing, international pioneer in data science that will empower you to have an immediate impact from the beginning. At Ekimetrics, we thrive on accelerating growth for ambitious individuals. A Junior Consultant can expect to develop significantly in a short period while consistently delivering exceptional, high-quality results for our clients.
 
About You
Ekimetrics is seeking individuals who can wear 2 hats – the data scientist and the strategic consultant. You will most likely be a recent graduate with internship experience or early in your professional career.
 
What you need to succeed:
·        A degree in Data Science, Economics or a similar analytical field (e.g. econometrics, statistics, mathematics, or other quantitative degrees like Engineering, Data Science, etc.)
·        Prior experience (academic or professional) in data analysis/ modelling / advanced analytics or ML.
·        Experience with programming languages such as Python or R - we use Python at Eki.
·        Capacity to work and learn quickly in a fast-paced environment.
·        Exceptional written and oral communication skills.
·        Interest in Data and Marketing to make an impact for businesses
·        Ability to work within an inclusive and diverse team to deliver innovative solutions.
·        A passion for joining a small team and a keen interest in personal learning and development.
·        Demonstration of behaviours that support our values: Curiosity, Creativity, Excellence, Transmission, and Pleasure.
 Additional Requirements:
·        Must be able to work on-site a minimum of 2 days a week in London, UK (Hybrid)
·        Good sense of humour!
 
Working for Eki
 
Working for Ekimetrics is a lot of fun! Our London team is growing (65+people). We come from all over the world, have varied experiences and passions, and all contribute value to Ekimetrics’ success.
 
As well as an opportunity to join a driven, energetic, and highly innovative team, we also offer the following:
·        Competitive Compensation + individual & company y bonuses
·        Continuous Learning and development opportunities with Eki.Academy, training programs and certifications
·        Hybrid working (Minimum 2 days a week in the office)
·        20 days a year Work from Anywhere
·        25 days annual leave (+ Bank Holidays + additional days for tenure)
·        Private healthcare, life insurance, critical illness cover, and professional wellbeing support services
·        Group pension scheme
·        An emphasis on work-life balance and a strong company culture
·        Eki. Anniversary gifts for every year of service
·        Opportunities to develop a dual profile in data science and strategic consulting.
·        Opportunities for international mobility
·        Cycle to Work Scheme
·        Wellbeing support, Gym and retail discounts & 50% off runners need!
 
At Ekimetrics, we believe our best assets are our people - they are what set us apart and drive our success. We encourage entrepreneurial spirit and innovation. We share what we know with others, and, above all, we love what we do. These sentiments are supported by our company values which serve as pillars in our work and attitude.
 
Follow our Ekimetrics’ values: Curiosity, Creativity, Excellence, Transmission and Pleasure.
 
Ekimetrics is an equal opportunities employer committed to making all employment decisions without regard to race, ethnicity, gender, pregnancy, gender identity or expression, creed, religion, nationality, age, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, military veteran status, current employment status, or any other legally protected categories, subject to applicable law.
Interview process
1. Online Hacker rank - May contrain Python coding
2. HR interview
3. Assessment with a consultant
4. Case study Assessment
5. Final interview with a Manager

raw.title: Marketing Tech (Senior) Principal
raw.description:
Farfetch exists for the love of fashion. We believe in empowering individuality. Our mission is to be the global technology platform for luxury fashion, connecting creators, curators and consumers.We're a positive platform for good, bringing together an incredible creative community made up by our people, our partners and our customers. This community is at the heart of our business success. We welcome differences, empower individuality and celebrate diverse skills and perspectives, creating an inclusive environment for everyone. We are FARFETCH for All.
 
MARKETING
We’re a diverse team of Marketing professionals, spanning artistic and scientific expertise. We’re driven to amaze our global community of customers through our data-driven approach, revolutionary spirit, test and learn culture and collaborative style. All for the love of fashion.
 
LONDON OR PORTO
Our office is located in Old Street, London's tech hub while most of our engineering and product stakeholders are based out of Porto in Portugal. Our open-plan space in both locations is ideal for collaborative working. When you're not doing what's never been done, you can enjoy a team lunch on our large outdoor terrace, or join a yoga class in our dedicated studio in the London office. 
 
THE ROLE
We are seeking a highly skilled Marketing Tech (Senior) Principal to join our dynamic team at Farfetch, reporting to our VP Growth Marketing. You will be responsible for leading the organization's efforts to lead the strategic development and optimization of marketing technology solutions to enhance channel performance, drive efficiency, and support ambitious business growth. 

WHAT YOU'LL DO
  • Architect and oversee the integration of marketing technologies, ensuring seamless data flow across paid marketing channels (SEM, Paid Social, Display, Affiliates etc), web & app analytics, CRM and personalization platforms.

  • Partner with marketing, product, and engineering teams to define and implement scalable solutions that improve audience & value signals, attribution, and campaign performance.

  • Ensure compliance with data privacy regulations while maximizing the use of first-party data for personalization and performance optimization.

  • Define best practices, governance frameworks, and training programs to enhance marketing tech & AI adoption across teams.

  • Help Farfetch in driving towards a single customer view across all touchpoints and parts of the journey 

  • Work with marketing & product teams to optimise our product feeds with rich & accurate data for paid & organic channels


    • WHO YOU ARE

  • Deep expertise in marketing technology platforms (e.g., CDPs, customer analytics tools, server-side tagging, customer engagement and automation platforms).

  • Ideally worked in an e-commerce environment with an understanding of online consumer behavior.

  • Strong technical background with experience in REST APIs, data architecture, and marketing automation workflows.

  • Ability to translate complex technical concepts into business-friendly strategies that drive marketing performance.

  • Demonstrated ability to effectively communicate complex technical concepts and strategies to senior management, resulting in measurable positive impacts on business operations and outcomes.

  • Experience working cross-functionally with marketing, product, data science, and engineering teams (eg managing RFPs with service providers).

  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with a data-driven mindset and a passion for innovation.

  • Extensive hands-on or leadership experience in Search Marketing or Display Marketing is a strong plus.


    • REWARDS & BENEFITS
  • Employee Pension Scheme 
  • Flexible Benefits Program 
  • Health Insurance & Critical Illness cover 
  • Flexible work environment- 3 days a week in the office, 2 days from home

    • EQUAL OPPORTUNITIES STATEMENT & SCAM DISCLAIMER
  • EQUAL OPPORTUNITIES STATEMENT- Farfetch is an equal opportunities employer ensuring that all applicants are treated equally and fairly throughout our recruitment process. We are determined that no applicant experiences discrimination on the basis of sex, race, ethnicity, religion or belief, disability, age, gender identity, ancestry, sexual orientation, veteran status, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, or any other basis prohibited by applicable law. 
  • SCAM DISCLAIMER- It has come to our attention that there may be fraudulent activities involving individuals or organizations falsely claiming to represent Farfetch in order to attract candidates to a SCAM. Please be aware that Farfetch does not conduct recruitment processes through messaging apps or any unofficial communication channels, other than our official careers website. Additionally, Farfetch will never ask candidates for any form of payment during the recruitment process.

raw.title: Senior Financial Analyst
raw.description:
Farfetch is a leading global marketplace for the luxury fashion industry. The Farfetch Marketplace connects customers in over 190 countries and territories with items from more than 50 countries and over 1,400 of the world’s best brands, boutiques, and department stores, delivering a truly unique shopping experience and access to the most extensive selection of luxury on a global marketplace. 

FINANCE 

We're a diverse team who partners and supports the business to enable delivery against our strategic and financial goals. All of our functions have an instrumental role within Farfetch to drive forward a financially sustainable business, ensuring we set the guardrails for financial control and enable financial performance.

 

LONDON

Our London office is located in Old Street, London’s tech hub, and is home to a wide range of teams. Our open space is ideal for collaborative work and sharing ideas. We also have a large outdoor terrace, which is the perfect spot to have a team lunch or host events. 

ROLE

As a Senior Financial Analyst you will partner directly with functional senior leaders helping to create a world-class business partnering function who are pivotal in turning insights into actions, driving business performance, and profitability, and championing the long-term financial health of the FARFETCH Group. This role will ensure that the organization operates with financial coherence and that the senior leaders and stakeholders have a transparent view of how their areas of responsibility are performing, giving clarity on the financial impact of their strategic, operational, and trading decisions.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Act as a trusted advisor, partnering with cross-functional teams to understand their business objectives and provide financial guidance

  • Identify opportunities for cost optimization, process improvements, and revenue growth initiatives

  • Help to bring alignment of financial management across the diverse elements of the organization, standardizing reporting and bringing focus to key financial KPIs

  • Deliver analysis, insight, and recommendations on the financial implications of key business decisions in a timely and efficient way

  • Challenge the organisation to deliver financial goals aligned with the Group's operating and financial strategy through business partnering, driving growth in top-line revenue and efficiencies in the cost base and working capital

  • Delivery of financial planning, budgeting, and forecasting for functional areas, translating the vision of the business into a long-term financial strategy, and supporting the development of the strategy to drive the business

  • Identify and implement process improvements and participate in existing reporting enhancements with the mindset of continuous improvement

WHO YOU ARE

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field; MBA/ACCA/ACA is a plus

  • Proven experience in P&L ownership and financial planning, within retail, technology, or the e-Commerce industry is advantageous

  • Proven people leadership and management experience, able to lead with an authentic style and ensure team delivery to high standards

  • Strong commercial acumen, with an ability to influence strategic business decisions, keeping the financial health of the business front of mind

  • A strategic mindset, with an ability to have a long-term vision with an eye on detail

  • Self-motivated in a fast-paced and rapidly changing environment with competing deadlines, driven to deliver results

  • A strong team player with the ability to interact and effectively communicate with those outside of Finance teams to deliver preferred outcomes

REWARDS & BENEFITS

  • Flexible working environment and well-being support and tools 

  • Extra days off, sabbatical program and days for you to give back for the community 

  • Training opportunities and free access to Udemy 

  • Flexible benefits program

EQUAL OPPORTUNITIES STATEMENT

  • FARFETCH is committed to being an inclusive workplace where diversity in all its forms is celebrated. We make employment decisions without regard to race, religious creed, color, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, ancestry, marital status, medical condition as defined by state law, physical or mental disability, military service or veteran status, pregnancy, childbirth and related medical conditions, genetic information or any other classification protected by applicable federal, state or local laws or ordinances. If you require special accommodation, please let us know.

The Legal team is a strategic business area ensuring we navigate the complexities of a global business and acting as guardians of our legal integrity, providing expert advice to protect our interests, manage risks, and ensure compliance.

 

LONDON

Our London office is located in Old Street, London’s tech hub, and is home to a wide range of teams. Our open space is ideal for collaborative work and sharing ideas. We also have a large outdoor terrace, which is the perfect spot to have a team lunch or host events.

 

ROLE

The Legal Team at Farfetch is seeking a Senior Legal Counsel - Regulatory for a broad regulatory and commercial role. This is a unique opportunity to advise on regulatory matters within a global, fast-moving and innovative business. You will enjoy a diverse role, delivering high-quality strategic legal advice across multiple operational territories in conjunction with our wider international Legal Team. You will work closely with the broader legal team and all business areas.

Acting as a true business partner, this role requires someone who is commercially minded, intellectually curious and hands-on, able to quickly understand and apply new sets of international laws and regulations - identifying and mitigating risks, as well as seizing opportunities. It is a role for someone with strong professional ethics and the energy, interest and experience to pursue a large array of regulatory and commercial matters. 


WHAT YOU'LL DO
  • Advise on payment regulation and broader regulatory frameworks, including in relation to digital regulation, product compliance and consumer protection
  • Track and assess existing and new requirements for the Farfetch Group, with a focus on payments regulation, as well as advise on their implementation
  • Identify, monitor and evaluate relevant regulatory risks and enforcement trends, and take proactive steps to mitigate these
  • Develop strategies for, and engage with, relevant regulators 
  • Advise on commercial matters, including on contractual agreements with partners and payment processors, and ensure a compliant payment model
  • Work on tariffs-related matters and advise from a legal perspective
  • Negotiate, draft and review commercial contracts, policies, guidance and other legal documentation 
  • Provide proactive, strategic and pragmatic advice
  • Liaise with external law firms, where external support is needed
  • Support the Group Legal VP, Regulatory Legal Team and the business in ensuring it operates in a compliant manner
  • Use legal technology and AI tools in an ethical way to deliver advice efficiently, and help the team adopt and get the best from these tools

    • WHO YOU ARE
  • A qualified lawyer with at least 4 years’ PQE and superior analytical skills and creative problem-solving skills. Prior in-house experience would be beneficial 
  • Have excellent training, preferably in a top-tier law firm
  • Have experience advising on payments regulation and commercial matters
  • Have proven ability to assess new pieces of international legislation/regulation and apply them on a risk-based basis to a business 
  • Have the curiosity and ability to absorb a lot of information quickly, apply it in assessments, and drive implementation
  • Be able to understand nuances and complexities, and translate these into commercial, pragmatic, and concise advice in the context of a global business
  • Have a strong work ethic and attention to detail, be highly proactive, organized and efficient, able to work on fast-moving projects
  • Be able to work autonomously but also well in teams, supervising legal counsel and supporting the Group Legal VP and Regulatory Legal Team
  • Possess excellent communication, organization and drafting skills

raw.title: Senior Program Manager, Scale Onboarding (London, United Kingdom)
Broker Development Manager
raw.description:
ABOUT FLOCK

Road accidents kill and injure people, damage vehicles, and cost businesses fortunes. But traditional insurance does nothing to prevent them - it just pays out claims when they happen. At Flock, we’re changing that. Using telematics, AI, and real-time data, we proactively help our fleet customers prevent crashes. We obsessively focus on keeping drivers safe, and we put our money where our mouth is - paying out millions of pounds per year to fleets that get safer over time.

We were acquired by Admiral in May 2026. Now we combine the backing of the UK’s leading motor insurer with startup energy and speed. We’re growing fast with bigger plans than ever, and we’re hugely optimistic that our approach will save many more lives in the decade ahead.

We’re on a mission to make the world quantifiably safer. Join us!

THE ROLE 

Our brokers play a crucial role in making this a reality. We’re an AI-first business, so whatever the role, we want people who reach for AI by default, stay curious about what it can do, and use it to work faster and think bigger. You’ll use AI day to day, from researching brokers to preparing for meetings, so more of your time goes on the conversations that win business. We’re looking for an ambitious and passionate Broker Development Manager to accelerate our distribution through brokers. In this role, you’ll maximise existing broker relationships and build strong, strategic, growth partnerships as part of our fast-paced distribution team right at the heart of Flock’s mission.

WHAT WE THINK IS MOST EXCITING ABOUT THE ROLE:

Be a part of building something truly game changing in the fleet market. You’ll manage a panel of key strategic brokers with significant growth opportunities. You’ll engage them on the market-leading benefits of Flock’s connected fleet proposition, and how together, we can reduce risk, improve costs and save lives. You’ll also have real freedom in how you use AI to work, whether that’s getting under the skin of a broker’s book before a meeting or spotting growth opportunities across your panel.

A LITTLE MORE ON WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING:

  • Act as a primary face of Flock for a panel of key broker partners, driving mutual growth and long-term success.

  • Deliver high volumes of broker submissions, directly supporting Flock’s ambitious growth targets.

  • Build, grow and develop our broker panel, onboarding new partners at pace and maximising their commercial potential.

  • Proactively engage brokers, finding new and creative ways to promote Flock’s appetite and proposition as we expand into new sectors.

  • Develop and execute clear, data-driven account growth strategies to drive sustained performance.

  • Achieve strong conversion and retention by supporting day-to-day trading activity and helping brokers (and Flock) win and retain business.

  • Work closely with internal teams, collaborating with brilliant Flockers across the business to deliver shared growth objectives.

  • Maintain strong broker advocacy by being visible, responsive and passionate about Flock’s product, proposition and mission.

  • Use AI in your day-to-day work, from broker research and meeting prep to analysing your pipeline, so your time goes on relationships rather than admin.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING TO FLOCK:

ESSENTIAL

  • A minimum of 5 years of experience in managing broker relationships within the insurance sector, possessing a reputable standing in the industry.

  • Energy and innovation in abundance - the ability to work fast, spot opportunity and solve problems. 

  • A proven track record of exceeding revenue targets, driving business growth, and closely collaborating with cross-functional teams to achieve collective objectives.

  • An existing network of broker contacts that will enable a rapid integration and immediate impact within Flock’s business development realm.

  • Exceptional understanding of the commercial broker marketplace, competitor carriers, broker business models, and processes.

  • Ability to deliver a consultative sales process, aligning Flock’s value proposition with brokers’ current and future business needs.

  • Comfortable using AI in your daily work, from research and meeting prep to account analysis, and curious about where else it could help you win business.

PREFERABLE

  • Experience building networks of brokers in a Commercial Motor Fleet setting. 

  • Have a broker distribution background with an active panel of brokers in the commercial insurance market. 

  • Can embrace new technologies and products, with experience of successfully distributing these to brokers.

WHAT WE OFFER (in addition to a competitive salary)

  • 25 days of holiday (+ Bank Holidays) 🏖 

  • Share Incentive Plan 📈

  • Workplace Pension 💰

  • Private Medical Insurance 🏥 (including Dental 🦷 Optical 👓 & Mental Health 💆‍♀️ support options)

  • Various Salary Sacrifice Schemes - Holiday Purchase, Tech, Gym, Cycle to Work, Electric Vehicle, Private Medical Insurance for families 💵

  • Enhanced Parental Leave and Pay 🐣

  • £1000 toward relevant professional qualifications 🎓

  • £500 per annum towards learning and development 🌱

  • 3 days paid leave for L&D purposes 🌻

We work hybrid, typically three days a week in our Central London office (fewer office days can be accommodated for longer commute times), a few minutes from Moorgate and Liverpool Street. Visits to client sites, conferences and broker offices count towards office days.

ONE LAST THING..

Authenticity is important to us. We value the unique qualities and experiences you bring. So if you apply, just be your genuine self. It’s who we want!

raw.title: Chief Information Security Officer (CISO)
raw.description:
About Fractile

Fractile was founded in 2022 on the bet that, eventually, the world’s most capable AI systems would be limited in their impact by the time taken to produce useful outputs. We bet everything on the logical conclusion: that the only way to truly unlock this latent value, to make speed viable at scale, was to radically re-invent the hardware that we run our frontier AI models on. Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to efficiently generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts.

 

The workloads that push to the limits of the current frontier are already transformational; it is the technical and economic limits on inference speed that are constraining progress. The defining work of the 21st century will be marked by the engine of inference delivering immense and diffuse chains of intellectual inquiry, in drug discovery, in software engineering, in materials discovery, in any field where progress is driven by deep reasoning and intelligence to resolve complex problems.

Fractile is building the next generation of AI computing technology, developing innovative hardware and software solutions designed to transform the performance and efficiency of AI workloads.

We're bringing together exceptional talent across semiconductor engineering, software, and AI to solve some of the most ambitious challenges in computing.

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced and highly technical Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) to lead Fractile's information security, corporate IT, and IT infrastructure functions.

You will be responsible for developing and executing a comprehensive technology and security strategy, ensuring Fractile's systems, infrastructure, intellectual property, and business operations are secure, reliable, and scalable.

This is a strategic and hands-on leadership role, combining cybersecurity expertise with ownership of IT operations, infrastructure, and service delivery. You will build and lead high-performing teams, establish robust processes and governance, and ensure our technology environment supports Fractile's rapid growth and engineering ambitions.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute Fractile's information security, IT, and infrastructure strategy, ensuring alignment with business objectives, operational requirements, and global growth.

  • Lead IT service delivery, including employee technology, hardware and software provisioning, IT support, onboarding and offboarding, asset management, and enterprise applications.

  • Protect Fractile's proprietary semiconductor designs, intellectual property, source code, research, and confidential business information against internal and external threats.

  • Partner with engineering teams to ensure secure, reliable, and scalable infrastructure supporting semiconductor development, software engineering, and research environments.

  • Establish and maintain cybersecurity governance, risk management frameworks, policies, and controls aligned with recognised industry standards and regulatory requirements.

  • Lead cybersecurity incident response, threat detection, vulnerability management, disaster recovery, and business continuity planning across IT and infrastructure environments.

  • Oversee IT and security architecture, including identity and access management, network security, endpoint protection, cloud security, access controls, and secure systems integration.

  • Manage technology vendors, infrastructure providers, third-party security risks, IT budgets, procurement, licensing, and supplier relationships to ensure operational efficiency and value.

  • Build, lead, and develop high-performing IT, infrastructure, and security teams, advising executive leadership on technology risks, investments, priorities, and operational resilience.

Requirements

  • Significant leadership experience across information security, IT operations, and infrastructure, ideally as a CISO, CIO, VP IT & Security, or equivalent within a technology organisation.

  • Proven experience developing and executing IT, infrastructure, and cybersecurity strategies in complex, high-growth environments.

  • Strong technical expertise across enterprise IT, cloud infrastructure, networking, systems administration, identity management, endpoint management, and cybersecurity.

  • Demonstrated experience building, scaling, and managing IT infrastructure and service delivery functions, including enterprise applications, employee IT support, and operational processes.

  • Experience protecting sensitive intellectual property, proprietary technologies, engineering systems, or research and development environments.

  • Comprehensive understanding of cybersecurity risk management, governance, compliance, and frameworks such as ISO 27001, NIST CSF, and SOC 2

  • Proven ability to establish resilient, scalable, and secure infrastructure, including disaster recovery, business continuity, monitoring, and incident management.

  • Experience managing IT and security budgets, technology procurement, vendor relationships, and third-party service providers.

  • Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with senior executives and highly technical engineering teams.

  • Experience within AI infrastructure, high-performance or deep-tech environments would be highly advantageous.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary: A competitive salary reflective of your experience and the specialist nature of the role.

  • Equity & Ownership: meaningful equity so everyone shares in the value creation.

  • Diverse & fun office: we believe the hardest problems get solved by the broadest range of minds. We are committed to Equal Employment Opportunity through attracting and retaining a diverse team and building an inclusive environment.

We bet everything on the logical conclusion: that the only way to truly unlock this latent value, to make speed viable at scale, was to radically reinvent the hardware that we run our frontier AI models on. Ever since, we have been building chips and systems that tackle this problem: how to efficiently generate output at thousands of tokens per second, while handling the complexity and capacity challenges of operating large models at very long contexts.

The role:

Fractile is at a pivotal moment in our growth to serve as our primary export compliance authority. You will build, operationalize, and maintain the trade compliance frameworks, classification pipelines, and operational controls that safeguard and enable our advanced AI hardware operations and global supply chain.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Trade Compliance Operations

  •       Act as Fractile’s designated Export Compliance Officer, taking operational and legal ownership of US, UK, and relevant international export controls and economic sanctions compliance. Act as the official point of contact for licenses, audits, and compliance enforcement.

  •       Lead hands-on ECCN / classifications for all Fractile technology and products. Manage end-to-end export licensing processes, including UK ECJU (SPIRE/LITE) and US BIS applications, end-user undertakings (EUUs), and license condition monitoring.

  •       Oversee denied party screening workflows across customers, vendors, supply chain partners, and prospective hires.

  •       Assist with customs compliance processes.

  •       Work with stakeholders on implementation of suitable IT controls and systems.

  1. Policy Framework & Operational Integration

  •       Design, embed, and continuously audit Fractile’s internal compliance programme tailored to scale-up speed. Integrate compliance checks and export hold mechanisms into enterprise workflows. Develop and deliver practical, role-specific training regarding controlled technology transfers (deemed exports/re-exports).

  1. Audit Readiness & Regulator Engagement

  •       Maintain rigorous, audit-ready record-keeping systems for all exports, re-exports, and technical data transfers. Act as the primary operational contact for UK ECJU, HMRC, US BIS, and freight forwarders during compliance audits or shipping inquiries. Monitor regulatory updates targeting AI hardware, semiconductor supply chains, and sanctions to adjust operational processes rapidly.

Candidate Profile & Qualifications

  • Relevant Experience: 5+ years of dedicated trade compliance experience within a technology (ideally semiconductor) scale-up/multinational.

  • Domain Expertise: Practical, working mastery of both UK export control rules (ECJU) and US rules (deemed exports, foreign direct product rules, and sanctions regimes).

  • Technical Aptitude: Proven capability to translate complex technical hardware/software specs into precise ECCN classifications.

  • Systems Experience: Experience implementing and operating automated screening.

  • Pragmatic Business Partner: Ability to build smooth, low-friction, proportionate processes and operational controls that keep fast-moving engineering and commercial teams compliant without stalling growth.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive salary: A competitive salary reflective of your experience and the specialist nature of the role.

  • Equity & Ownership: Meaningful equity so everyone shares in the value creation.

  • Benefits: Private Medical, Dental and Vision, Contributory Pension, 25 days' holiday plus bank holidays and Life/Critical Illness Insurance.

  • Diverse & fun office: we believe the hardest problems get solved by the broadest range of minds. We are committed to Equal Employment Opportunity through attracting and retaining a diverse team and building an inclusive environment.
