raw.title: Senior Product Manager, Cruise Liners & Port Operations
raw.description:
At Kpler, we are dedicated to helping our clients navigate complex markets with ease. By simplifying global trade information and providing valuable insights, we empower organisations to make informed decisions in commodities, energy, and maritime sectors.
 
Since our founding in 2014, we have focused on delivering top-tier intelligence through user-friendly platforms. Our team of over 850 experts from 69 countries works tirelessly to transform intricate data into actionable strategies, ensuring our clients stay ahead in a dynamic market landscape. Join us to leverage cutting-edge innovation for impactful results and experience unparalleled support on your journey to success.
 

Kpler is expanding into high-value maritime verticals, with Cruise Liners and Port Operations representing two important opportunities. Both address a common market need: the lack of independent, reliable insights into actual performance, built on observed data rather than published schedules or self-reported information.

In the cruise sector, operators and analysts often rely on published itineraries rather than actual vessel movements, despite the significant fuel and carbon costs associated with fleet operations. In ports, performance data is often incomplete or self-reported, creating a need for independent benchmarking as berth-level emissions carry increasing financial implications under schemes such as the EU ETS.

As a Senior Product Manager, Cruise Liners & Port Operations, you will own both products end to end, from strategy and roadmap through to the first release and go-to-market. Working closely with the Lead Product Manager – Maritime & Logistics, you will build two early-stage products in parallel, leveraging Kpler’s network of more than 13,000 AIS receivers and over 10,000 mapped ports and berths.

For Cruise Liners, you will develop itinerary intelligence for tracked fleets, providing an independent view of actual sailed itineraries, fuel consumption and emissions. For Port Operations, you will build a product focused on port-level vessel activity monitoring, giving port authorities a reliable, live view of activity and performance.

This is an individual-contributor role for an experienced product professional with a background in maritime, cruise, travel, ports or an adjacent B2B data/SaaS environment. You will need to balance competing priorities across two products, establish trusted data methodologies, engage customers and bring both products to market through a pragmatic, build-and-iterate approach.




Key Responsibilities
  • Own the product strategy and roadmap for Cruise Liners and Port Operations, prioritising customer needs and commercial opportunities while making trade-offs between the two products explicit.
  • Lead market discovery with cruise operators, port authorities, harbour masters and terminal operators, gathering requirements and translating customer needs into product priorities.
  • Drive delivery across both products, maintaining clear roadmaps, delivery cadences and launch plans, with a pragmatic approach focused on launching initial capabilities and iterating based on feedback.
  • Establish trusted data and benchmarking methodologies for both products, developing an independent view of cruise itineraries, fuel and emissions, alongside consistent port call-cycle measurement and performance benchmarking.
  • Collaborate with Engineering, Data, Sales, Product Marketing and other product teams to align delivery, reuse shared data and emissions capabilities, and develop early data and distribution partnerships.
  • Define the Cruise Liners product direction, delivering fleet itinerary intelligence based on live, observed vessel movements that reflects actual sailed journeys rather than published schedules.
  • Build the Port Operations product, providing port authorities with a reliable, live view of vessel activity using Kpler’s AIS receiver network and mapped port and berth data.
  • Develop product positioning and competitive strategy, identifying opportunities to differentiate Kpler’s independent, first-party observed data from existing cruise analytics and port operations offerings.
  • Drive go-to-market execution for both products, working with Product Marketing on positioning, packaging, pricing input and launch planning, and establishing repeatable customer discovery and design partnerships.

    • Skills & Experience
  • 6–10 years of senior product or commercial experience in maritime data, cruise or travel, ports, or an adjacent B2B data/SaaS business, with a proven track record of delivering products that customers adopt.
  • Working fluency in at least one of cruise or port operations, with the ability to develop expertise quickly in the other.
  • Direct experience in the cruise or ports industry, with an established network among operators, port authorities and terminals.
  • Experience translating customer needs into product strategy and working closely with product and engineering teams to deliver solutions.
  • Experience managing multiple products or workstreams simultaneously, balancing competing priorities and maintaining delivery momentum.
  • Strong product discovery and roadmap prioritisation skills, with the ability to engage customers and translate market insights into actionable product requirements.
  • Experience working with data and engineering teams to deliver data-driven products.
  • Understanding of go-to-market planning, including product positioning, packaging and pricing input.
  • Familiarity with maritime and trade data concepts, including AIS, port calls and voyage legs.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to engage technical and commercial teams and senior external stakeholders.
  • A self-directed approach, with strong ownership, sound judgement and a pragmatic bias towards action.
  • Comfort working in an ambiguous, early-stage environment, with a build-and-iterate mindset.

    • Nice to have
  • Experience launching a new product line or building a product from concept to market, rather than solely managing an established offering.
  • Understanding of the regulatory environment shaping maritime and port operations, including the EU ETS, FuelEU Maritime, CII and green port incentive schemes.
  • Experience establishing customer design partnerships and building relationships with industry stakeholders to support product discovery and adoption.

Data Ethics & Legal Operations Analyst
raw.description:
LiveRamp is shaping the future of responsible data collaboration between the world’s leading brands, retailers, financial services providers, and healthcare innovators. As consumers embrace new AI-driven experiences, the LiveRamp data collaboration network exponentially expands the breadth and accuracy of the data on which marketing AI capabilities operate, powering deeper customer insight and measurable performance on a global scale. LiveRamp is headquartered in San Francisco, California, with offices worldwide. Learn more at LiveRamp.com.

We are looking for a highly-motivated, business-minded Legal and Data Ethics Operations Analyst. This person will help the Data Ethics and Legal teams solve internal problems, implement goal-oriented strategies and play a key role in the Data Ethics team.

This role strengthens operational execution across jurisdictions through process improvement, responsible AI enablement, privacy and legal operations, playbook development, and effective management of data subject requests.

You will:

  • Coordinate data subject request management, including intake, categorization, routing, deadline tracking, documentation, communications, and closure; work with the Data Ethics team on high-risk, complex, sensitive, or multi-jurisdictional requests.

  • Build and maintain practical playbooks, decision trees, checklists, templates, escalation criteria, and role-based guidance for recurring data ethics, privacy, legal, and regulatory processes.

  • Manage privacy questionnaire workflows by coordinating intake, preparing AI-assisted first drafts from approved information, maintaining supporting evidence, and escalating questions requiring legal, privacy, security, or data ethics judgment.

  • Support the design of responsible AI controls including approved-source use, permissions, confidentiality, traceability, version control, audit trails, quality checks, and human approval before material outputs are used.

  • Study our organizational workflows and processes to recommend and implement changes to help improve business processes and optimize overall operations.

  • Participate in creating team functional process documentation, creating presentation materials and facilitating or leading cross functional teams through projects and/or issues.

  • Co-ordinate, write and maintain information and knowledge resources to ensure it is kept up to date and supports users of the system(s). This includes managing and organizing documents within the Data Ethics department to ensure that they are accurate, up-to-date, and easily accessible.

  • Create, modify, and manage content on the Data Ethics intranet site.

  • Assist with the project planning, scheduling, and documentation of various department projects, such as working with subject matter experts to assist with designing and organizing training course content and may use instructional technology tools to develop participant materials, videos, practical exercises, and interactive eLearning.

  • Prepare operational reporting on questionnaire and request volumes, turnaround times, escalations, recurring issues, automation performance, risks, and improvement opportunities.

Your team will:

Our Data Ethics operations program is designed to enable LiveRamp to meet its privacy-related legal requirements and reasonable expectations of clients while minimizing and mitigating risk to LiveRamp. Our mission is to help the business find safe and legal ways to use data for the betterment of our products, services and consumers. The team operates as a connected, cross-border function that helps LiveRamp find safe, legal, ethical, and scalable ways to use data while supporting consistent execution across all locations.

About you:

  • Degree in a relevant discipline

  • Experience in a similar role required with relevant experience in data privacy, data ethics, legal operations, regulatory operations, or related process enablement

  • Experience completing critical analysis, review and editing of written documents

  • Ability to work in a collaborative manner to develop strong working relationships with the business and key stakeholders to facilitate data compliance while enabling commercial opportunities and support them in improving data protection and governance practices

  • Comfortable receiving loose requirements and working with internal team members to identify project objectives, collaborate to further define requirements, pull and validate the data, present the data to the end-users, and make refinements as needed. Strong communication and organizational skills are a must.

  • Ability to translate complex legal, regulatory, and data ethics requirements into practical processes, playbooks, decision trees, and guidance.

  • Experience applying AI or automation to privacy questionnaires, document or contract-template updates, knowledge retrieval, playbook creation, triage, or workflow orchestration.

  • Hands-on experience building, configuring, or implementing AI agents, automation, or AI-assisted workflows in a controlled business environment.

  • Self-motivated, proactive, and eager to dive into the business, data workflows, and technology

  • Comfort with ambiguity, multi-tasking, and independence

  • Excellent written/verbal communication, presentation, drafting and negotiation skills

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

  • Ability to organize, prioritize, manage deadlines, and handle complex escalations in a fast-paced and demanding work environment

  • Comfortable expressing a point of view and influencing change, as appropriate

  • Strong proficiency in Salesforce and Google Suite applications, especially Google Slides (preferred)

We use automated decision systems (ADS) as part of our recruitment and hiring process. If you require an accommodation or believe that the use of an ADS may create a barrier to your application or participation in the hiring process due to a disability or other protected characteristic, please let us know. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations and ensuring an equitable hiring experience for all candidates.

To all recruitment agencies: LiveRamp does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, LiveRamp employees or any other company location. LiveRamp is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

raw.title: Staff Technical Lead Manager
raw.description:
LiveRamp is shaping the future of responsible data collaboration between the world’s leading brands, retailers, financial services providers, and healthcare innovators. As consumers embrace new AI-driven experiences, the LiveRamp data collaboration network exponentially expands the breadth and accuracy of the data on which marketing AI capabilities operate, powering deeper customer insight and measurable performance on a global scale. LiveRamp is headquartered in San Francisco, California, with offices worldwide. Learn more at LiveRamp.com.

Role Summary
As the Technical Lead and People Manager for the Identity Engine team, you will be at the forefront of developing LiveRamp's first-party identity resolution platform. Identity Engine allows customers to configure their own resolution rules and workflows against their first-party data, unifying disparate sources into a persistent, customer-specific identifier — either as a configuration and recognition layer on top of LiveRamp's AbiliTec Identity Graph, or standalone to build an independent first-party graph. You will lead the team responsible for the platform's backend, orchestrating large-scale, configuration-driven resolution jobs across GCP and AWS, and helping enterprise clients build and activate a first-party identity graph in hours rather than months.

Key Responsibilities
Drive the technical strategy, architecture, and roadmap for the Identity Engine team, ensuring alignment with LiveRamp's overall engineering and product goals.
Lead a high-performing team of engineers, fostering a culture of technical excellence, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
Oversee the day-to-day execution and delivery of Identity Engine's data preparation, resolution, and export capabilities, ensuring operational excellence and quality at scale.
Anticipate and resolve complex issues and conflicts that extend beyond the team's direct area of responsibility.
Hold other teams accountable for quality and timely delivery when dependencies exist.
Actively engage in long-term (12-month) Product planning and priority setting, helping to define the strategic roadmap for Identity Engine.
Be the primary technical liaison for Product Management, ensuring technical feasibility and strategic alignment of product initiatives.
Help identify, develop, and hire strategic skills to enhance the overall capabilities of the LiveRamp engineering organization.
Maintain a significant individual contributor (IC) component (approximately 50% of time), focusing on complex technical challenges, architecture, and code quality reviews.

Required Qualifications
2+ years of demonstrating strong leadership skills, with a proven ability to deliver on products as the technical lead.
8+ years of hands-on development experience, ideally leveraging Java or other JVM based languages.
You oversee coding of critical areas and develop the most difficult code across multiple system components, driving high coding standards and improving development practices.
Demonstrated experience driving complex designs, high-quality interface/API designs, and overall architecture improvements across multiple teams and services, leading design reviews and ensuring consistent architecture.
Track record of driving product/service design and vision inside engineering, using global industry and market trends to deliver successful products and fulfilling unexpressed client wants.
Experience mentoring more junior engineers, providing technical guidance, and contributing to talent identification at Staff Level & above.
Strong communicator. Sharing information regularly and concisely.

Good to Have
Knowledge of the adTech space and particularly the identifiers used in the field.
Experience with large-scale distributed data processing (e.g., Apache Spark) and cloud data infrastructure across GCP and AWS (e.g., Dataproc, Dataflow, GKE, EMR).
Experience with Temporal

raw.title: Senior Product Manager, KYB - MoonPay Enterprise
raw.description:
MoonPay Enterprise is for builders with something to prove.

This isn't a "work on cool crypto stuff" company. It's a high-standards, high-velocity, high-accountability company building the operating system for value movement. If the internet moves information, we move value: crypto, stablecoins, tokenized assets, and whatever comes next. Four offerings make that real: fund, tokenize, trade, and spend.

MoonPay Enterprise is the fund layer built for businesses. We power how stablecoins move through real financial operations: enterprises, fintechs, PSPs, wallets, and marketplaces running their treasuries, their cross-border flows, and their stablecoin operations on us. The goal is to make moving real money at scale as predictable as any other piece of financial infrastructure, with the compliance and controls CFOs need to say yes.

AI is the default operating mode here. It's woven into every role, and we expect you to use it daily. It handles the manual work so you can deliver on what actually matters.

You'll thrive here if outcomes excite you more than process, if impact motivates you more than titles, and if you want hard problems, real ownership, and teammates who love winning, building, and doing it together.

The bar is high. The pace is real. We're building the rails that businesses run real money on, for humans and agents. MoonPay ranked #2 in Crypto Services on Fortune's inaugural Crypto 100, made Forbes' America's Best Startup Employers 2026 (Top 25 in Finance), and landed on The Sunday Times Best Places to Work two years running.


About MoonPay Enterprise

MoonPay Enterprise is one of the more operationally complex products in the stablecoin space: multiple banking providers, multiple payment rails, a growing partner base across two product lines (Orchestration and Issuance), and an active compliance surface across each. MoonPay Enterprise runs B2B, B2B2B, and B2B2C models. Partners integrate our API. Their customers become direct customers of MoonPay Enterprise for compliance purposes.

KYB is the front door. Every partner is a business. Every business customer of every partner clears KYB before a single transaction moves. Today the flow is part automated registry verification, part manual review, with different rules for the US and the rest of the world, and turnaround measured in days. That does not scale to where MoonPay Enterprise is going. KYB has to become a product: measurable, fast, API-first, defensible in front of regulators and banking partners. This is a principal seat. You set the multi-year direction for how businesses enter MoonPay Enterprise, and you own the outcome.

What You'll Own

KYB product strategy & roadmap

  • Business onboarding end-to-end, across every model MoonPay Enterprise runs: partners onboarding onto MoonPay Enterprise, businesses onboarding directly, and business customers onboarding through partners.

  • Platform altitude. KYB decisions ripple into KYC, Travel Rule capture, banking-provider onboarding, and Issuance partner diligence. Connect the surfaces; don't optimise one in isolation.

  • MoonPay Enterprise runs three KYC delivery models (reliance, outsourcing, hosted). KYB coverage is uneven across them. You decide where it expands and in what order.

  • Genuine product depth on MoonPay Enterprise is non-negotiable. Within weeks you talk fluently about KYB outcomes, UBO requirements, virtual account structures, and API behaviour. From being hands-on, not from documentation.

Onboarding funnel & conversion

  • The KYB funnel is yours: pass rate, time-to-verified against a 48-72h target, manual review rate, drop-off per step.

  • Instrument what isn't instrumented. Make approval speed and rejection quality measurable. Then move both.

  • Fix rejection UX. Today a declined business often gets a status without a reason, and the partner escalates to support to find out what is missing. Rejection reasons, retry semantics, and resubmission flows become API surface partners build on.

KYB API & partner experience

  • The KYB API surface: statuses, webhooks, document submission, and the edge cases that make business onboarding hard (sole proprietors, corporate shareholders, one person who is UBO, Director, and Representative at once).

  • Partners integrate KYB in weeks and self-serve their onboarding questions. Every "what is missing for this customer" escalation is a product gap. Close it.

Compliance as product

  • Turn compliance-approved onboarding matrices into product logic. US and non-US differ: control prong versus directors, when ownership documents are required, self-certification options. Partners should never need to read a matrix.

  • EDD triggers, high-risk classification, prohibited industries, Travel Rule capture: you decide how they show up in the product.

  • Compliance is your sparring partner, not a ticket queue. You shape how policy becomes product. They own the policy.

Vendor & provider orchestration

  • The verification stack (SumSub today) and the build-versus-buy calls around it.

  • Cost per verification, automation rate, vendor performance. Know when a second provider, a waterfall, or in-house tooling earns its place.

  • Push automation. Decide where AI-assisted review with a human in the loop replaces manual queues, and prove it does not raise risk.

  • Every new banking provider brings its own onboarding requirements. Keep KYB compatible with every rail without collecting everything from everyone.

Who You Are

  • A principal-level PM with real KYB or KYC depth. You have owned onboarding, identity, verification, or risk as a platform, not a feature.

  • High agency. You do not wait for a mandate, a brief, or perfect data. You find the problem, claim it, and fix it.

  • Full autonomy, zero to one. Hand you an unowned surface and you take it from first principles to shipped. No handover document, no waiting for direction.

Global Health and Safety Lead
raw.description:
Mission

Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear.

In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives.

Role Purpose

Every Neko clinic brings together members, advanced medical equipment, a clinical team and, before opening, an active construction site. The Global Health & Safety Lead ensures that all of this is safe and legally compliant in every country where we operate, and that safety is embedded in how we select, build, open and run our clinics.

This is a build role. With hundreds of new locations planned across global markets, you will establish the standards, checks and processes that make every opening safe and legally compliant, and build the global standards and operating systems that oversee day-to-day health and safety, adapted to each market’s legislation and needs.

You will own Neko’s day-to-day health and safety management so that our members and staff are in a safe environment, select and implement the systems to run it at scale, and put in place the training, audits and people needed to sustain high standards as we grow.



What You’ll Deliver in the First 6–12 Months

Clinic Openings

  • A repeatable opening process, with the health and safety standards, checks and sign-offs every new clinic must pass before it opens, built to work across hundreds of locations in different markets.

  • Map the health and safety legal requirements in each Neko market and establish global standards with local additions where required.

  • Health and safety due diligence for every new site and new market, with a clear view of the residual market risks.

  • Safety integrated into clinic design and construction, in partnership with the real estate and construction teams: contractor requirements and pre-qualification, site audits, and complete safety briefings at handover.

  • Emergency and evacuation plans agreed with the Global Security Lead.

Risk Management and Infrastructure

  • A global health and safety management system, adapted locally for each market, that oversees day-to-day safety across every clinic and office.

  • Risk assessments for every clinic, office and build site, covering fire safety, first aid, manual handling and the use of medical equipment.

  • Controls for clinic-specific hazards, including clinical waste and the safe operation of medical equipment, aligned with local regulation and quality management systems.

  • A risk-based audit programme and a set of performance measures reported regularly to the COO.

Day to Day Operations

  • Ownership of Neko’s day-to-day health and safety management, so our members and staff are in a safe environment in every clinic.

  • Routine maintenance and compliance checks that control building risks including fire, water hygiene, electrical safety and lifts, in collaboration with Facilities.

  • Robust reporting, investigation and corrective action processes for incidents and near misses, including statutory reporting to regulators.

  • Induction and ongoing training for clinic teams, including fire wardens and first aiders who can lead effectively in an emergency.

Tech Forward

  • Selection and implementation of the systems used to manage health and safety globally.



Minimum Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in health and safety, including responsibility across more than one country.

  • A recognised professional qualification, such as the NEBOSH Diploma, Chartered membership of IOSH (CMIOSH) or equivalent.

  • Experience building or running a health and safety management system, ideally certified to ISO 45001.

  • Hands-on experience of construction or fit-out safety for new commercial sites.

  • A track record of leading incident investigations and driving corrective actions through completion.

  • Ability to influence operations, construction, and senior leadership teams without direct authority.

  • Ability to travel regularly between markets.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Background in multi-site, public-facing businesses such as healthcare, fitness, wellness, co-working, tech, retail or hospitality.

  • Experience in a regulated environment involving medical equipment or a quality management system.

  • Experience managing contractor safety on new builds.

  • ISO 45001 lead auditor training or equivalent.

  • Knowledge of health and safety regulations in Neko’s global markets.

  • Experience building a health and safety function as a business scales from a few sites to many.

  • Experience selecting and implementing systems to manage health and safety at scale

raw.description:
Mission

Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear.

In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives.

Role Purpose

Most companies treat support as a queue to clear. We think it can be the warmest, most memorable part of the whole experience.

Neko Health is building a new kind of healthcare: proactive, human, and built around the member. In the US, that promise is about to meet thousands of new members, and the care behind every call, text, email, and message has to feel like hospitality at its best. Right now, that team is yet to be scaled, and you would help build it.

As a Member Care Lead, you will work with a team of peers to lead a high-performing, hospitality-led support organisation across email, phone, SMS, and social. You will guide frontline Agents, and you will work alongside Workforce Planning, Quality, Training, and Tooling colleagues to make great service consistent. You will partner closely with Clinics, Operations, Product, and Marketing, and stay hands-on where it matters most: complex escalations, high-visibility social moments, and coaching by example. All of it serves one common goal: to reinforce the Neko brand in everything we do and to exceed expectations every time.

You will help build a culture grounded in trust, accountability, and open communication, where every member interaction reflects Neko’s commitment to proactive, human-centred care. You will use data, automation, and AI to make that service faster and sharper, without losing the human touch at its heart.

We are scaling aggressively, and this is the moment to get it right. If you want to build something extraordinary, something members talk about long after the conversation ends, this is the role.

What You’ll Do

  • Work with your peers to scale a high-performing US customer care function, with measurable improvements in SLA, CSAT/NPS, QA scores, and first-contact resolution. (Member-first, always)

  • Work with Workforce Planning to help forecast demand and optimise rotas, so staffing supports clinic operations and demand variability. (Tech-enabled, human-centred)

  • Collaborate on scalable SOPs, escalation frameworks, and service playbooks that simplify operations while protecting trust and speed. (Hard truths, high hopes)

  • Partner with colleagues across the business to reduce avoidable contacts, give members greater clarity, and raise support efficiency. (Chase 10X, not 10%)

  • Strengthen alignment with Clinics, Operations, Product, and Marketing so member communication is consistent and service delivery is seamless. (Impact, not activity)

  • Help build Voice-of-Member feedback loops that inform product development, operational improvements, and training priorities. (Optimistic truth-seeking)

  • Stay selectively hands-on with complex escalations, public-facing social care, and coaching, setting the standard by example.

Minimum Requirements

  • 3 to 5+ years’ experience in customer or member support within high-touch or service-intensive environments.

  • 2+ years leading multiple frontline support teams.

  • Proven success improving multi-channel support operations (email, phone, SMS, social), with measurable impact on SLA, QA, CSAT/NPS, and FCR.

  • Strong experience working with workforce planning teams on forecasting, rota design, and intraday operations management.

  • Demonstrated ability to lead people, build team culture, and develop future leaders through coaching and feedback.

  • Strong operational and analytical skills, with the ability to turn performance data into actionable improvements.

  • Excellent judgement in sensitive member situations, public-facing social care, and complex escalations.

  • Deep familiarity with support platforms such as Zendesk (or equivalent), including reporting, tagging, macros, and workflow optimisation.

  • A calm, organised, and decisive approach in fast-paced, high-visibility environments.


Preferred

  • Experience in healthcare, health tech, wellness, or other sensitive service environments.

  • Experience supporting clinic, field, or distributed operational teams.

  • Background in hospitality-led or premium service environments.

  • Experience contributing to QA frameworks, escalation playbooks, or Help Center and self-serve content strategies.

  • Exposure to automation, CX tooling optimisation, or AI-supported customer service.

Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear.

Role Purpose

Neko Health is looking for a Workday Integration Specialist to own the design, build, and maintenance of integrations between Workday and our wider systems landscape (TA, Reward, Payroll, Absence, Finance, and third-party tools). You'll work alongside the People Technology and module teams to keep data flowing accurately and securely across the platform and help extend Workday's capabilities beyond its native functionality.

What you'll do in the first 6-12 Months

  • Design, build, and support Workday integrations using EIB, Core Connectors, Studio, and Workday APIs (SOAP/REST)

  • Develop and maintain custom reports via RaaS (Report-as-a-Service) to serve downstream systems and stakeholders

  • Build and extend business processes using Workday Extend to digitise offline or manual processes

  • Troubleshoot integration failures, including security/permission issues, data mapping errors, and connectivity problems

  • Manage integration security: ISU setup, OAuth scopes, domain security policies, and API client configuration

  • Partner with module teams (HCM, Absence, Compensation) and system owners (Finance, IT, Workforce Management) to gather integration requirements

  • Maintain integration documentation, including field mappings and process flows

  • Support data migration validation and spot-check processes for ongoing data loads

  • Monitor integration health and proactively flag/resolve recurring errors

Minimum Requirements

  • Hands-on experience building Workday HCM integrations using EIB, Connectors, and Studio

  • Working knowledge of Workday RaaS and calculated fields

  • Experience with Workday Extend (building or supporting custom applications)

  • Understanding of Workday security model (domains, business processes, ISUs, OAuth)

  • API integration experience (REST/SOAP), including troubleshooting auth and permission errors

  • Comfortable working across HR, Finance, and IT stakeholder groups

Nice to Have

  • Experience integrating Workday with ATS (e.g. Ashby), payroll (ADP), Microsoft Entra, benefits platforms (Thanksben)

  • Exposure to Workday Studio advanced transformations (XSLT)

  • Experience with data migration projects (e.g. legacy HRIS to Workday)

  • Workday Pro certification in Integrations or Extend

Why this Role

You'll join at a live, post-go-live stage of Workday's evolution at Neko Health, meaning your work has immediate visibility and impact, not years of legacy debt to untangle first.

raw.description:
Join Neudata - Research Analyst

Introducing Neudata:

Neudata is the global leader in alternative and market data intelligence, helping investors, hedge funds and corporates discover, evaluate, and use data to make smarter decisions. Our independence is what really sets us apart - we provide objective, unbiased intelligence that our clients trust and depend on.

Neudata’s research team is at the core of what we do. Clients of Neudata have access to:

  • Our research portal, allowing them to browse our catalogue of dataset reports, each of which is written by a member of the research team and pertaining to a dataset (e.g. short positions data by vendor X)

  • Our research team’s expertise, allowing us to help them make informed data decisions (e.g. through calls where we share our opinion on the most appropriate dataset for their needs)

The Role:

Our expertise lies in the vast world of alternative data, spanning everything from social sentiment feeds and credit card transactions to complex ESG signals. As a Research Analyst, you will join the team dedicated to Scout, our premier platform for alternative data discovery. You will be largely interacting with:

  • Data buyers, by communicating our findings via research reports and calls, and

  • Data sellers, to understand their properties and potential use cases of different datasets

Your work will centre on translating complex, non-traditional datasets into actionable intelligence in a highly collaborative and inquisitive role that requires a blend of analytical thinking and clear, authoritative communication.

Your Key Responsibilities:

  • Conducting in-depth research on alternative data providers and datasets

  • Writing research reports on alternative datasets and industry trends

  • Interacting with our client base (data buyers and data sellers), primarily through research calls and emails

  • Gathering industry intelligence via effective relationships built through our reputation in the industry

  • We highly encourage our Research Analysts to exercise independent thought and critical thinking, and believe this to be one of the most appealing aspects of the role

What You’ll Bring:

  • Enthusiasm for data and understand its impact to users in various industries, particularly the financial sector

  • Strong written and communication skills, enjoy relationship building and have an inquisitive mindset

  • You want to become an industry expert in alternative data and have an eagerness to help discover new, under the radar datasets

  • Knowledge of the investment management industry/alternative data market is a plus, but not a necessity

  • You do not require advanced knowledge or experience in data science - this isn’t a data science role

Our Benefits & Perks:

  • 25 days' annual leave + bank holidays, plus an extra day for each year of service (up to 30 days), alongside one paid volunteering day and two paid study days per year 📅

  • Hybrid and flexible working, including working from anywhere for up to 10 working days per year from a location of your choosing 🌍

  • Private medical insurance via Vitality (including dental, optical, and hearing) ✚

  • Enhanced maternity, paternity, adoption and shared parental policies 🏠

  • Enhanced pension scheme via NEST 📈

  • Employee referral bonus of £1,000 per successful new hire you refer 💸

Key Details:

  • Location: London (Moorgate)

  • Start Date: ASAP

Recruitment Process:

  1. Initial screening call with our Talent Acquisition Manager

  2. Competency interview with our Head of Research

  3. Written task and meetings with Team Leads

  4. Final stage interview & presentation

Candidates who may require visa sponsorship should discuss this with the hiring manager during the interview process. Further information on Skilled Worker sponsorship can be found here.

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, and shortlisted candidates will be invited to an initial screening call with our Talent Acquisition Manager.

About Niantic Spatial

AI has learned from almost everything online, but it still struggles with the physical world, where 99.5% of economic activity happens. It doesn’t know where things are, how spaces fit together, or what changes over time.

That’s one of the biggest unsolved problems in AI, and it’s the one we’re solving at Niantic Spatial. We build spatial AI models and services so people and machines can reason, learn and act safely in the physical world. We turn camera imagery, video, sensor data and archives into accurate, AI-readable representations of real places that robots can train in and machines can use to know exactly where they are.

In physical AI, mistakes have real consequences. That’s why we build AI grounded in measured reality, not guesswork, so the people and machines relying on it can trust it to get things right.

Our team built some of the world’s most widely used maps. Now we’re building something bigger: a living, measured record of the real world that machines can query, learn from and use to understand how places change over time. If you want to help AI understand the world we actually live in, come build with us.

About the Role

You'll help build the geometric foundation of the next-generation world map — joining our World Map Research Engineering team (Geospatial Alignment) as a Research Engineer or Senior Research Engineer. This is an end-to-end applied research role that spans from strong engineering and data-systems work to R&D in 3D deep learning, transformers, and foundation models. You'll develop new algorithms, produce the research data and evaluation assets needed to advance them, and engineer the resulting capabilities into dependable production systems.

The World Map team works with heterogeneous captures from phones and handheld devices, aerial imagery, LiDAR, and 360 cameras, as well as external geographic and elevation data. The central challenge is to harmonize these data sources, quantify uncertainty, and maintain consistency as the map evolves.

You'll work at the intersection of cutting-edge research and scalable engineering — developing new approaches to geospatial registration, correspondence, and geometric optimization, then productionizing these technologies to directly improve Niantic Spatial's world model.

What You'll Do

  • Geospatial Registration — Develop and advance algorithms for world-scale georeferencing and registration across imagery, 3D reconstructions, point clouds, and geographic reference data.

  • 3D Geometry & Correspondence — Build and improve methods spanning multi-view geometry, SfM, SLAM, feature matching, learned correspondence, bundle adjustment, point-cloud registration, and ICP.

  • Data & Evaluation — Create the data and evaluation flywheel for world-scale mapping — design and maintain large-scale datasets, pipelines, benchmarks, and evaluation methodologies that expose hard failure modes, accelerate research iteration, and support production.

  • Learning-Based 3D Reasoning — Explore and develop learning-based approaches for geospatial understanding, combining transformers and 3D foundation models with geometric priors and uncertainty modeling.

  • Production Robustness — Design robust solutions for challenging real-world conditions: sparse or noisy GPS, changing appearance, inconsistent reconstruction quality, large geographic extents, and imperfect reference maps.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration — Partner with leading researchers in visual localization, 3D computer vision, and mapping — as well as engineering and product teams — to identify high-impact problems and turn research breakthroughs into end-to-end production systems.

  • Research Communication — Share results clearly through technical writing, design reviews, and internal presentations; contribute to publications and open research where appropriate.

What You'll Bring

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Robotics, Machine Learning, Photogrammetry, or a closely related field — or equivalent research or industry experience.

  • Strong grounding in 3D computer vision, machine learning, robotics, photogrammetry, or a closely related area.

  • Demonstrated experience with 3D geometry and several relevant areas — multi-view reconstruction, SfM, SLAM, camera pose estimation, point-cloud registration, image-based localization, georeferencing, or sensor fusion.

  • The ability to formulate ambiguous real-world problems, choose the right mathematical or learning-based tools, and evaluate solutions rigorously.

  • Strong Python skills and experience with modern ML and scientific-computing libraries (PyTorch, NumPy, SciPy).

  • Strong software engineering skills — you can turn research prototypes into reliable, scalable, and maintainable systems.

  • A track record of taking an algorithm from research idea and experimental prototype through evaluation, benchmarking, and deployment on real-world data.

  • Clear written and verbal communication; able to collaborate effectively across research and engineering disciplines.

Nice to Have

  • PhD in computer vision, robotics, machine learning, photogrammetry, geodesy, remote sensing, or a related field — not required, but valued.

  • A strong publication record or active involvement in the research community at venues such as CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, NeurIPS, ICLR, SIGGRAPH, 3DV, ICRA, or RSS.

  • Experience with learning-based approaches for visual or 3D understanding — transformers, point transformers, foundation models, or methods combining learned representations with explicit geometric priors.

  • Experience with aerial or satellite imagery, GNSS/GPS, geodesy, mapping systems, or large-scale spatial data.

  • Evidence of technical leadership, mentorship, or successful cross-functional delivery.

Compensation & Benefits

Base salary: Competitive market rate. Compensation also includes an annual bonus, equity, and a comprehensive benefits package.

Location & Work Model

This role is based in our London office, with three days per week in office. We welcome applications from candidates who require visa sponsorship.

Inclusive Application

We know the strongest candidates don't always tick every box. If you're excited about this role and believe you could do it well, we encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't match every qualification listed — you may be exactly who we're looking for.

Equal Opportunity

Niantic Spatial is an equal opportunity employer. Individuals seeking employment at Niantic Spatial are considered without regard to race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, creed, age, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding or related medical conditions), marital status, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, military or veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, or any other protected category under applicable laws. Niantic Spatial will also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in accordance with applicable laws. Please contact your recruiter if you want to request an accommodation for the job application or interview process.

Candidate Privacy

I understand that by submitting my job application, the information I provide as part of that application will be used in accordance with Niantic Spatial's Privacy Notice for Job Applicants and Candidates https://www.nianticspatial.com/applicant-privacy-notice.

raw.description:
Building on more than 30 years of business expertise, Objectway is an international wealth, banking and asset management software provider empowering clients to embrace their future challenges while providing great performance today. The Group is a future-proof technology player with a well-established track record in the financial services industry and over €100 million of consolidated revenue. The Group is a global Top 100 fintech provider (IDC ranking), whose clients include 200+ leading Wealth Managers, Banks, Asset Managers, Fund Managers, Insurers and Outsourcers in more than 15 countries. With over 800 professionals operating from Italy, UK, Belgium, Germany, Switzerland and Ireland, the Group serves clients in 4 continents, supporting approximately 100,000 investment professionals to manage more than €1 trillion in assets.


To strengthen our team in the UK (London or Birmingham) we are currently looking for a:

PRODUCT OWNER

 


Main responsibilities:
In the role of Product Owner, you will:
•    Work closely together with our implementation consultants in documenting, deploying and configuring our solution both internally and on customer sites. This may be for both green field implementations or upgrades.
•    Fulfil the role of product consultant/SME in order to support customer implementations and to support the internal engineering team.
•    Translate customer business requirements into product specifications detailing enhancements and extensions to our product.
•    Conduct analysis and gather requirements for new product features/functionality in order to extend the core product.
•    Monitor and be aware of regulatory changes which may impact our product and customers.
•    Manage the backlog and define user stories.
•    Be responsible for and participate in the full development process from requirements gathering, analysis and development to testing and documentation.
•    Participate in pre-sales activities including responding to RFIs, conducting pre-sales demos and presentations.
•    Work together with our development and quality assurance team members in order to deliver high quality software, on time and within budget.
•    Represent the company being a key point of contact in relation with customers.
•    Organize and participate in regular customer status meetings.
•    Handle customer calls and incidents in collaboration with involved parties.
•    Monitor customer adoption and satisfaction and report on it to the management.

Requirements:

•    Degree in (Business) Economics or IT, or equivalent through experience.
•    Strong ability to abstract and to translate business requirements in IT.
•    At least 5 years’ experience within the wealth/asset management sector with at least one of the following: creation of functional analyses based upon a high-level scope definition; application(s) with a 3-tier development structure. 
•    Experience in managing projects focused on digital solutions, processes and/or digital products.
•    Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.

The candidate should have strong knowledge or experience in at least 6 of the following back-office areas:
•    Client Management & Portfolio Accounts.
•    Costs and Charges.
•    UK & Overseas Settlements.
•    Custody & Reconciliations.
•    Cash Management & Reconciliations.
•    Corporate Actions. 
•    Dividends.
•    Stock Transfers.
•    Finance / Accounting.
•    Client Reporting.
•    Service Fees.
•    UK Regulatory Reporting.
•    UK Tax Reporting.


Personal Profile:
Passion for quality, you use high standards and you aim to achieve them
•    Team player, flexible, accurate, hands-on mentality
•    Leadership skills, enthusiasm, pride and a "can-do" attitude
•    Excellent time management and organization, deadline focused
•    Strong communication & collaboration skills
•    Open to travel both within the UK and on occasion, outside your home country when required.
What we offer:
  • Permanent Employment
  • A challenging and progressive position within an international work environment
 

Equality Policy: 
We are an equal opportunities employer and we welcome applications from all suitably skilled or qualified applicants, regardless of their race, sex, disability, religion/beliefs, sexual orientation or age.

raw.title: AI Transformation Strategist
raw.description:
Our Mission:

Omnea is the agentic operating system for procurement.

Procurement touches every pound a business spends, yet requests still stall for weeks and approvals get lost in inboxes. Our AI-first platform changes that: our agents capture requests, route approvals, onboard suppliers, flag risk and track every renewal, while anyone in the business can ask a question and get an answer grounded in their own company’s data. Buying becomes painless for everyone, procurement gets a seat at the table, and our customers have saved more than 100,000 hours of manual work so far.

Companies like Spotify, PayPal, T. Rowe Price, JustEat, Adyen and S&P Global run procurement on Omnea. We’re backed by $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners and Accel, and we’ve been named the UK’s number one startup in the Startups 100, ranked 11th on Sifted’s 2026 list of Europe’s fastest-growing companies, and recognised as one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies.

Talent density matters more to us than almost anything else. We keep the bar high in every team, so everyone here has real ownership and real impact. Our team is full of former founders and operators who’ve scaled unicorns, and we’re looking for people who want to do the best work of their careers alongside them.

Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here.

The Role

As an AI Transformation Strategist, you'll work directly with our most strategic customers to understand their objectives and key challenges, identify high-impact AI opportunities, and translate them into measurable business value.

You'll be building AI solutions on Omnea's procurement automation platform, combining the structured data flowing through requests, approvals, contracts, and supplier records with AI. Omnea gives AI the operational context of how a business actually buys, so it can move past answering questions and start taking action inside procurement itself: routing requests, flagging risk, drafting contract terms, negotiating with suppliers. There is no AI without that context.

You'll prototype these solutions, demonstrate their value to executives, and ensure successful implementation, adoption, and value realisation, growing Omnea's footprint at those customers as you go.

This customer-facing role is ideal for people who enjoy working directly with customers and turning complex business challenges into practical AI solutions. The focus is on problem framing, solution design, and business impact rather than pure implementation. While you will prototype AI solutions, the primary goal is to deliver meaningful business value to customers.

What You'll Do

  • Identify High-Impact AI Opportunities: Work closely with enterprise customers to understand their strategic priorities and operational challenges, identifying where AI can deliver measurable business value.

  • Design AI-Powered Solutions: Translate complex business problems into scalable solution architectures, using Omnea's AI to eliminate manual work across procurement.

  • Prototype and Demonstrate Value: Rapidly build prototypes and proof-of-value solutions that demonstrate tangible outcomes to business and technical stakeholders.

  • Lead AI Innovation with Customers: Facilitate workshops, hackathons, and innovation sessions with customers to explore new ways AI can transform their operations.

  • Drive Adoption and Business Impact: Partner with customer teams to ensure successful implementation, adoption, and realisation of measurable value from AI deployments.

  • Develop Domain Expertise: Build deep expertise in specific industries or business domains (e.g., supply chain, finance) and help scale that knowledge across the organisation.

What's Different About This Role

  • You'll spend more time on problem framing and validation than on hand-building every proof of value. AI can generate a working prototype fast; your job is deciding whether it actually solves the customer's problem.

  • Writing a sharp brief for what you want AI to build is now core to the role, not a side skill.

  • Judgment on business impact matters more than raw build speed: which use case actually moves the metric the customer cares about, and which is just an impressive demo.

  • You'll keep pushing on what's possible as Omnea's AI tooling evolves, and bring what you learn back to the rest of the team.

About You

You might be a great fit if you…

  • 3+ years in transformation, strategy or operations work, ideally where AI or automation was part of the answer

  • You take a messy business problem, form a hypothesis fast, and turn it into something that can actually be built

  • You’re comfortable in front of a CFO or COO, whether that’s working through a problem on a whiteboard or presenting a formal readout

  • You know how to measure the business impact of what you've delivered (pre- and post-delivery), and can turn that into a clear story for stakeholders - time saved, error rates down, adoption up, whatever the metric that actually matters to that customer

  • You’d rather be accountable for the outcome than hand over the recommendation and move on

  • Experience at a top-tier strategy consultancy is a big plus, though not required

At Omnea, we embrace diversity. To build a product that's loved by everyone, we're best served by a team with all sorts of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't quite match the full job spec! And regardless of your race, religion, colour, gender, or anything else! If you think you could be a good fit for Omnea, please reach out.

A few things to note:

  • We offer competitive geo-localised benefits, and you can check out our UK Benefits Package here and our US Benefits Package here.

  • We work Tuesdays, Wednesdays & Thursdays in-person at our offices. At this early stage of our company life-cycle it's important to us that we get this together-time, and you can read more about why we believe this is a winning move here

  • We're commercial, ambitious and we don't pretend otherwise! We're actively seeking folks looking to make the most of a career-defining opportunity, with the hunger to be part of building something really impressive. You can see our values here and our Omnea Future Founder's fund here!

  • We sometimes use AI note-takers to help us transcribe interview notes, so we can be more present in your interview. If you'd like to opt out of us using automatic transcribers, please note this in the free text field in your application, otherwise we'll take your application as confirmation that you're happy for us to use notetakers (whether added to video calls or in the background).

We are proud to be recognised for both our culture and product, and we are just getting started. Join us as we grow!

Our team is full of former founders and operators who’ve scaled unicorns, and we’re looking for people who want to do the best work of their careers alongside them.

Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here.

What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for highly technical engineers who want to lead and manage one of our engineering teams. It took over 10,000 interviews to hire our first 50 Omneans, and we’re now growing from 11 to more than 14 engineering teams in the coming months. Over the next year, our engineering team will double in size, our enterprise customer base will grow from ~180 to 300+, and revenue will triple.

 

As a Team Lead Manager, you’ll lead a small team of engineers. You’ll set its technical direction, line-manage and grow the people in it, and stay hands-on in the code. This is not a hands-off management role: our teams are small, and you’ll be one of the strongest engineers on yours. You’ll partner closely with a Product Manager and Product Designer to decide what to build, and you’ll be accountable for how well it’s built and how fast it ships.

 

If you’re a strong Tech Lead who hasn’t managed people yet, we’d still love to hear from you. You can start as a Team Lead, with management handled by an Engineering Manager, and grow into the full role with our support.

 

What Can You Expect As a Team Lead Manager?

  • Lead and Manage a Small Team. Line-manage the engineers on your team, run 1:1s, give feedback, and help them take on bigger problems.

  • Stay Deeply Technical. You’ll still build. Expect to spend a meaningful share of your time writing code, reviewing PRs, and unblocking the hardest technical problems.

  • AI-Native Development. AI is core to how we build. Engineers use Claude, Code, and agentic workflows every day, and our product is built on AI agents that automate complex procurement workflows. You’ll set the bar for how your team uses them.

  • Customers at the Center. Talk directly with customers to understand their problems, and make sure your team builds things that create real value for them.

  • Own Technical Direction. Make the architecture and design calls for your team’s problem space, and own the trade-offs between speed, quality, and long-term maintainability.

  • Work with Modern Technology. TypeScript across the stack, React, Postgres, and AWS serverless (Lambda, DynamoDB, EventBridge), managed through Pulumi and deployed via GitHub Actions. Datadog, Meticulous, and Incident.io round it out.

  • Shape the Roadmap. Work with your PM and Designer on prioritisation, scoping, and sequencing so the team ships what matters most.

  • Build the Team. Interview, hire, and onboard new engineers as we double in size.

 

About You

  • You’re a highly technical full-stack engineer. You’ve designed and shipped web apps end to end in TypeScript, ideally on AWS serverless, and you’re still one of the strongest engineers in the room.

  • You’ve led engineers. You’ve been a Tech Lead, Team Lead, or TLM, owning delivery and technical direction for a team.

  • You want to manage people, or grow into it. Ideally, you’ve line-managed engineers already. If not, you’re keen to learn.

  • You still love to build. Leading hasn’t pulled you away from the code, and you want a role where you keep shipping.

  • You raise the bar. You know what well-architected, reliable software looks like, and you help others get there through reviews, pairing, and clear feedback.

  • You’re motivated by customer impact. You care about outcomes for customers, not just output, and you make good calls on what to build and what to cut.

  • You’re a strong partner. You work well with product and design, push back when it matters, and bring people with you.

  • You’re comfortable with ambiguity. You can take an unclear problem, shape it, and get a team moving on it.

 

Nice-to-Haves

  • You’ve led a team through fast growth, ideally at a scale-up where the team and product changed quickly.

  • You’ve built B2B or enterprise SaaS, with complex workflows and demanding customers.

  • You’ve performed exceptionally at something else, be it academics, sport, or work.

 

Interview Process

Before applying, we strongly encourage you to spend a few minutes in our R&D Candidate Hub. It covers our engineering culture, ways of working, interview process, tech environment, and what it’s like to build at Omnea.

 

R&D Candidate Hub: https://omnea.notion.site/R-D-Candidate-Hub-2f688cce658780f1b942c81cd3a032d4

 

Note: our pair programming stage is in TypeScript OR Python and you’ll be assessed as if it’s your primary language. This is a full-stack, hands-on leadership role, so if you’re exclusively frontend, backend, or platform-focused, or no longer writing code, it likely isn’t the right fit.

 

The process generally includes:

 

  1. Initial screening call with our Talent team (30 mins, remote)

  2. AI Product Eng Challenge, language-agnostic (1 hour, remote)

  3. Onsite interviews at our Victoria office (~3 hours)

     

    • Engineering Culture interview with an Engineering Manager or Team Lead (45 mins)

    • System Design interview with a Senior Engineer (60 mins)

    • Engineering Leadership interview with our CTO (45 mins)

    • Office tour (15 mins)

 

We’re proud to support visa sponsorship for candidates who need it.

raw.description:
About the Team

OpenAI's Legal team plays a crucial role in furthering OpenAI's mission by tackling innovative, fundamental legal issues in AI. If you're passionate about doing significant and unique work as a technology lawyer, this team is for you. The team comprises professionals from diverse fields, including technology, AI, privacy, IP, commercial, corporate, employment, tax law, regulatory, and litigation.

About the Role

We’re seeking an experienced lawyer to join OpenAI’s EU Policy/Regulatory Legal team. You will own assigned legal matters and workstreams concerning EU and UK AI and digital regulation, prepare practical legal advice, and support engagements with the EU AI Office, other regulators and policymakers. Working with our Associate General Counsel, EU Policy/Regulatory, you will assess regulatory developments, develop legal recommendations and help translate them into action across OpenAI’s products and operations.

We’re looking for a hands-on lawyer who can work independently, exercise sound judgment in unfamiliar areas, manage competing priorities and collaborate effectively across teams. You should be comfortable taking responsibility for your work while identifying material risks and knowing when to escalate. This individual-contributor role reports to our Associate General Counsel, EU Policy/Regulatory.

In this role, you will:

  • Prepare for and participate in OpenAI’s EU and UK engagements with the European Commission, EU member states, other EU institutions, national regulators and policymakers, including briefing materials and follow-up actions.

  • Advise on the interpretation and application of existing and emerging AI, digital and technology regulation, and translate complex regulatory requirements into practical legal and business guidance.

  • Assess regulatory developments, enforcement risks and policy proposals, and develop legal recommendations for the AGC on their implications for OpenAI’s products and operations.

  • Work with US and EU legal colleagues to deliver coordinated advice and progress assigned cross-border matters.

  • Partner with Global Affairs, policy and regulatory affairs colleagues to draft legal input into policy positions, consultation responses, regulatory guidance, codes of practice and industry standards.

  • Own assigned workstreams for regulatory inquiries, investigations and supervisory engagements, including drafting responses, coordinating factual inputs and escalating material issues to the AGC.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • 10+ years of legal experience.

  • Law degree (JD, LL.B., or equivalent) and qualification to practice law in at least one relevant jurisdiction.

  • Experience advising on EU or UK technology regulatory matters and independently managing legal workstreams.

  • Relevant in-house, law firm and/or government or institutional legal experience.

  • Experience analyzing complex legislation and regulations, including technology laws such as the EU AI Act, Data Act, Digital Services Act, Online Safety Act, GDPR or Digital Markets Act, and the ability to develop expertise in new frameworks.

  • Familiarity with EU legislative and regulatory processes and the respective roles of EU institutions and national authorities.

  • Experience preparing for or participating in engagements with European regulators or policymakers, including drafting clear, accurate submissions and briefing materials.

  • Ability to produce clear and concise writing, distilling complex concepts into simple, explainable, and persuasive ideas.

  • Ability to work independently on assigned matters, exercise sound judgment and recognize when to escalate material risks or seek specialist input.

  • Ability to move between legal analysis, regulatory strategy and practical implementation, and to identify the issues that matter most to the business.

  • Ability to manage competing deadlines, coordinate contributions from other teams and take matters through to delivery.

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to give practical advice and influence colleagues without relying on managerial authority.

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. raw.description:
About the Team

The Privacy Engineering team builds secure, reliable systems that help OpenAI meet its legal obligations while protecting user data. We partner closely with Legal and Engineering teams across OpenAI to support lawful data access requests and other critical legal workflows. Our work turns complex, high-stakes processes into auditable and dependable technical systems with clear human oversight and strong privacy and security controls.

About the Role

We’re looking for a full-stack Software Engineer to build the internal tools and data pipelines that power lawful data access request workflows and Legal Operations. You will work across product and data systems to make authorized retrieval and case handling accurate, efficient, and auditable. This role is well suited to someone who enjoys translating ambiguous operational requirements into durable systems, cares deeply about sensitive-data handling, and wants to improve both technical reliability and the day-to-day experience of the people operating these workflows.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA, with two additional locations under consideration: London, UK, and Dublin, Ireland. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will:

  • Design, build, and operate backend systems and workflow tooling for the full lifecycle of lawful data access requests, from intake and scoping through authorized retrieval, review, preparation, and audit.

  • Build reliable data pipelines and interfaces across products and data stores so authorized teams can locate and handle the right records accurately and reproducibly.

  • Implement least-privilege access, approval gates, provenance, audit trails, data minimization, and safe failure modes for sensitive workflows.

  • Partner with Legal and Legal Operations to translate legal and operational requirements into clear technical designs and intuitive operator experiences.

  • Identify responsible automation opportunities that reduce repetitive work while preserving human review, judgment, and accountability.

  • Own production systems through testing, observability, incident response, documentation, and continuous reliability improvements.

  • Help define the architecture and roadmap for reusable privacy and legal-infrastructure foundations as OpenAI’s products and obligations evolve.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Have experience building or operating systems for lawful data access requests and understand the domain’s legal-process lifecycle, privacy and security constraints, auditability requirements, and operational sensitivities.

  • Strong backend engineering fundamentals and experience building production services or data-intensive systems.

  • Ability to reason carefully about correctness, authorization, security, and privacy when working with sensitive data.

  • A track record of turning ambiguous requirements into pragmatic plans and communicating technical tradeoffs clearly.

  • End-to-end ownership, including operating what you build, and comfort learning unfamiliar products and domains.

  • Care for operator experience and a drive to make complex workflows safer, clearer, and more efficient.

raw.title: Business Value Architect (Hybrid London)
raw.description:
Who We Are

Having surpassed $300M ARR and continuing to grow, Optro helps enterprises transform risk into opportunity through its AI-powered GRC Intelligence Platform. More than 50% of the Fortune 500, including 7 of the Fortune 10, leverage our award-winning technology to move their businesses forward with greater clarity and agility. And our customers love us: Optro is top-rated on G2.com and Gartner Peer Insights.

At Optro, we inspire each other to innovate and are proud of what we are producing. We spend each day thinking of new ways to help our customers and contribute to the greater good of our company and our surrounding communities. We are all about assisting each other and breaking through barriers to create the most loved audit, risk, ESG, and InfoSec platform by our customers. This is how we have become one of the 500 fastest-growing tech companies in North America for the seventh year in a row, as ranked by Deloitte!

Business Value Architect

Optro is looking for a creative and passionate individual who can help define strategy, conduct business value analysis, and deliver presentations identifying and articulating the value of Optro to our top strategic customers and prospects.

The role of Business Value Architect is a critical client-facing role. Our Value Architects are aligned with the go-to-market organization. You will work closely with our Sales, Sales Engineering, Customer Success and Product Marketing teams on our most strategic customer accounts. You will develop and present compelling value proposition assessments + business cases, and work with sales / customer success to track value realization in support of Optro’s largest, most strategic customers.

Key Responsibilities

  • Engaging onsite and remotely with clients to perform business value assessments of Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC) across audit operations processes and tools.

  • Deliver Value Assessments and Value Realization services for select customers/prospects by documenting gap analysis of clients’ current versus desired state, identifying specific opportunities for improvement leveraging Optros’ capabilities. Assessments should include Product ROI and TCO considerations such as:

    • Objective Gathering. Partner with the customer/prospect and AE/SE/CSM to understand the strategic initiatives within the company, and how that translates to the work of the functional areas Revenue Acceleration will impact.

    • Strategy Development. Define the areas of impact, and specify the technology, personnel, and conversational experiences required to maximize impact.

    • Performance Analysis. Translate the strategy into a forecast of measurable return on investment and total cost of ownership. Specify the value drivers and their distinct impact on the business.

  • Use in-depth business, technical, and financial analyses to understand the baseline and future capabilities of the client; as part of this analysis, align client strategic business and technical objectives with the required capabilities which Optro provides.

  • Evangelize the value stories and outcomes that Optro drives for our clients, and help develop assets the entire organization can use to support effective solution selling.

    • This includes partnership with sales enablement and product marketing, as well as the teams in sales, onboarding, customer success and account management.

  • Assist with developing value messaging associated with targeted opportunities

  • Validate messaging is aligned with customer value themes (partner with product marketing management)

  • Craft reusable assets to help scale the team's reach across the greater Optro organization

  • Play an active role in the evolution of Optro’s business value architect team and methodology. We expect team members, whether individual contributors or leadership, to take a hands-on role in the continuous improvement of this best-in-class Value Practice; specifically help lead and build Value Selling and Realization processes, templates, and tools.

  • Provide tactical support for targeted opportunities

  • Manage library of assets include items such as spreadsheets, presentation templates, case examples, and customer stories

  • Travel required up to 40%

Attributes for a Successful Candidate

  • 3-5+ years of experience in value consulting, value engineering or other applicable roles.

  • Proven ability to collaborate with and successfully influencing leaders to invest.

  • Strong verbal and written communication of qualitative and quantitative business cases.

  • Innate curiosity to investigate business processes and evaluate the possibility of new business models.

  • Consultative personality to effectively facilitate interview sessions with a wide-ranging set of stakeholders; proven ability to communicate complex enterprise technology in simple terms and tailor a message to a variety of audiences.

  • Strong facilitation skills, to encourage clear articulation of the business issues and effective solution design by the relevant players.

  • Executive presence and advanced presentation skills. Individuals must be comfortable influencing and collaborating in a C-level environment.

  • Experience with enterprise cloud solutions, particularly in the GRC / audit space.

  • (Bonus) Deep experience in financial analysis and modeling of ROI and TCO concepts to justify business cases.

*perks may vary based on eligibility/location

Our Company Values

  • Customer obsession: It starts and ends here. Consistently ask yourself how what you’re doing creates value for our customers. It’s a mindset.

  • Gritty resilience: Make it happen. Find a way. Move fast, stay positive, and do what it takes.

  • Drive innovation: Create the future. Continuously improve what exists and invent what’s next.

  • Win, together: One team. No silos, no egos. Drive to be the best and support each other’s success.

  • Growth mindset: 10x, not 10%. Think in orders of magnitude, not increments. Seek feedback, learn, and improve.


Please note that background checks are required. Qualified Applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for Employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. This role may have access to highly sensitive data, including employee data, customer data, company financials, and proprietary product information.

We love building strong partnerships, but please note that Optro cannot accept unsolicited resumes from agencies. Any submissions without a signed agreement in place will not create a fee obligation.

You’ll work in a close-knit pod with our EMEA Sales team, sharing priorities, planning programs around target accounts, and partnering on follow-through.   • Experience as the first regional marketer or helping a US-based company establish its EMEA marketing presence.
