raw.title: Member of Scientific Staff, Protein Production
raw.description:
LOCATION: King's Cross, London · PATTERN: Lab-based, full-time

The opportunity

We're a stealth startup in AI and bio, building infrastructure for data generation. The team is small and elite, the problems are hard, and the foundations are being laid right now. You'd help write them from the first line, with real ownership and a direct line to the founders.

This role sits at the start of our protein work. Every measurement we make depends on the protein in the well being the right one, made the same way every time, and you would be one of the people making it.

About us

AI for biology has a data problem. The data that matters most doesn't exist yet, so we're

building the infrastructure to produce it, with quality and traceability built in from day one.

We're in stealth and heads-down on execution. We'll share more about what we're building once you've spoken with the team.

The role

You will make proteins, many of them at once. The work runs from DNA through to purified, quality-checked protein in 96-well format, ready for the binding and biophysical assays downstream of you.

On the DNA side you will prepare expression templates from synthetic gene fragments, by PCR and by Golden Gate or Gibson assembly, and check them before they go forward. You will express proteins in cell-free systems first, with E. coli and mammalian (HEK293) expression following as the menu grows. You will purify them by affinity capture, mostly on magnetic beads in plates, and confirm what you made with quantification, CE-SDS and SEC.

Every step is recorded as you go: what went in, which lot, which conditions, what came out, and what failed. Failed expressions and poor yields are kept as data, so they get the same care as the successes.

As protocols settle you will help move them from the bench onto liquid handlers and our automated platform, working with the engineers who build it. This is a hands-on bench role, and in a small team you will also support the work either side of production when it needs doing. Downstream, that means molecular characterisation runs. Alongside, it means the cell culture behind our cell-based assays, from routine passage and banking to seeding assay plates.

Your first 90 days

FIRST 30 DAYS

◆ Run our core DNA preparation, cell-free expression and purification protocols to a

consistent standard.

◆ Learn how a sample is tracked, from DNA order to purified protein, and what gets

recorded at each step.

DAYS 30 TO 60

◆ Take a full plate of constructs from DNA through expression, purification and QC with

minimal support.

◆ Support on one step beyond production, such as a downstream characterisation

readout, a mammalian expression run or routine culture for the cell-based assay panel.

◆ Revise one protocol, including how its failures are captured.

DAYS 60 TO 90

◆ Run production week to week as part of the team, with QC results others can rely on

without checking.

◆ Own and routinely execute a downstream characterisation readout, a mammalian

expression route or maintenance of cell lines for a cell-based assay.

Who you are

You are a hands-on protein scientist who likes the bench and cares about doing the same thing well many times over. You have expressed and purified proteins yourself, you know what a failed prep looks like and why it failed, and you are comfortable working in plates rather than one tube at a time.

You keep records someone else could follow without asking you. You say early when something is not working, and you are happy with a plan that changes as we learn.

MUST HAVE

◆ A PhD in biochemistry, protein science, molecular biology or a related field (recent graduates welcome), or a BSc or MSc with two to three years of hands-on lab experience. Industry experience in a high-throughput setting is preferred.

◆ Molecular biology for expression: PCR, cloning by Golden Gate or Gibson assembly, and checking constructs by gel, fragment analysis or sequencing.

◆ Recombinant protein expression and purification you have run yourself, in at least one of cell-free, E. coli or mammalian systems, with affinity capture such as His, Strep or Protein A.

◆ Protein QC: quantification, SDS-PAGE or CE-SDS, and reading the results critically.

◆ Working in 96-well or 384-well plate formats, with careful, traceable record-keeping.

◆ Mammalian cell culture with good aseptic technique: adherent and suspension lines,

thawing, passaging and banking, and transient transfection of HEK293 or CHO cells for expression.

◆ Liquid handlers, magnetic-bead purification systems or other lab automation.

◆ Experience with antibodies, nanobodies or other binder formats.

Most protein production roles make a handful of proteins well for one project. This one makes many, in plates, for a lab built around the quality of its data, and that changes the job in two ways.

raw.title: Product Manager, Interactive Avatars (Staff/Principal-level)
raw.description:
Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US.

As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations.

Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow.

About the role

For years, avatars have been something you watch. You write a script, we render a video, someone presses play. That model has taken AI video a long way but it has a ceiling. A video can't answer a question. It can't read the room. It can't role-play a tough conversation and adapt when you push back.

We're changing that. Interactive Avatars listen, talk, and respond in real time; inside your product, your website, or your internal tools. You bring the logic and the language model; we power the avatar layer: the speech, the expression, the listening, the sense that there's someone actually there.

It's early. Interactive Avatars is in closed beta today, and the teams building on it are pushing it into places we didn't expect - AI sales reps, always-on support agents, interactive trainers, onboarding guides. We're hiring a Product Manager to own it and take it from beta to a platform that thousands of developers build on.

This is a role with real scope. You'll help define what a real-time avatar API should be, the surface developers integrate against, the experience end users feel, and the commercial model that makes it a business. You'll work directly with the engineering and research teams building the real-time avatar stack, and with the design partners already live in the beta.

 

The problem you're solving

Today, a developer who wants a lifelike, real-time avatar in their product has to stitch together a streaming pipeline, a rendering layer, an agent, and a set of hard real-time problems - latency, interruption handling, listening behavior, expressiveness, consistency across sessions, most of which have nothing to do with the product they're actually trying to build.

We have the avatar technology and a working beta. What we need is a PM who can turn that into an API a developer can integrate in an afternoon, trust in production, and build a real business on top of, all while holding a quality bar high enough that the experience feels human, not uncanny.

 

What you'll be doing

  • Owning the end-to-end Interactive Avatar API. This is the developer-facing surface (SDK, integration patterns, docs), the real-time experience quality, and the path from closed beta to general availability, and defining what the roadmap looks like over the coming cycles

  • Getting close to the developers and teams building on the beta: understanding how they integrate, where the API fights them, which real-time behaviors make or break the experience, and what "production-ready" means to them

  • Translating that understanding into a clear product direction. What to build, in what order, and why, and keeping the team aligned as the strategy evolves

  • Working closely with the engineering and research teams building the real-time avatar stack; contributing clear specs, sound judgment on trade-offs (quality vs. latency vs. cost), and the context that helps them build the right thing the first time

  • Partnering with go-to-market and commercial teams to define how the API is packaged, priced, and sold - a real-time API has a fundamentally different business model from batch video, and shaping that is part of the job

  • Defining and tracking the metrics that tell us whether the product is working across adoption, integration success, real-time quality, reliability, and the commercial signals that prove it's a business

Who you are

You've owned a developer-facing product before like an API, an SDK, or a platform and you know that the product is the developer experience. You understand that adoption is won or lost in the first hour of integration, and that trust is won or lost the first time something breaks in production. You build accordingly.

You're comfortable in a space where the roadmap isn't fully formed. You don't need a clean brief to get started. You can talk to developers, watch them integrate, synthesize what you see, and come back with a point of view. You're also honest about what you don't know and willing to update when the evidence changes.

You care about the detail, and you can hold a quality bar for something subjective and hard: a real-time avatar either feels present and responsive or it feels off, and the difference lives in latency, interruption handling, expressiveness, and consistency. You know how to make that bar concrete and defend it.

You think commercially. A new API isn't just a technical surface. It's a business, and you have instincts (or scar tissue) around how developer products get adopted, packaged, and monetized.

Requirements:

  • 5+ years in product, with direct experience owning a developer-facing API, SDK, or platform product. The vertical doesn't matter, the platform depth does

  • Comfortable operating in an early-stage, 0→1 environment where discovery and delivery happen in parallel and the roadmap is still being shaped

  • Strong technical fluency: you can hold a credible conversation with engineers about real-time systems, latency, and integration trade-offs, and make good calls without needing every answer handed to you

  • Strong written communication: you can write a spec, a strategy doc, or an API design rationale that others can act on without a follow-up conversation

  • Real-time / streaming media, conversational AI, or applied-AI product experience is a strong plus but not a prerequisite.

  • Instinct for the commercial side of a developer product - adoption, packaging, and monetization is a plus.

  • Based in London or open to regular in-person time.

Our culture

At Synthesia we’re passionate about building, not talking, planning or politicising. We strive to hire the smartest, kindest and most unrelenting people and let them do their best work without distractions. Our work principles serve as our charter for how we make decisions, give feedback and structure our work to empower everyone to go as fast as possible. You can find out more about these principles here.

 

Location

Flexible, hybrid role based from our London office.

 

Global benefits:

  • You will be compensated well with a generous salary and equity.

  • You get 25 days of annual leave + local holidays.

  • Regular team offsites where you’ll get to collaborate with the product & engineering team in person.

  • Work from home budget

  • Work from anywhere policy of 60 days per year

  • Generous referral scheme

  • Enhanced parental leave - maternity leave includes 16 weeks at full pay, and paternity leave includes 5 weeks at full pay (if your country’s government scheme offers more generous support, you receive whichever is greater—our enhanced policy or the local statutory benefit)

Benefits specific to UK:

  • Private healthcare via AXA for you with a discount for dependants

  • 5% pension match

  • Team lunches Tuesday-Friday in the office

  • Flexible, hybrid role based from our London office.

raw.description:
Life at UiPath

The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We’re committed to creating category-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power.

To make that happen, we need people who are curious, self-propelled, generous, and genuine. People who love being part of a fast-moving, fast-thinking growth company. And people who care—about each other, about UiPath, and about our larger purpose.

Could that be you?

Your mission

As an Enterprise Sales Executive focused on Manufacturing vertical, you will open new doors for UiPath across a territory full of untapped potential. Your focus is winning new logos: finding, building and closing opportunities with manufacturers that have not yet worked with UiPath. You will engage C-suite leaders and digital transformation teams early, challenge how they think about work, and position UiPath as the trusted platform for agentic automation across production, supply chain, finance and customer operations. Every new customer you win helps manufacturers cut repetitive work, become more resilient and efficient, and free their people to focus on higher-value decisions and better outcomes. This is a high-impact hunting role in an industry going through major change. You’ll be challenged, supported and inspired by some of the best talent in the field as you build your own path to success.

What you’ll do at UiPath

  • Build and run a territory plan focused on new logo acquisition, identifying and prioritising the manufacturing organisations with the greatest potential

  • Generate your own pipeline through proactive outreach, including cold calling, social selling, events and executive networking

  • Break into new accounts and build relationships from first contact through to signed contract

  • Own the full sales cycle for new business, from prospecting and discovery to negotiation and close

  • Achieve or exceed quarterly and annual new business targets

  • Lead with insight, bringing a point of view on how automation can solve specific challenges such as supply chain disruption, order-to-cash delays, quality and compliance demands, and workforce shortages

  • Build compelling business cases that show the financial and operational value of UiPath to new buyers

  • Work with local partners and global systems integrators to source new opportunities and access new accounts

  • Partner with marketing, business development and pre-sales teams on campaigns and plays that create new pipeline

  • Track competitors, market trends and industry priorities to spot new opportunities before others do

  • Hand over new customers smoothly to Customer Success and Customer Engineering, setting them up for successful implementation and long-term growth

  • Share what works with fellow sales executives to strengthen the team’s hunting approach

  • Explore ways of incorporating automation into daily work

What you’ll bring to the team

  • 5+ years of solution or value selling experience, with a strong focus on new business

  • A proven track record of consistently winning new logos and exceeding new business quota year on year

  • 3+ years of enterprise sales experience selling to Manufacturing customers (preferred)

  • Experience building pipeline from scratch in a greenfield or under-penetrated territory

  • Confidence prospecting into senior stakeholders, including the C-suite, and opening conversations with organisations that are new to you and to UiPath

  • Understanding of manufacturing operations and the systems that support them, such as ERP, supply chain and shop-floor technology

  • Ability to explain new and complex concepts simply, in a way that creates real desire for the solution

  • Skill in navigating complex organisations and building a network of contacts across departments and levels of leadership

  • A research and data-driven approach to account targeting and planning

  • Resilience, persistence and a competitive drive to win

  • Strong collaboration and influencing skills, internally and externally

  • A self-starter who is invested in the success of the team

  • Bachelor’s degree highly preferred

  • Automation-first mindset

#LI-MB1

Maybe you don’t tick all the boxes above—but still think you’d be great for the job? Go ahead, apply anyway. Please. Because we know that experience comes in all shapes and sizes—and passion can’t be learned.

Many of our roles allow for flexibility in when and where work gets done. Depending on the needs of the business and the role, the number of hybrid, office-based, and remote workers will vary from team to team. Applications are assessed on a rolling basis and there is no fixed deadline for this requisition. The application window may change depending on the volume of applications received or may close immediately if a qualified candidate is selected.

We value a range of diverse backgrounds, experiences and ideas. We pride ourselves on our diversity and inclusive workplace that provides equal opportunities to all persons regardless of age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, and expression, national origin, disability, neurodiversity, military and/or veteran status, or any other protected classes. Additionally, UiPath provides reasonable accommodations for candidates on request and respects applicants' privacy rights. To review these and other legal disclosures, visit our privacy policy.

raw.title: Principal Software Engineer
raw.description:
Life at UiPath

The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We’re committed to creating category-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power.

To make that happen, we need people who are curious, self-propelled, generous, and genuine. People who love being part of a fast-moving, fast-thinking growth company. And people who care—about each other, about UiPath, and about our larger purpose.

Could that be you?

Your mission

UiPath’s Intelligence Document Processing drives understanding of the documents and messages on which a business runs: invoices, claims, contracts, customer emails. We use frontier LLMs to turn all of that into structured data that automations and AI agents can act on. You'll be building the product that does it: the ingestion and extraction pipelines, the APIs customers build their operations on top of, and the systems that make those models useful, fast and trustworthy at enterprise scale.

Increasingly that work is agentic. What you build is what lets AI agents ingest, understand, retrieve and reason over enterprise documents at volume, without giving up accuracy, security or governance.

It's a product engineering role with complex systems and LLM-in-production problems underneath it. The same service handles a customer's first ten documents and another's ten million, runs in our cloud and inside a bank's own air-gapped datacentre, and has to be good enough that a business will act on its output. Knowing how well the models are actually doing, and what to do when the answer is "not well enough", is a large part of the job.

You'll write in several languages here, and pick up new ones as the problem demands. We care much more about how you think than about what you've written it in. We're looking for someone who loves building things, learns fast, and wants to own product outcomes rather than tickets.

 

What you'll do at UiPath

  • Work with engineers, product managers and customers to design, build and operate the AI systems behind UiPath's document processing products.

  • Build across the pipeline: ingestion, parsing and extraction, indexing and retrieval, and the evaluation that tells us any of it is working.

  • Take features from idea to production and stay with them, measuring whether they actually worked, and improving them when they didn't.

  • Solve genuinely hard problems in concurrency, latency and distributed systems, so the platform holds up under high-volume production workloads.

  • Build for environments we don't control: multi-cloud, on-premises, air-gapped, and under strict security and compliance requirements.

  • Use coding agents as a serious part of your toolkit, and help the team get better at it. Where to trust them, where not to, and how to keep quality high as the tooling changes underneath us.

  • Work with teams across UiPath and across locations to innovate and build best-in-class document processing, and occasionally with customers directly. Because the fastest way to understand a product is to watch someone use it.

  • Contribute to our engineering culture: mentor, review, hire, and push back when something isn't good enough.

 

What you'll bring to the team

  • A solid track record (7+ years) building and operating large-scale commercial services that real customers depend on.

  • Strong programming ability and the confidence to pick up whatever language a problem calls for. You'll meet Python, Rust and C# here, but we don't expect you to arrive knowing them all.

  • Real-world experience with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS or GCP) and containerised deployment on Kubernetes. You understand how production systems get shipped, monitored and scaled, not just written.

  • Comfort with data at scale: SQL, and the trade-offs between different storage and search systems.

  • Experience working with coding agents, and opinions about them, What responsible use looks like, where they earn their keep and where they cost you, and how you keep evaluating them in an ecosystem that changes every few months.

  • An appreciation for tools that catch bugs before runtime — type systems, tests, and designs that make bad states unrepresentable. Especially in the age of coding agents.

  • A pragmatic grasp of computer science fundamentals. We care about solving real problems with the right data structure, not reciting one from a textbook.

  • Experience shipping LLM-backed products to production is a strong plus: prompting, evaluation, and everything else that turns a model into a feature people will trust.

  • Familiarity with document processing is a plus: OCR, layout, and the messy reality of documents as they actually arrive.

  • An opinion on what makes good code and good architecture, and the ability to argue it, including against us.

  • You're a builder and a problem-solver at heart.

Maybe you don’t tick all the boxes above—but still think you’d be great for the job? Go ahead, apply anyway. Please. Because we know that experience comes in all shapes and sizes—and passion can’t be learned.

raw.title: Senior Data Engineering Manager, AD/ADAS
raw.description:
Woven by Toyota is enabling Toyota’s once-in-a-century transformation into a mobility company. Inspired by a legacy of innovating for the benefit of others, our mission is to challenge the current state of mobility through human-centric innovation — expanding what “mobility” means and how it serves society.

Our work centers on four pillars: AD/ADAS, our autonomous driving and advanced driver assist technologies; Arene, our software development platform for software-defined vehicles; Woven City, a test course for mobility; and Cloud & AI, the digital infrastructure powering our collaborative foundation. Business-critical functions empower these teams to execute, and together, we’re working toward one bold goal: a world with zero accidents and enhanced well-being for all.

TEAM

At Woven by Toyota, we tackle Autonomy challenges at the intersection of AI, Robotics, and Advanced Driving. We develop advanced Perception and Planning technologies, and their production software for multiple AD/ADAS systems. To deliver reliable data-driven technologies to millions of Toyota vehicles, we are solving complex real-world problems using large-scale data, machine learning, and state-of-the-art architectures for Perception, Prediction, and Motion Planning.

WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR?

The team is seeking an experienced, technical, and hands-on Autonomy Data Manager to grow and lead a talented team composed of Data Scientists, Data Engineers and ML Ops Engineers, working in the Autonomy team to deliver data driven Planning and Perception solutions. You will lead the team to drive the creation and deployment of sophisticated data models and algorithms to resolve business challenges for the Autonomy team. You lead through your expertise in data, deep learning and software engineering. You provide technical guidance to the team by combining modern data approaches with safety standards while also considering cost efficient options.. Furthermore, you are proactive towards handling the processes required for production development and approach them by asking "What can I do for you?" with a "Giver" mindset.


RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Define the team's short-term and long-term technical direction while collaborating on broader, cross-functional strategic initiatives across Perception, Planning, Simulation, Infrastructure, and Tooling. 

  • Initiate and influence cross-functional teams towards common data development goals and unified solutions.

  • Support the data roadmap for the program and connect your team’s technical roadmap by focusing on actionable data strategy approaches from data collect strategies, to data curation, labelling , sampling, evaluation, with a goal of leveraging the large amounts of Toyota’s market fleet data to directly improve machine learning  model performance across the End-to-End Autonomy Data pipeline.

  • Lead initiative execution by defining efficient processes, mitigating technical risks, and anticipate long-term strategic improvements within the team and across the program.

  • Enable and develop each team member to be more effective through coaching and leading by example providing high-quality algorithms, carefully thought out design reviews, and delivering rigorous initiative reports.

  • Collaborate and provide technical guidance in the design, development, deployment, optimization, and evaluation of state‑of‑the‑art data algorithms, data efficiency and pipelines to enable ML model performance with a focus on iteration speed, scalability and overall cost efficiency.

  • Drive a culture of rigorous statistical evaluation to measure, validate and implement evaluation frameworks that support ML model development and improved system behavior.

  • Drive organizational metrics towards performance, safety, and quality.

  • Work in a high-velocity environment, employ agile development practices, and collaborate in a globally distributed department (US, Japan, UK).


    • MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

  • Masters or PhD degree in Machine Learning, Computer Science, Robotics, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, or related quantitative fields, or equivalent industry experience

  • 3+ years of experience managing engineering teams, with a focus on technical leadership, team development, and delivering high-impact projects in the automotive industry.

  • 8+ years of experience covering data science, data sampling and curation, machine learning workflows, pre-processing, model training, ablation studies, evaluation, deployment, and inference optimization.

  • Experience with rigorous data science for applications leveraging large scale data sources and highly efficient pipelines

  • Experience working with large-scale robotics datasets, temporal data and/or sequential modeling

  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to communicate concepts clearly and precisely

  • Experience writing software using: i)  Python for data science (numpy, scipy, scikit, pandas; ii) databases; and iii) cloud platform services (AWS, GCP, Azure)


    • NICE TO HAVES

  • Experience as a Data Architect or Senior Manager

  • Proven track record of deploying ML models at scale in self-driving products, self-driving challenges, or related fields

  • Experience with production data pipelines or Safety & Quality processes for safety-critical applications

  • Hands-on experience in the following:

  • Analyze huge (e.g. peta byte) scale database;

  • Develop perception-related technologies, such as camera image processing, computer vision, machine learning, or deep learning; 

  • Design data annotation rules for machine learning

  • Build or manage infrastructure, such as Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins, GitHub Actions

  • Behavior prediction, imitation learning, reinforcement learning, or end-to-end models.

  • Japanese language skills

    • WHAT WE OFFER
    We are committed to creating a modern work environment that supports our employees and their loved ones. We offer many options of the best programs to allow you to do your most meaningful work and to help you shape the future of mobility.
    ・Excellent health, wellness, dental and vision coverage
    ・A rewarding pension
    ・Flexible vacation policy
    ・Family planning and care benefits

    Our Commitment
    ・We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity.
    ・Any information we receive from you will be used only in the hiring and onboarding process. Please see our privacy notice for more details.

raw.description:
Woven by Toyota is enabling Toyota’s once-in-a-century transformation into a mobility company. Inspired by a legacy of innovating for the benefit of others, our mission is to challenge the current state of mobility through human-centric innovation — expanding what “mobility” means and how it serves society.

Our work centers on four pillars: AD/ADAS, our autonomous driving and advanced driver assist technologies; Arene, our software development platform for software-defined vehicles; Woven City, a test course for mobility; and Cloud & AI, the digital infrastructure powering our collaborative foundation. Business-critical functions empower these teams to execute, and together, we’re working toward one bold goal: a world with zero accidents and enhanced well-being for all.

TEAM
An autonomous driving system typically comprises Sensing, Perception, Localization, Planning, and Control components. The World Understanding team owns responsibilities for Sensing, Perception, and Localization within Woven by Toyota for autonomous driving development. Specifically, the Sensor & Calibration sub-team, operating under the World Understanding team, focuses on Intrinsic and Extrinsic calibration of autonomous driving sensors, including Camera, LiDAR, Radar, and IMU. Our scope of work also encompasses the quality management of sensor data for post-processing activities and the operational management of calibration for our autonomous driving test vehicles.

WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR?

The Sensor & Calibration sub-team is seeking a Software Engineer to support the development of ground truth sensor calibration & data validation tools that live in the cloud and fuel our next-generation autonomous driving systems.

The selected candidate will be responsible for accelerating our calibration & data validation systems as well as maintaining & improving its infrastructure used across multiple teams. The scope of this role encompasses the following: (1) Developing and scaling validation pipelines that process large quantities of LiDAR data in the cloud, (2) Collaborating with hardware and data engineers to supporting sensor data validation across a complete sensor set up: cameras, LiDARs, imus & radars, by (3) Authoring SQL-based validation tests to ensure data correctness and coverage, (4) Managing the teams calibration and validation services, ensuring robust and predictable operation, and (5) Improving the maintainability, reliability, and observability of these systems, (6) Maintaining and improving the team repositories, with an emphasis on simplification and long-term code health, (7) Evolving the teams Vision library to be more extensible, enabling other engineering teams to build reliably on top of it. Furthermore, candidates who exhibit a collaborative, "giver" mindset, proactively supporting partner teams while maintaining a strong focus on production-quality, scalable solutions, are highly valued.


RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Support the design, implementation, and delivery of calibration & validation pipelines alongside its underlying infrastructure, proactively resolving deficiencies and ensuring that solutions meet objectives for reliability, maintainability, and business impact.

  • Write high-quality code & workflows that scale to process large quantities of fleet data, maintaining stable cloud-based calibration & validation services.

  • Contribute SQL-based validation tests and collaborate with hardware and data teams to ensure comprehensive sensor data validation coverage.

  • Enable other engineering teams to build reliably on top of shared infrastructure, improve and simplify our in house Vision library.

  • Instrument and monitor production systems, proactively identifying and addressing issues to uphold service reliability and observability.

  • Operate within a high-velocity environment and employ rigorous agile development practices

  • Work within a hybrid workspace model, necessitating physical presence in our London office three days per week.


    • MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's (Master's preferred) in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent industry experience.

  • Proficiency in Python and SQL, with experience writing production-quality, testable, and modular code.

  • Experience building and maintaining cloud-based data pipelines, with a strong emphasis on reliability, maintainability, and scalability.

  • Experience managing and maintaining software repositories, including code reviews, dependency management, versioning, and enforcing contribution standards across multiple teams.

  • Experience with monitoring and observability tooling to maintain and improve production service health.

  • The ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment and collaborate effectively across teams and disciplines, supported by excellent interpersonal skills.


    • NICE TO HAVES

  • Experience with large-scale data processing frameworks (e.g., Spark, BigQuery, or similar) for cloud-based validation pipelines.

  • Familiarity with autonomous driving sensor modalities, particularly camera, LiDAR, IMU and/or Radar.

  • Prior contributions to shared platform or framework libraries used by multiple engineering teams, with an emphasis on developer experience and extensibility.

  • Experience managing or contributing to backfill and data reconciliation services in a production environment.

  • Hands-on experience with the full lifecycle of a validation or quality assurance system, from design through deployment and ongoing maintenance.

  • A proven track record of improving system observability and operational reliability in a cloud-native or distributed systems environment.

Our data platform team is working on accelerating autonomous driving by providing access to petabytes of data collected by our fleet of autonomous and non-autonomous vehicles. The data ecosystem developed by the London team is a key building block for developing and testing modern AD/ADAS products that will impact millions of customers. 

Our ML and Data pipelines are built on-top of the open-source Flyte orchestration framework and are deployed to AWS. Pipeline code is written in Python. We use SQS and Kafka to automate data connections and leverage BigQuery and ElasticSearch for data storage. We believe strongly in automation and testing to ensure delivery of robust and correct systems.  We are a distributed team, working in the UK and US.

 

Who are we looking for?

The London Data Infrastructure team is looking for engineers who are passionate about and enable the next generation of automotive software development.   • Work on distributed systems that serve, process and transform large quantities of data in the cloud.

Application Scientist
raw.description:
About CuspAI

CuspAI is the frontier AI company on a mission to solve the breakthrough materials needed to power human progress. While nature took billions of years to perfect molecules, we are harnessing AI to unlock trillion-dollar materials breakthroughs in months, not millennia. Our founding team is the most cited in the world, comprised of world-class researchers in AI, chemistry and engineering.

We are working on some of the hardest and most important challenges including energy, clean water, the future of compute, and carbon capture, and this is just the start of what our 'search engine' for next-generation materials will unlock.

We invite you to be part of a diverse, innovative team at the intersection of AI and materials science, working to create impactful partnerships that drive innovation, scalability, and industry collaboration. This work matters. Your work matters.

We’re on the cusp of the on-demand materials era. Join us.

The Role

We hire across a spectrum of backgrounds. Some Application Scientists are computational (atomistic and molecular simulation, machine-learned force fields), some are experimental (synthesis, processing, characterisation, lab automation), and some are data-driven (materials and cheminformatics, optimisation). What they share is the ability to turn a partner’s problem into a plan, deliver it, and translate fluently between experimental, computational, and machine learning teams.

We operate a matrix structure. You will have a home team, but may contribute to projects in another pillar as demand and your expertise evolve.

Your Impact

You will own the scientific delivery of partner projects, from scoping to results. Working with our technical programme managers, ML researchers, platform engineers, and lab integration team, you will make sure our platform answers the questions that matter to partners, and that what is learned on each project feeds back into tools and workflows used across the company.

Alongside delivery, you will help build the cross-cutting capabilities that future projects depend on, such as validated workflows, harmonised data pipelines and agentic design campaigns.

Application Areas

We are particularly interested in candidates with expertise in one or more of the areas below. You do not need to cover a whole pillar.

  • Electronics: Semiconductor processing, device-level modelling and electronics, photonic and thermal materials

  • Energy: Catalysis, batteries, photovoltaics and multiscale kinetics.

  • Environment: Porous and soft materials, interfaces, and separations

  • Cross-cutting: Materials informatics, automated experimentation and optimisation.

What You Will Do

Project leadership and delivery

  • Lead partner projects from scoping to delivery, as a key point of contact alongside the technical program managers.

  • Write technical scopes that define objectives, deliverables, success criteria, and timelines.

  • Prepare regular technical reports and presentations for partners and internal teams.

Science and campaigns

  • Apply and extend our platform to partner problems, using simulation, machine learning, data-driven optimisation, or experiments as the project requires.

  • Design and steer discovery campaigns, including agentic and closed-loop campaigns with partner labs.

  • Assess when models, simulations, and data can be trusted, and contribute to validating them against experiments.

Bridging experimental and computational teams

  • Translate platform recommendations into clear, executable experimental plans, and translate lab realities back into requirements for internal teams.

  • Make sure data from partners and our own workflows are clean, structured, and consistent.

  • Work closely with partner labs, including on-site visits at key stages of a project.

Capability and product development

  • Build and automate workflows that run reliably at scale within our platform.

  • Relay partner feedback to TPMs, ML researchers, and platform engineers to improve tools and workflows.

  • Stay informed about advances in your field and contribute to the scientific direction of your team.

Must Have Skills and Qualifications

  • A PhD in chemistry, materials science, physics, chemical engineering, or a related field, or equivalent industry experience.

  • Deep, hands-on expertise in at least one of: atomistic simulation (including machine-learned force fields); experimental materials or chemistry, ideally with automation or high-throughput methods; materials or cheminformatics with machine learning and optimisation.

  • A track record in one or more of the application areas above.

  • Python skills for data handling, analysis, automation or modelling, and familiarity with version control (Git).

  • Exceptional ability to communicate with both experimental and computational scientists, and to translate between them.

  • A personal passion for CuspAI's mission and the potential of AI to unlock breakthroughs in materials science.

Bonus Points (But Not Critical)

  • Industry experience, particularly in the semiconductor, electronics, energy, or chemical sectors.

  • Experience leading projects or collaborations with external partners, including writing technical scopes or proposals.

  • Experience with multiscale modelling, from atomistic to mesoscale, continuum or device level.

  • Practical synthesis or processing experience, with an understanding of what makes a route feasible and reproducible.

  • Professional software engineering practice, such as code review, testing and deployment.

  • Prior experience in a start-up or fast-growth technology company.

Additional Considerations

These roles can be based in our London, Cambridge, Amsterdam, or Berlin offices, with the expectation of being in the office at least three days per week. There may be regular travel to partner sites and other CuspAI offices for collaboration and project work.

What We Offer

  • A competitive salary: We value and reward impact and growth

  • Equity in CuspAI: You have a stake in the success of the company

  • Time off to stay fresh: 28 days holiday (DE, NL, UK) or 21 days holiday (JP, SG, US), in addition to local public holidays

  • ‘Gold Standard’ parental leave: 26 weeks (primary caregiver) and 12 weeks (secondary caregiver) at full pay - we look after you and your family while we work on the most important materials discovery problems together

  • Professional development budget: We invest in your career development so you can stay up to date with the latest industry knowledge or add to your skills to increase impact and growth

  • Solve meaningful problems: See how your work has a direct impact on advancing materials science and solving sustainability and climate-related problems through the creation and application of bleeding-edge SOTA technology and revolutionary techniques

  • True interdisciplinary teamwork: Be part of a deeply collaborative environment bridging AI research, computational chemistry, and experimental science - work with world-class researchers and engineers who enjoy sharing knowledge and supporting each other


Join us in shaping the future of materials with AI. Together, we can create groundbreaking solutions for a more sustainable world.

*Note that you would be joining as a ‘Member of Technical Staff’, but the indicative job title above hopefully helps to explain the nature of this role. The role will be part of our Platform Engineering organisation.

Your Impact

In this role you will be building the internal product ecosystem that streamlines and curates our proprietary discovery workflows, which is critical for accelerating our mission to solve global challenges through next-generation materials.

Your main focus initially will be partnering with our VP of Product to define and build the first generation of internal applications from scratch, ensuring they are not just functional but curated as high-quality products. Over time, you will likely get involved in scaling these systems to support increasingly complex interdisciplinary data flows and potentially external-facing interfaces as our "search engine" for materials evolves.

What You Will Do

Product Inception & Internal Tooling

  • Lead the development of a suite of internal applications, treating them as first-class products with a focus on usability and long-term scalability.

  • Collaborate closely with the VP of Product to translate high-level research needs into technical roadmaps and intuitive software solutions.

  • Own the end-to-end lifecycle of internal tools, from initial architecture and backend design to frontend deployment.

Full-Stack Development & Platform Integration

  • Design and build robust backend services in Python to interface with our core AI and research engines, integrating disparate workflows into a unified, high-performance internal platform.

  • Partner with the Data Engineering team to ensure seamless ingestion and visualisation of complex datasets within internal applications.

  • Develop clean, responsive UIs that enable researchers to interact with complex data effectively, maintaining a high bar for intuitiveness and reducing cognitive load for technical users.

Interdisciplinary Collaboration

  • Work closely with AI Researchers and Data Engineers to understand the nuances of their daily tasks and build tools that empower them.

  • Collaborate with the broader engineering team to ensure internal tools align with our overall infrastructure and security standards.

Must Have Skills and Qualifications:

  • You have at least 4+ years of professional experience in full-stack software engineering, with a proven track record of building and maintaining production-grade applications.

  • You possess strong backend expertise, specifically with Python and modern web frameworks (e.g. FastAPI, Django, or Flask).

  • You are proficient with Node.js and modern frontend frameworks (e.g. React, Vue, or TypeScript) and have a keen eye for UI/UX best practices.

  • You are a "builder" at heart who enjoys the greenfield stage of a project and is comfortable making architectural decisions from scratch.

  • You have a product-focused mindset, meaning you don't just "write tickets" but actively think about how to make the user's life easier.

  • You are excited by the prospect of enabling world-changing scientific discovery, even if you don't have a background in the sciences yourself.

Bonus Points (But Not Critical):

  • Experience working in an early-stage startup environment where you've had to wear multiple hats.

  • Previous experience building internal tools, dashboards, or "Admin" interfaces for data-heavy companies.

  • Knowledge of modern DevOps practices and cloud infrastructure (e.g. GCP, Docker, Kubernetes).

  • An academic background or personal interest in Materials Science, Chemistry, or Sustainability.


Additional Considerations

This role could be based in our Cambridge, London, Amsterdam or Berlin offices, with the expectation of being in the office three days per week. Additionally, there may be regular travel required to other locations for collaboration and project work.

What We Offer

  • A competitive salary: We value and reward impact and growth

  • Equity in CuspAI: You have a stake in the success of the company

  • Time off to stay fresh: 28 days holiday (DE, NL, UK) or 21 days holiday (JP, SG, US), in addition to local public holidays

  • ‘Gold Standard’ parental leave: 26 weeks (primary caregiver) and 12 weeks (secondary caregiver) at full pay - we look after you and your family while we work on the most important materials discovery problems together

  • Professional development budget: We invest in your career development so you can stay up to date with the latest industry knowledge or add to your skills to increase impact and growth

  • Solve meaningful problems: See how your work has a direct impact on advancing materials science and solving sustainability and climate-related problems through the creation and application of bleeding-edge SOTA technology and revolutionary techniques

  • True interdisciplinary teamwork: Be part of a deeply collaborative environment bridging AI research, computational chemistry, and experimental science - work with world-class researchers and engineers who enjoy sharing knowledge and supporting each other


Join us in shaping the future of materials with AI. Together, we can create groundbreaking solutions for a more sustainable world.

raw.description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

The role / impact
As an Internal AI Engineer at ElevenLabs, you'll be embedded at the frontier of how we scale - acting as a forward-deployed engineer across our GTM, Operations, and Finance teams. You won't just build tools; you'll co-design and ship agentic AI workflows that eliminate manual toil and fundamentally reshape how our people operate.

Your impact goes beyond the code. You'll own high-stakes automations from discovery to production, acting as a technical partner to internal teams. The patterns, guardrails, and tooling you define will become the blueprint other teams reach for - the standard for how ElevenLabs harnesses AI safely and at speed.

The team / how we work
You'll join a lean, high-velocity team with a shared obsession: turning broken, manual processes into elegant automated systems. We move fast through rapid experimentation, work closely with operators and business owners to uncover the real problem, and ship pragmatic solutions without waiting for perfect specs.

What you'll actually be working on

  • Designing and iterating on AI agents and workflow orchestrations using tools like ElevenAgents, Claude, and n8n.

  • Integrating AI systems with our core business stack - Salesforce, Slack, Ashby, and more

  • Building reusable automation services, patterns and shared templates that multiply the output of every team you touch

  • Owning experiments end-to-end: spotting the opportunity, building the solution, and measuring the impact

  • Developing evaluation and monitoring frameworks so our AI-native workflows are reliable, auditable, and safe


    What we're looking for

  • Proven experience building and shipping automations or applications in production - you know what it takes to go from fuzzy business pain to something real teams depend on

  • AI-First Instincts: Strong familiarity with LLM capabilities, prompting strategies, RAG patterns, and a genuine passion for building agentic workflows.

  • Deep Backend Expertise : Strong Python and SQL and system design patterns (APIs, webhooks, orchestration layers)

  • A systems-thinking mindset : you design with security, auditability, and blast radius in mind from the start

  • Builder and AI-First instincts: you don't wait to be told what to build - you spot the pattern, propose the fix, and ship it.

  • Infra & DevOps Instincts: Hands-on experience operating cloud infrastructure (GCP preferred), Kubernetes, Docker, and enterprise authentication flows

Location

This role is remote and can be executed globally. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London, New York, San Francisco, and Warsaw. Specific teams may have specific location preferences.

raw.description:
Institutional Fabric for the Digital Asset Market

Founded in 2018, Talos provides institutional-grade trading technology for the global digital asset market, powering many of the major players in the crypto ecosystem. Our mission is clear: to advance the mass adoption of digital assets by seamlessly connecting institutions to the digital asset ecosystem. We are committed to building the most innovative and trusted platform in the world, supporting the entire trading lifecycle.

At Talos, you’ll find an environment that champions kindness and respect, values diverse perspectives, and upholds inclusivity at every turn. We believe every member of our team brings invaluable insights and abilities that drive Talos forward. In our pursuit of excellence, we foster a culture of trust, integrity, collaboration, and mutual growth.

We are a tight-knit yet globally distributed team of highly experienced engineers and business leaders, with hubs in New York, London, Singapore, and Cyprus. You’ll be part of a hybrid-friendly environment where your unique talents and insights will play a crucial role in building something extraordinary.

Principal Engineer, Data Quality Platform

You'll own data correctness across Talos. You'll lead the data quality engineering team, run BAU data operations, and own reference and security master data, along with the pipelines and platform that deliver it.

Our goal: the data we return to clients is always correct, and we find defects before a client does.

You'll join a small team with the mandate to work independently from product engineering and challenge it. Engineering teams make assumptions about how their systems behave. Your job is to test those assumptions and prove or disprove them with evidence.

 

Responsibilities

  • Lead AI-first data quality engineering

  • Validate every client-facing endpoint continuously. The focus is our REST and WebSocket APIs. Cloud delivery (S3, Snowflake, Databricks) is also in scope. Assert correctness against independent sources of truth, across every environment and client entitlement.

  • Cover streaming as well as request/response. For WebSocket, that means:

  • sequencing and gap detection

  • snapshot-to-increment consistency

  • reconnect and replay correctness

  • staleness of live subscriptions

  • agreement between the streamed view and the REST view of the same state

  • Use adaptive detection, not static thresholds. Learn baselines per endpoint and per market, and let them adjust as "normal" changes. Hand-set limits get noisy, go stale, and teach people to ignore alerts.

  • Apply LLM and agentic tooling to generate checks from API specs and schemas, keep them current as the product changes, and triage alerts before a human sees them. Know when a deterministic rule, invariant or cross-source reconciliation is the better tool.

  • Test resilience and load. Design load, performance and failure-mode tests.

  • When you find a fault, raise it with the owning team with enough evidence for them to act. Drive it to resolution, then add a check that would have caught it earlier.

  • Measure and publish endpoint and field coverage, time to detect, detected-before-client rate and false-positive rate.

  • Run data governance

  • Build and maintain a catalog of our data assets and APIs, covering lineage and downstream consumers. Maintain an understanding of assets, how they're used and what breaks when they change.

  • Own data governance tooling such as OpenMetadata.

  • Own reference and security master data

  • Lead the build-out of the next-generation security master platform, then run it day to day: new listings, symbol mapping across venues, and increment and contract specs.

  • Design processes for safe updates to security entries, with validation and rollback.

  • Expand coverage across the firm

  • Over time, extend data quality coverage beyond client APIs to:

  • trade signals

  • pre-trade analytics

  • client post-trade analysis

  • PMS analytics

Qualifications

  • A track record of leading data QA or data quality teams, preferably on market data or other high-throughput, real-time data.

  • A deep understanding of streaming and API behaviour: throughput, WebSocket semantics, ordering, recovery and failure modes.

  • Experience inventorying and testing a large API and data surface end to end.

  • Hands-on experience with data governance: cataloging, lineage, ownership.

  • Experience with performance and load testing of distributed systems.

  • A strong engineering background. You design platforms, not scripts on a cron job, and you build on shared infrastructure rather than creating one-off tooling.

  • Practical experience applying LLM and agentic tooling to engineering problems.

  • Our stack: Flink, Doris, Dagster and Spark, plus OpenMetadata (or an equivalent such as Apache Atlas). Experience with comparable tools is just as relevant.

raw.description:
Company Description

We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

The role

Our Commercial and Revenue Operations teams help power commercial growth by ensuring that customer-facing teams have the right knowledge, skills, processes, systems, data and capabilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience and drive revenue.

As a Commercial & Revenue Operations Graduate, you’ll build a broad understanding of the commercial lifecycle while gaining hands-on experience in areas such as Revenue Operations, Revenue Enablement, Deal Management, Commercial Insights and Business Partnering.

You may complete rotations across commercial teams before moving into a longer-term placement aligned with your strengths, development interests and business needs. The proposed early careers model includes Commercial Operations, BDR, Account Management and Solutions Engineering pathways.

You’ll work alongside experienced professionals, receive structured training and mentoring, and join a global Early Careers community with networking, professional development and leadership opportunities.

How you’ll make an impact

During the programme, you may:

  • Analyse commercial processes and workflows to identify bottlenecks, risks and opportunities to improve efficiency.

  • Support the design and implementation of scalable processes, playbooks and operating procedures.

  • Use data to identify trends, measure performance and provide clear recommendations to commercial stakeholders.

  • Help maintain accurate CRM and pipeline data, supporting reporting, forecasting and decision-making.

  • Support deal, pricing and approval processes, ensuring information is complete, accurate and well controlled.

  • Create enablement materials, training resources and communications that help commercial teams adopt new tools and ways of working.

  • Explore how AI and automation can improve commercial productivity and operational effectiveness.

  • Partner with teams including Sales, Account Management, Solutions Engineering, Technical Account Managers, Product, Engineering, Finance and Data.

  • Contribute to projects that improve the merchant experience and support sustainable revenue growth.

What we’re looking for

You’re a curious, organised and commercially minded problem-solver who enjoys connecting people, processes and data. You are comfortable learning quickly, asking questions and taking ownership in a fast-paced environment.

You’ll bring:

  • A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree, ideally in a quantitative, business, economics, technology or similarly relevant subject.

  • An interest in commercial strategy, revenue operations, sales, fintech or business transformation.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to turn data into practical recommendations. Intermediate to advanced spreadsheet ability. SQL is a plus.

  • Clear written and verbal communication skills.

  • Strong organisation and attention to detail.

  • An appetite to learn about payments, technology and the commercial lifecycle.

  • Curiosity about AI, automation, data and new ways of working.

  • The ability to collaborate effectively with diverse stakeholders.

  • A proactive mindset and willingness to take responsibility for delivering outcomes.

  • Fluency in written and spoken English; additional languages are a plus.

  • Payments or financial services knowledge is helpful but not required.

  • A keenness to work at pace, managing competing properties effectively and maintaining quality while delivering against tight timelines

What success looks like

By the end of the programme, you will:

  • Understand how Checkout.com’s commercial teams operate and work together.

  • Be able to analyse a business process, identify improvement opportunities and recommend practical solutions.

  • Demonstrate confidence working with commercial data, systems and reporting.

  • Communicate clearly with stakeholders across different functions and levels.

  • Deliver projects that create measurable value for commercial teams or customers.

  • Be ready to progress into a permanent role within Revenue Operations, Revenue Enablement, Deal Management, Commercial Insights, Business Development, Account Management or another suitable commercial pathway.

Early Careers experience

You’ll receive:

  • Dedicated onboarding and payments-focused training.

  • Professional skills workshops and leadership sessions.

  • Mentoring from experienced colleagues.

  • Networking and community events.

  • Opportunities to work on meaningful, business-critical projects.

  • Regular feedback and transparent performance conversations.

  • Potential progression into a permanent role, subject to performance, readiness, headcount availability and business requirements.

Our culture

We’re looking for people who put the customer first, move with pace, continuously improve, take ownership and maintain high standards of accuracy. Our early careers strategy is designed to develop future payments and commercial experts who can contribute with technical curiosity, commercial awareness and a merchant-focused mindset.

Eligibility

  • Graduated within the last 12 months or due to graduate by the programme start date, depending on the selected pathway.

  • Available to work full-time for the duration of the programme.

  • Able to work from the stated programme location and meet applicable right-to-work requirements.

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

For a closer look at daily life at Checkout.com, follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram

Company Description

We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

The Role

As part of Checkout.com’s #NextGen Early Careers Program, we are looking for an ambitious Finance Analyst Apprentice to join our fast-paced EU Finance department. Reporting directly to the Regional Finance Director, you will work alongside experienced professionals, gain hands-on experience, and join a global community with technical training, mentorship, and regular networking opportunities to accelerate your growth.

Through a structured three-year program, you will balance real team deliverables with study towards your ACCA (Association of Chartered Certified Accountants) qualification, dedicating 20% of your time (around six hours per week) to your professional studies. Each placement will be supported by a dedicated Rotation Manager alongside guidance from senior Finance leadership.

You will gain broad exposure across six core finance pillars: Financial Control and Revenue & Billing in year one; Tax and Treasury in year two; and Strategic Finance and Finance Transformation in year three. Depending on business and ACCA requirements, you may also gain exposure to adjacent areas such as Product Control, Procurement, or Internal Audit.

How You’ll Make An Impact

  • Support accurate, timely finance operations across your rotations, contributing to processes such as month-end close, reconciliations, journals and variance analysis.

  • Help teams deliver invoicing, settlement, revenue recognition, tax compliance, cash management, budgeting and reporting activities.

  • Prepare and review information carefully, including supporting audit, compliance and management reporting requirements.

  • Work with colleagues across Finance to respond to queries, share information and deliver tasks to agreed deadlines.

  • Look for practical ways to improve processes, documentation and the use of finance systems and data.

  • Apply what you learn through ACCA study to real finance work, building technical, analytical and communication skills over time.

Eligibility Requirements

This role is offered as a government-funded Level 7 ACCA apprenticeship. Appointment is conditional on the successful candidate meeting the government’s apprenticeship funding and eligibility requirements at the start of training, as confirmed by our approved training provider. Under current England funding rules, Level 7 funding is generally available to applicants aged 16–21, with limited exceptions for eligible applicants aged 22–24 who have an EHCP or have been, or are, in care.

This role is offered as an early-careers opportunity and we are not able to offer this role on a privately funded basis. Further information about the Apprenticeship funding can be found here.

  • Academic Qualifications: You will have either:

  • A degree qualification

    OR

  • You have completed a Level 4 AAT qualification before the September start date

+ 2 A Levels (or equivalent) and 3 GCSEs including a pass in English and Maths

Visa sponsorship: We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

What We’re Looking For

  • Academic Ambition: You are eager to begin your journey toward becoming a Chartered Accountant via the ACCA pathway.

  • Analytical Mindset: You have a natural comfort with numbers and a high attention to detail.

  • Resilience: The ability to work toward tight deadlines in a fast-paced, high-growth work environment.

  • Tech Savvy: Proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets. Any prior exposure to accounting systems (like Workday) is a huge plus, but not a dealbreaker—we will train you!

  • Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills and a "team player" attitude.

  • Proficiency with Excel or Google Sheets; familiarity with finance systems such as Workday is helpful, but not essential.

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

  • Manage all incoming and outgoing mail and courier requirements with accuracy and care.

  • Prepare, issue, and manage visitor access passes in line with company security procedures.

  • Respond to emails, service desk requests, and general correspondence promptly, professionally, and within agreed SLAs.

  • Act as a trained First Aider and Fire Warden (training provided if required).

  • Maintain and continuously improve the Front of House playbook.

  • Respond to London based Slack queries in a timely, helpful, and professional manner.

We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

About the role

The Partner Engagements Manager, Compliance Strategy will lead Checkout’s external-facing compliance strategy across banking, scheme and other strategic partner relationships.

You will own the operating model and delivery of compliance-related partner engagements, including annual reviews, periodic due diligence, requests for information, licensing and scheme initiatives, and readiness for product or geographic expansion. You will ensure that Checkout presents a consistent, accurate and well-evidenced view of its compliance framework, while converting external expectations into practical improvements to our roadmap, controls, processes and operating model.

The role combines strategic ownership, senior stakeholder management and hands-on delivery. You will lead complex engagements, advise Compliance leadership, build strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders, and develop the partner-engagement capability of the team, including managing and coaching Senior Analyst(s) as the structure is established.

What you will do

  • Own the Compliance Strategy partner-engagement portfolio, prioritising work across banking partners, schemes and other strategic external stakeholders.

  • Establish and continuously improve the operating model for partner engagements, including governance, roles and responsibilities, service standards, evidence expectations, response libraries, escalation routes and management information.

  • Lead annual KYC AML partner compliance reviews, partner onboarding or refreshes, complex RFIs and other material external engagements from planning through to closure.

  • Act as a senior Compliance representative in partner meetings, with high level input around Checkout’s compliance framework, risk management approach, policies, controls, governance and improvement plans with clarity and confidence.
