Role Description
As a Real Estate Analyst at Checkout.com, you will provide dedicated administrative, data management, and operational support to the Head of Real Estate, focusing on mitigating risk and increasing efficiency across the global portfolio. This role is essential for managing high-risk operational tasks, such as lease event tracking, lease administration, budgeting and data reporting to ensure a structured approach and prevent critical errors.

Key Responsibilities

1. Lease Administration & Governance

  • Proactively track, monitor, and manage critical dates for all lease events, including renewals and break clauses, acting as the primary conduit for populating and managing the tools that host our Real Estate data.

  • Support the execution of Real Estate contracts by coordinating with Brokers, Procurement, Legal etc. to finalise signing, updating project budgets, and archiving completed agreements.

  • Manage operational risk by ensuring all key details related to lease obligations are accurately recorded, tracked and action is taken.

  • For business case generation, gather comparable evidence, property valuations, and market data to drive strategic negotiations.

  • Liaise with regional, business and central teams to capture the justification and data necessary for business case approval.

  • Manage subleasing activities, including monitoring sub-tenant compliance, tracking sublease income and key milestones, and coordinating with legal and property management teams.

2. Financial and Procurement Reporting

  • Coordinate with Finance, Tax and Procurement teams for Real Estate budgets, including updating and managing the Real Estate OPEX and CAPEX budget tracking tools.

  • Act as the central point of contact for all property-related budget reporting, preparing quarterly reviews in a clear, digestible format that includes Real Estate and Workplace costs - giving an all inclusive cost per desk / square foot / head.

  • Assist in reporting refurbishment or new office delivery costs, against business as usual spend for operational office locations.

  • Support the coordination of financial and legal documentation required for transactions, such as preparing group structure charts and financials for external parties (e.g., landlords).

3. Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) Data Collation

  • Lead the coordination and collection of energy, water, and utility consumption data across the global portfolio to support future CSR reporting requirements.

  • Manage the challenge of obtaining utility data in co-working and serviced spaces where direct meter readings are complex, including liaising with local teams, operators and landlords to gather the necessary information.

  • Act as the conduit between the CEO Office and ESG/CSR teams to ensure our portfolio meets the needs of Sustainability policies and or regulatory requirements.

4. Departmental Administrative Support

  • Assist in due diligence and preparation of business cases by researching and reporting on regional office statistics (e.g., desk counts, utilisation, attendance, capacity & commercials).

  • Act as a key liaison for business case presentation and refinement.

  • Maintain dynamic headcount forecasts to ensure space planning aligns with evolving business needs, particularly for high-growth regions.

  • Monitor and document team shift patterns to inform workspace strategy (e.g., HVAC service requirements, after-hours access, and desk rotation models).

  • Monitor and manage utilisation reports for Serviced Offices, along with onboard and offboard leaves to locations where we do not directly manage access control.

  • Maintain the central digital repository for all property documentation (leases, contracts, floor plans, and insurance certificates), ensuring strict naming conventions, accessibility, and version control are met to ensure 100% audit-readiness.

  • Schedule and prepare agendas, collate pre-read materials, and document meeting minutes for key real estate governance forums, proactively tracking action items to ensure timely closure by stakeholders.

  • Managing the administrative aspects of the "joiner/leaver" process for office access where no assigned Workplace / People person is assigned.

  • Act as the primary administrator for processing property-related invoices, performing the initial "first-pass" review to flag discrepancies against purchase orders (POs) and ensuring all costs are accurately coded before final submission to Finance.

5. Health, Safety & Physical Security Management

  • Coordinate the global H&S audit schedule in partnership with SMEs, managing the central audit database, evidence library, action log, and training records to track progress and compliance.

  • Support the weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual reporting framework to surface risk trends and audit completion status, allocating audits to regional teams for execution.

  • Own the scheduling, chasing, and evidence trail for the audit lifecycle, acting as the primary administrative point of contact to ensure smooth execution.

  • Drive the audit lifecycle by ensuring all actions are identified, triaged, and managed to resolution, proactively identifying blockers and managing overdue items.

  • Ensure regional teams interpret and apply the central H&S framework in accordance with local laws while maintaining the global baseline standards.

  • Manage the integration of the H&S framework with wider Real Estate RACI to ensure clear accountability and prevent overlaps in responsibilities.

  • Implement and maintain physical security policies and standards across all global office locations.

  • Instruct periodic physical security risk assessments and audits to identify vulnerabilities and ensure compliance with security protocols.

  • Oversee visitor management processes and physical security measures to safeguard personnel and assets.

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

Checkout.com builds payment technology that helps ambitious businesses accept payments, get paid out, and grow into new markets. We work as one team, move with ownership, and look for better ways to help our merchants succeed.

About the Role

As the BDR Academy Lead, you will own the design, delivery, and continuous improvement of Checkout.com’s global Revenue Academy. You will turn commercial priorities into a structured, measurable development journey that helps Business Development Representatives (BDRs) build deep product knowledge, master prospecting skills, and apply our proprietary Sales Methodology. Your work will directly impact quality pipeline creation and prepare BDRs to progress into future commercial roles.

The Academy provides a consistent global foundation, tailored to two distinct sales motions: Mid-Tier and Enterprise.

Key Responsibilities

1. Own the BDR Academy End-to-End

  • Partner with BDR and Commercial leadership to establish the Academy’s operating model, annual roadmap, governance, and continuous improvement cycle.

  • Manage the complete learner journey from onboarding to graduation, including cohort planning, communications, milestones, and learner support.

  • Build and maintain a unified global curriculum with clear applications for Mid-Tier and Enterprise motions, balancing global consistency with necessary regional adaptations.

  • Translate field needs into clear learning outcomes, facilitator guides, practical exercises, and reusable assets.

  • Coordinate cohort intake and operational readiness across regional BDR leaders, Sales, People, and Talent Acquisition teams.

  • Deliver learning efficiently using a blend of e-learning, virtual sessions, and in-person training (directly or via regional partners).

2. Drive Capability & Field Application

  • Facilitate engaging blended learning programs: live workshops, practice simulations, call reviews, coaching sessions, and on-the-job application.

  • Earn internal "Train-the-Trainer" certification for the Checkout.com proprietary Sales Methodology.

  • Build BDR expertise across payments, Checkout.com products, discovery and qualification, account research, stakeholder mapping, outreach strategies, and commercial tools (including approved AI tools).

  • Partner with managers to connect training to live BDR workflows, reinforce positive behaviors, and identify capability gaps early.

  • Act as an AI champion, supporting managers in embedding approved AI tools and automated workflows into BDR routines.

3. Maintain Standards, Certification & Progression

  • Define competency standards, rubric-based assessments, and clear certification requirements for the BDR pathway.

  • Lead evidence-based milestone reviews with managers and leaders at key stages (onboarding, probation, and progression gates).

  • Track completion rates, assessment results, and revenue impact; provide transparent data to help managers make informed progression decisions.

  • Prepare BDRs for future commercial roles (e.g., Sales, Account Management) while managing clear performance-based expectations.

4. Measure Impact & Collaborate Globally

  • Track and maintain an Academy Scorecard covering metrics such as onboarding speed, certification rates, pipeline contribution quality, and learner/manager feedback.

  • Analyze cohort performance by region and stage to resolve bottlenecks and optimize delivery.

  • Collaborate with regional teams to ensure local market relevance without compromising global standards.

What Success Looks Like

  • Clear Pathways: BDRs follow a structured, tailored learning journey appropriate for their target market motion (Mid-Tier or Enterprise).

  • Actionable Learning: Coaching and training directly translate into improved live prospecting and pipeline generation.

  • Transparent Growth: Progression decisions are timely, objective, and grounded in clear competency evidence.

  • Measurable Value: Executive leadership receives clear, data-backed insights on cohort health, capability growth, and revenue contribution.

  • Scalable Operations: The Academy scales seamlessly across global regions without losing quality or accountability.

What You Bring

Essential Experience & Qualifications

  • Commercial & Enablement Background: Direct experience in BDR/SDR roles, BDR leadership, Revenue/Sales Enablement, or sales performance program management.

  • Program Architecture: Proven track record of designing, running, or scaling structured sales onboarding or development programs with clear milestones.

  • Instructional Design & Facilitation: Strong expertise in adult learning principles, workshop facilitation, and turning strategic concepts into practical, engaging training.

  • Stakeholder Management: Confidence collaborating with, influencing, and guiding frontline managers and senior commercial leaders.

  • Analytical & Operational Skills: Data-driven mindset with experience using performance metrics and feedback to evaluate programs and drive continuous improvement.

  • Tech & AI Positive: Comfortable using modern sales engagement platforms, learning technology, and approved AI tools to enhance productivity.

  • Proactive Leadership: Collaborative yet assertive approach—able to operate independently, take full ownership, and advocate for high standards.

Preferred (Nice-to-Have)

  • Experience in payments, fintech, SaaS, or complex B2B technology sectors.

  • Familiarity with Salesforce, Learning Management Systems (LMS), and sales engagement tools.

  • Experience building or administering skills assessments, certification programs, or analytics dashboards.

  • Fluency in additional languages relevant to Checkout.com’s key global markets.

About the Role

As the BDR Academy Lead, you will own the design, delivery, and continuous improvement of Checkout.com’s global Revenue Academy. You will turn commercial priorities into a structured, measurable development journey that helps Business Development Representatives (BDRs) build deep product knowledge, master prospecting skills, and apply our proprietary Sales Methodology. Your work will directly impact quality pipeline creation and prepare BDRs to progress into future commercial roles.

The Academy provides a consistent global foundation, tailored to two distinct sales motions: Mid-Tier and Enterprise.

Key Responsibilities

1. Own the BDR Academy End-to-End

  • Partner with BDR and Commercial leadership to establish the Academy’s operating model, annual roadmap, governance, and continuous improvement cycle.

  • Manage the complete learner journey from onboarding to graduation, including cohort planning, communications, milestones, and learner support.

  • Build and maintain a unified global curriculum with clear applications for Mid-Tier and Enterprise motions, balancing global consistency with necessary regional adaptations.

  • Translate field needs into clear learning outcomes, facilitator guides, practical exercises, and reusable assets.

  • Coordinate cohort intake and operational readiness across regional BDR leaders, Sales, People, and Talent Acquisition teams.

  • Deliver learning efficiently using a blend of e-learning, virtual sessions, and in-person training (directly or via regional partners).

2. Drive Capability & Field Application

  • Facilitate engaging blended learning programs: live workshops, practice simulations, call reviews, coaching sessions, and on-the-job application.

  • Earn internal "Train-the-Trainer" certification for the Checkout.com proprietary Sales Methodology.

  • Build BDR expertise across payments, Checkout.com products, discovery and qualification, account research, stakeholder mapping, outreach strategies, and commercial tools (including approved AI tools).

  • Partner with managers to connect training to live BDR workflows, reinforce positive behaviors, and identify capability gaps early.

  • Act as an AI champion, supporting managers in embedding approved AI tools and automated workflows into BDR routines.

3. Maintain Standards, Certification & Progression

  • Define competency standards, rubric-based assessments, and clear certification requirements for the BDR pathway.

  • Lead evidence-based milestone reviews with managers and leaders at key stages (onboarding, probation, and progression gates).

  • Track completion rates, assessment results, and revenue impact; provide transparent data to help managers make informed progression decisions.

  • Prepare BDRs for future commercial roles (e.g., Sales, Account Management) while managing clear performance-based expectations.

4. Measure Impact & Collaborate Globally

  • Track and maintain an Academy Scorecard covering metrics such as onboarding speed, certification rates, pipeline contribution quality, and learner/manager feedback.

  • Analyze cohort performance by region and stage to resolve bottlenecks and optimize delivery.

  • Collaborate with regional teams to ensure local market relevance without compromising global standards.

  • Scalable Operations: The Academy scales seamlessly across global regions without losing quality or accountability.

  • Commercial & Enablement Background: Direct experience in BDR/SDR roles, BDR leadership, Revenue/Sales Enablement, or sales performance program management.

raw.description:
Company Description

We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.

Role Overview

We are seeking a TPRM Senior Associate with 4+ years of relevant experience to serve as a key operational member of the London TPRM team. This role is the primary operational bridge between the London leadership, the Offshore TPRM Operations Team, and critical onshore functions (Procurement, Business Owners, Risk SMEs). The Senior Associate is responsible for coordinating the execution workflow, managing the quality assurance of medium-risk third parties, and driving the logistics for the critical Supplier Performance Review process.

Responsibilities

This role is centred on execution quality, operational leadership, and cross-functional coordination within the London TPRM team structure:

  • Offshore Operations Liaison & Quality Control:

    • Act as the primary daily point of contact and operational supervisor for the Offshore TPRM Operations Team, ensuring the accurate and timely execution of all third-party risk assessments and due diligence activities.

    • Lead the Quality Control (QC) process for all assessments delivered by the offshore team, ensuring outputs are consistent, align with established methodologies, and are fully audit-ready.

    • Monitor the operational performance of the offshore team against defined Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).

    • Be ready to conduct third-party assessments to support the team, where required.

  • Stakeholder Coordination & Assessment Oversight:

    • Coordinate Assessment Initiation by working closely with Procurement and Business Owners to ensure third-party risk assessments are initiated at the correct phase of the third-party lifecycle.

    • Manage the crucial triage and review process by coordinating with Internal Risk SMEs (e.g., InfoSec, Data Privacy, BCP) to ensure high-risk assessments receive appropriate specialized review and sign-off prior to completion.

    • Serve as the operational point of contact for these onshore internal risk teams regarding third-party-specific findings and remediation requirements.

  • Supplier Performance Monitoring & Reporting:

    • Oversee the governance and standardization of ongoing supplier performance monitoring activities executed by the offshore team.

    • Coordinate with Business Owners and Procurement to collect and review performance data (e.g., SLA adherence, operational metrics) and integrate significant performance failures or deficiencies into the overall third-party risk profile.

    • Ensure any critical performance issues are appropriately flagged for risk review and incorporated into continuous monitoring plans.

  • Escalation and Remediation Management:

    • Serve as the primary escalation point for all high-risk findings, process bottlenecks, and third-party non-compliance issues reported by the Offshore TPRM Operations Team.

    • Work with Business Owners and Procurement to define, drive, and track third-party remediation plans, ensuring mitigation steps are completed within established timelines.

  • 2nd Line of Defense Liaison & Governance Support:

    • Act as the key operational liaison for the 2nd Line of Defense (Risk Oversight), compiling and delivering required operational data, metrics, and commentary on the coverage and control effectiveness of the TPRM program.

    • Support the TPRM team in the preparation of reports and presentations on TPRM metrics, trends, and program effectiveness for leadership and Risk Committees.

  • Program & Tool Support:

    • Assist the TPRM team in the implementation, configuration, and ongoing maintenance of the TPRM system/tool, ensuring data integrity across the platform.

Qualifications

  • Experience: 4+ years of dedicated experience in Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM), risk management, compliance, or a related operational control function.

  • Consulting Background: Prior experience working at a Big 4 (e.g., Deloitte, EY, PwC, KPMG) or a similar major consulting firm is highly desirable.

  • Operational Control: Proven experience acting as a process gatekeeper or reviewer, with specific experience in Quality Assurance (QA) for risk or compliance deliverables.

  • Coordination: Demonstrated success coordinating delivery and information flow between offshore/remote teams and demanding onshore business/risk stakeholders.

  • Stakeholder Management: Strong organizational and interpersonal skills, with the ability to manage expectations and articulate complex operational risks clearly.

  • TPRM/GRC Knowledge: Solid understanding of TPRM principles, risk domains (InfoSec, BCP, ABAC, etc.), and prior experience supporting the administration or maintenance of a GRC/TPRM platform is highly desirable.

Additional Information

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

The role

You will be a hands-on operator at the heart of the Cyber Security team, helping to run, harden, and continuously improve the day-to-day machinery of security. Where the Detection & Threat Engineer defines what "good" looks like, you help make it real, turning standards, runbooks, and tooling into reliable, repeatable operational practice.

This is a delivery-focused role for an experienced practitioner. You will spend your time in the tooling, in the tickets, and in the detail: enhancing the platforms the team depends on, tightening procedures, and making sure findings, alerts, and remediation work actually get closed out rather than left to drift.

You will partner closely with Senior Detection & Threat Engineers, Application Security, Information Security, Security Operations, and Engineering executing against the standards they set, feeding operational insight back up, and progressively taking ownership of the tooling and procedures that keep security operations running.

What you'll be responsible for

  • Supporting and enhancing security tooling SIEM, EDR, DLP, vulnerability management, and automation platforms including configuration, tuning, and day-to-day maintenance

  • Building and improving operational procedures, runbooks, and playbooks so the team's response is consistent and repeatable

  • Triaging and handling security alerts, escalating high-severity events, and contributing to incident response under the direction of senior engineers

  • Tracking, coordinating, and driving pentest and vulnerability findings through to remediation across engineering teams (ownership, action plans, status, closure)

  • Maintaining the accuracy and hygiene of security data asset inventories, finding trackers, and remediation records

  • Supporting detection deployment and validation, and feeding operational feedback into detection tuning to reduce noise and alert fatigue

  • Assisting with scripting and automation to remove manual toil from recurring operational tasks

  • Producing clear operational reporting and metrics on findings, remediation progress, and tooling health

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in a Security Operations, SOC, or equivalent operational security role

  • Practical experience operating modern security tooling SIEM (e.g. Sentinel), Data Loss Prevention (DLP) tools, EDR, and vulnerability management platforms

  • Solid understanding of security operations workflows: alert triage, incident handling, and vulnerability/finding remediation lifecycles

  • Comfort with scripting to support automation and tooling (e.g. Python, KQL)

  • Experience coordinating remediation across multiple engineering or platform teams, and keeping work moving to closure

  • Working knowledge of cloud environments (e.g. AWS, Azure and GCP) and how security operations apply across cloud and SaaS

  • Familiarity with common frameworks and standards such as PCI DSS, NIST CSF, SOC 2, ISO 27001, CIS Benchmarks, and MITRE ATT&CK

  • A pragmatic, ownership-minded operator: methodical, detail-oriented, and focused on getting things fixed rather than just logged

raw.title: Account Lead - Client Success
raw.description:
Let’s transform banking forever

ClearBank is built on the belief that banking infrastructure shouldn’t slow down progress. Quite the opposite. Speed it up and that’s when you unlock potential. When you really start to innovate.

That spirit and ‘can-do’ attitude is why our clients – from FinTech's and crypto platforms, to banks and credit unions – choose to use our API to power their banking infrastructure.

 

But it’s our people who are the stars here. They power that innovation, push harder to break boundaries. They make coming to work (or working from home) fun. They’re the ones we trust to catapult our clients to success. Just as they trust us to build a business that’s always striding forward.

 

What you can expect:

ClearBank is a place where you can do things differently and challenge the status quo. We will give you a high level of autonomy and transparency, and we trust you to make the right decisions for the bank.

 

Your mission:

As an Account Lead in our Mid-Market Client Management team focused on Client Success, you’ll be responsible for building and maintaining strong, trusted relationships with a portfolio of existing and new clients.

 

You’ll develop a deep understanding of our clients’ businesses, priorities and evolving needs, helping them get the most from their relationship with ClearBank while ensuring we continue to deliver positive client outcomes. You’ll identify opportunities to deepen and grow those relationships through appropriate cross-sell and upsell opportunities, working collaboratively across ClearBank to connect clients with the products and solutions that meet their needs.

 

Key Responsibilities

· Own and develop strong, trusted relationships with existing Mid-Market clients, acting as a key point of contact and developing a detailed understanding of their businesses, priorities and evolving needs.

· Develop and execute client account plans that support successful, long-term relationships and identify opportunities to deepen client engagement.

· Proactively engage clients through regular relationship and account reviews, maintaining an understanding of their performance, priorities, challenges and future plans.

· Identify and progress cross-sell and upsell opportunities within existing accounts, connecting client needs with relevant ClearBank products and capabilities to support sustainable account growth.

· Build relationships across client organisations, developing effective connections with relevant decision makers and stakeholders and ensuring relationships are not dependent on a single point of contact.

· Act as an advocate for clients internally, bringing together the appropriate teams to address needs, resolve issues and support strong client outcomes.

· Collaborate across Product, Solutions, Operations, Risk, Compliance and other relevant teams to support clients effectively and ensure commitments and issues are progressed appropriately.

· Maintain a strong understanding of the payments landscape and ClearBank’s proposition, using this knowledge to have credible, commercially relevant conversations with clients and identify opportunities that meet their needs.

· Monitor the health and development of client relationships, proactively identifying risks, emerging needs and opportunities for further engagement.

· Support retention and sustainable growth across the existing client portfolio by combining excellent relationship management with appropriate commercial development.

 
 

Skills & Experience (must-have)

· Strong knowledge and practical experience of the payments industry is essential, with the credibility to discuss payments propositions, client requirements and relevant industry developments with senior client stakeholders.

· Proven experience managing and developing existing B2B client relationships, ideally within payments, banking or financial services.

· Demonstrable experience of building trusted, long-term relationships with clients, understanding their objectives and using that insight to improve client outcomes.

· A track record of identifying and successfully progressing upsell and cross-sell opportunities within existing client relationships.

· Strong commercial skills, with the ability to balance client success, relationship retention and account growth.

· Experience conducting structured client and account reviews and translating client needs into clear actions and opportunities.

· Proven stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build credibility with decision makers and senior stakeholders within client organisations.

· Great communication, questioning and presentation skills, including the ability to make complex payments and banking topics clear and relevant for different audiences.

· Problem-solving and judgement, with the ability to coordinate stakeholders and maintain client confidence when navigating issues or competing priorities.

· Ability to work collaboratively across multiple internal teams to deliver positive outcomes for clients.

 

Nice-to-have

· Broader knowledge of banking infrastructure and embedded banking.

· Experience working with fintech, financial services or other regulated organisations.

· Experience managing complex client relationships involving multiple products and stakeholder groups.

 

What success looks like in the role

· Clients experience a proactive, trusted and value-adding relationship with ClearBank, supported by a strong understanding of their business and priorities.

· Client relationships are maintained and developed effectively, with risks, issues and changing client needs identified and addressed proactively.

· Appropriate cross-sell and upsell opportunities are identified and progressed based on genuine client needs and commercial value.

· Account plans and client information remain current, providing a clear view of relationship health, priorities, opportunities and agreed actions.

· Strong collaboration across ClearBank supports positive client outcomes and sustainable long-term relationships.

A little bit more about us! 

ClearBank is Where You Can belong: 

At ClearBank we think about Diversity, Equity and Inclusion (DE&I) a lot. Not because we think we should. But because we know we should – how else can we build a happy workforce and be successful as a business. We’re committed to making sure our teams reflect society. And we put energy and effort into making this a place where everyone feels at home, where they’re given the trust and encouragement to do their very best work. Here are some of the things we’re most proud of: 

  • 42% of our senior management roles are held by women 

  • Our enhanced family leave policies

  • Launching our partnership with Code First Girls 

  • Increasing awareness of neurodiversity in the workplace through our partnership with the Inclusive Group 

Our hiring process and what you can expect:

Application: a member of our talent acquisition team will review your application against the key requirements for the role and let you know within two weeks whether you’re moving forward to the next stage; 

Screening: You’ll spend 30-45 minutes speaking to one of our recruiters learning more about the role and ClearBank, and we’ll get it know more about you, your experience and how your skills align with the role (this will be via phone or Teams video call). You can expect to hear back from us within seven days following this meeting (if things are taking longer than expected, we’ll let you know that too); 

First Interview: You’ll spend one hour with a member of our hiring team focusing on your skills, competencies and your ways of working at the same time we’ll give you time to ask more questions about the role, the team and learn more about the ClearBank culture. This will be via Teams.  

Second Interview: This will be a competency-based interview with one or more members of our team.

Final Stage: You will have a final meeting with the Head of Department. This will be around 45-60 minutes.  

Offer: Congratulations! Get ready to transform banking forever! 

 

Our commitment to you as a candidate: 

We will always try our best to get back to you within seven days of your interview whether you’ve been successful or not and provide you with feedback. Sometimes things take a little longer, so we may not have a decision to share but we will get it touch to let you know we need a little more time.  

We’re unable to provide specific individual feedback at the application or screening stage but know that your application was reviewed and considered carefully.  

We wish you the best of luck with your application and maybe we’ll be celebrating your new role at ClearBank soon!  

Equal Opportunities

ClearBank is committed to ensuring equal opportunities throughout every stage of the recruitment process. ClearBank recognises that diversity is vital to the long-term success of the business in the communities and markets in which it operates. ClearBank is also a firm believer that an inclusive culture fosters greater employee engagement and collaboration. 

ClearBank strives for diversity and inclusion of all forms, including (but not limited to): gender, age, educational and professional background, disability, gender reassignment, marital or civil partner status, pregnancy or maternity, race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief and sexual orientation. 

As part of the Company’s commitment to equal employment opportunity, we provide reasonable adjustments, to candidates during the recruitment process, including to individuals with disabilities. We want to create a safe space that welcomes everyone so please let us know how we can accommodate you. In case you have any accessibility requirements you can share that with our Talent Acquisition team prior to your interview stage, if applicable. 

The legal bit

By submitting your CV to ClearBank Limited you are providing your consent for us to use the information you provide for recruitment purposes. For more information on how we manage your data go and check out our Candidate Privacy Notice on the ClearBank website to see how we process, manage and look after your data. You are also allowing us to communicate with you by email and telephone for recruitment purposes.

Senior Finance Business Partner, UK Finance

About us:

We built ClearBank on the belief that banking infrastructure would no longer slow down progress. Instead, it would be a catalyst that unlocks the potential to innovate. It would adapt to different needs so a new era in financial services could begin. We’re here to challenge the status quo in banking, are you?

You Can. If you think you have it in you, this is Where You Can.

Role Purpose

As Senior Finance Business Partner, you’ll play a key strategic and operational leadership role within our UK Finance team, reporting to the UK CFO.

You’ll provide independent financial oversight and insight across the UK Bank, deputise for the UK CFO when required and connect UK Finance with Group Finance teams. The role combines financial control, regulatory oversight, planning and commercial finance to support effective decision-making and sustainable performance.

This is a visible senior role requiring strong technical expertise, commercial judgement and the confidence to influence and constructively challenge senior stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

  • Deputise for the UK CFO, including supporting interactions with the Board and Executive Committee.

  • Lead the relationship between UK Finance and Group Finance, ensuring services meet UK regulatory and operational requirements.

  • Maintain independent oversight of the UK Bank’s financial position, constructively challenging and validating Group Finance outputs.

  • Lead UK financial planning and analysis, including budgeting, forecasting and performance reporting.

  • Partner with the UK leadership team on business cases, profitability and strategic decision-making.

  • Support the review of regulatory submissions and the preparation of Board and Executive Committee papers.

  • Monitor compliance with UK regulatory and prudential requirements, escalating risks and control weaknesses appropriately.

  • Improve financial processes and reporting to strengthen clarity, accuracy and timeliness.

  • Act as a trusted adviser to the UK CFO and senior stakeholders, providing clear financial insight and challenge.

  • Contribute financial leadership to strategic initiatives, including growth planning and operational resilience.

Skills & Experience

  • A recognised accountancy qualification, such as ACA, ACCA, CIMA or an equivalent, with significant post-qualification experience in financial services.

  • Broad finance experience covering financial control, reporting, planning and commercial finance.

  • Strong knowledge of UK GAAP and IFRS.

  • Experience of regulatory and prudential requirements, including PRA and FCA frameworks, ICAAP, ILAAP, and recovery and resolution planning.

  • Experience working within a regulated UK banking environment.

  • Strong budgeting, forecasting, performance analysis and business-case development skills.

  • Experience working effectively across a matrix organisation.

  • Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the confidence to engage and constructively challenge at Board and Executive level.

  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to simplify complexity and focus on material issues.

  • Sound professional judgement, independence and professional scepticism.

  • A collaborative, outcome-focused approach, with the ability to take ownership, identify risks early and support shared goals.

raw.title: Talent Acquisition Coordinator
raw.description:
Let’s transform banking forever

ClearBank is built on the belief that banking infrastructure shouldn’t slow down progress. Quite the opposite. Speed it up and that’s when you unlock potential. When you really start to innovate.

That spirit and ‘can-do’ attitude is why our clients – from FinTech's and crypto platforms, to banks and credit unions – choose to use our API to power their banking infrastructure.

But it’s our people who are the stars here. They power that innovation, push harder to break boundaries. They make coming to work (or working from home) fun. They’re the ones we trust to catapult our clients to success. Just as they trust us to build a business that’s always striding forward.

What you can expect:

As our Talent Acquisition Coordinator, you’ll play an important role in creating a seamless and welcoming experience for candidates and keeping our Talent Acquisition operations running smoothly. You’ll coordinate interviews, maintain accurate information in Ashby and support the production of regular Talent Acquisition reporting. You’ll also work with colleagues across Talent to support supplier administration and help organise our monthly induction for new joiners.

This role is suited to someone who enjoys bringing structure to a busy environment, cares about getting the details right and wants every interaction with ClearBank to leave a positive impression.

Your role includes:

  • Complete the day-to-day administration of Ashby, maintaining accurate and complete candidate, vacancy and recruitment information to support reliable reporting and compliant hiring processes.

  • Coordinate interviews across multiple time zones, managing candidate and interviewer communication and availability to create a timely, organised and professional experience.

  • Welcome and support candidates attending interviews at the ClearBank office, particularly senior candidates, creating a positive and professional first impression.

  • Monitor recruitment activity and data quality in Ashby, identifying missing, inaccurate or outdated information and working with recruiters to resolve issues promptly.

  • Produce accurate weekly Talent Acquisition dashboards and insights, providing clear visibility of recruitment activity and data to the Talent Acquisition Lead.

  • Support wider Talent operations, including supplier onboarding and offboarding for the Head of Talent and the organisation of monthly new-joiner induction with the Talent Development Manager.

  • Identify opportunities to improve Talent Acquisition coordination and administration, suggesting practical ways to make processes simpler, clearer and more effective.

What does success in this role look like:

  • Ashby contains accurate, complete and dependable recruitment information that the Talent Acquisition team can confidently use for reporting and decision-making.

  • Candidates experience organised, timely and thoughtful communication throughout interview coordination and when visiting the ClearBank office.

  • Interviews are coordinated effectively across stakeholders and time zones, with scheduling problems identified and resolved promptly.

  • Weekly Talent Acquisition dashboards are produced accurately and consistently, giving the Talent Acquisition Lead clear visibility of recruitment activity.

  • Supplier administration and monthly induction coordination are organised and reliable, with the relevant stakeholders kept informed.

What you’ll bring:

To excel in this role, you’ll also need:

  • Previous experience in a Talent Acquisition, recruitment coordination or similar role, with hands-on experience supporting interview scheduling, candidate administration and day-to-day recruitment processes.

  • Strong organisational skills, with the ability to coordinate multiple interviews, activities and competing priorities.

  • Excellent attention to detail, particularly when working with recruitment systems, schedules, reports and confidential information.

  • Confidence communicating with candidates and colleagues at different levels of seniority.

  • The ability to use digital systems effectively and learn new technology and processes quickly.

  • A methodical approach to maintaining accurate records and identifying missing or inconsistent information.

raw.title: Head of Legal
raw.description:
Build Conveo's legal function from the ground up, and be the partner our leadership team relies on as we scale.

Conveo is a Y Combinator-backed company in an active growth period. We started this year as a team of ~20 and are on track to reach ~125 people by year end. The people who join now have an outsized chance to shape how this company is built.

We raised a $50M Series A led by DST Global, Balderton, and Visionaries, giving us the fuel to move even faster. We're investing in our product, growing an exceptional team, and taking on bigger challenges as we enter our next stage of growth.

What We're Building

Conveo is the AI research platform enabling fast, affordable, and high-quality consumer and B2B research. Global brands like Unilever, Google, and Orange use our AI video interviewer to generate insights across marketing and product teams.

Traditional research is slow, expensive, and superficial. Running it well requires expertise most teams don't have. That gap affects how well companies understand their customers and how well they can serve them. We're closing it.

The Role

As our first Head of Legal, you'll build Conveo's legal function from the ground up. Strategically critical commercial agreements with enterprise clients and reseller partners are coming in, and they require sharp commercial and legal review to protect our revenue lines. You will advise on a broad array of legal topics across commercial, product, IP, employment and corporate matters, with the support of external advisors and tools where appropriate.

This is a partnership role. You'll report to our CFO and work hand in hand with them, with a strong dotted line to our CEO. You'll have full strategic and operational visibility across the organisation and help strike the balance between risk and opportunity. Conveo operates across Europe and the US, so you'll also support our New York team and work across jurisdictions.

You'll lead our legal associate directly and manage our external lawyers. Legal here is both sword and shield for our commercial team. You'll be commercially pragmatic: working with the business, you'll make proportionate risk calls on the deal as a whole, not clause by clause, and you'll be prepared to work at pace. You know that speed and clarity matter, and that sometimes legal rigour is what saves us down the road.

This role is based in our London office, in a hybrid setup (3 days a week in the office expected).

What You'll Do

Own our commercial contracts

  • Review and negotiate our most important client and reseller agreements: MSAs, DPAs, SLAs and order forms, often against enterprise procurement and legal teams

  • Own supplier contract reviews

  • Set fallback positions so deals don't stall, and tell the business clearly when to say no

  • Build templates and playbooks so sales can close standard deals without you

Build the legal function

  • Set up intake, templates, playbooks and a central contract repository

  • Decide what is handled in-house and what goes to external counsel, and keep spend in check

  • Select, brief and manage outside firms across jurisdictions

  • Lead and develop our legal associate, and grow the team as the company scales

Own corporate, people and IP matters

  • Keep corporate housekeeping in order across our entities

  • Work closely with the CFO and corporate counsel on any debt or equity fundraises.

  • Partner with our People team on employment and equity matters across the UK, Belgium, the US, and any new market we enter

  • Protect our IP and work with external counsel to protect our brand

  • Get the company ready for Series B and due diligence

Own the legal side of data privacy and AI

  • Have a say in how we build and use AI in our product, advising product and engineering to remain compliant with the changing landscape of AI regulation.

  • Create and own the data protection and AI terms in our client and supplier contracts, including DPAs and subprocessor terms

  • Develop and help manage our AI Governance across the company.

What Success Looks Like

After 3 months

  • You fully own the legal function

  • You've completed a deep-dive risk review of our contracts and processes, covering commercial, employment and terms and conditions, so we know what is in place and what is not

  • You've put a process in place to step into commercial agreements when needed

  • You have a handle on every open external counsel matter, and you're leading on our longer-standing legal issues

  • You've set up a working framework with our People team

  • You're shaping how legal acts as both sword and shield for our commercial team

  • Depending on when you join, you've started preparing the company for Series B and due diligence

After 6 months

  • We contract with clients in a fundamentally better way, through a new contracting process

  • There's a clear legal intake process across HR, corporate, IP and commercial

  • You have strong working relationships with sales, product, engineering, finance and People, and everyone knows legal is the place to go for any agreement

  • Our legal associate works independently and is growing as a legal professional

  • Our external counsel spend is planned and predictable, with outside advice focused where it adds the most value

What You'll Bring

You're high agency and low ego, self-directing and startup-native. You stay calm with a long backlog, and you're genuinely interested in AI tools. You'll also bring:

  • 10+ years qualified in any UK or EU jurisdiction, with private practice followed by in-house experience

  • Experience leading an in-house legal function, ideally as head of legal or GC at a SaaS company, with the creativity and drive to build things from scratch

  • Deep commercial experience, including IP and liability: MSAs, DPAs, order forms, and negotiating with enterprise procurement and legal teams

  • A track record of building legal process from scratch: templates, playbooks, intake, a contract repository

  • Experience running external counsel across several jurisdictions and keeping spend in check

  • Working knowledge of employment, equity and corporate matters across multi-entity groups, with exposure to the UK, US and Belgium.

  • Comfort making risk calls and closing imperfect contracts, and giving clear, usable advice to non-lawyers and board-level readers

Nice to Have

  • Fundraising experience on the fund or company side

  • US legal experience

  • Experience with data privacy (GDPR) and AI regulation, such as the EU AI Act

  • Experience with cross-border data transfers between the UK, EU and US

  • Hands-on experience with contract lifecycle tools and AI-assisted contract review

Why Join Us?

  • Build the legal function at a hyper-growth, YC-backed AI company

  • A true partnership role, working directly with our CFO and CEO

  • Meaningful equity. We want you to own a piece of what we're building.

  • Offices in London, Antwerp, and New York. We work best together, so 3 days a week in the office is required.

  • Regular socials: rooftop drinks, team dinners, run clubs, and more

  • Twice-yearly off-sites to places worth travelling to: Austria, Las Vegas, and Portugal

  • Private health coverage with Vitality (incl. dental, vision)

  • Enhanced employer pension contribution (5% employer, 3% employee contribution)

  • Refer someone great and earn up to £5,000

raw.title: Product Manager, Homepage
raw.description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Join us in shaping the experience that millions of customers land on every time they open DoorDash, Wolt, or Deliveroo. As part of our Core Consumer organisation, our Homepage team owns one of the single biggest levers we have on what customers find and one of the hardest surfaces in the app to get right.

Working at the intersection of ranking, personalisation, and AI/ML, you'll help decide what each customer sees and why, across three brands and dozens of markets. You'll be building on a global stack, and your roadmap will be a mix: global platform problems that apply worldwide, global capabilities we're accelerating into EMEA, and EMEA-specific problems worth solving properly rather than working around.

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Homepage team. In this role, you'll shape how customers discover restaurants, grocery and retail venues, dishes and products — and help define what discovery looks like as AI-driven and agentic experiences change the way people decide what to order.

What You'll Be Doing

You'll be joining a team working on one of the most-used surfaces in the app.

Here's what your day-to-day might look like:

  • Building new end-to-end features and user experiences on Homepage that shape how customers discover restaurants, grocery and retail venues, dishes, and products.
  • Working on ranking, personalisation, and AI/ML problems in the Homepage domain, including how we decide what each customer sees and why.
  • Exploring where AI-driven and agentic experiences change the way customers discover what to order.
  • Making discovery work across three brands and many markets, without flattening into one-size-fits-all.

What You'll Need to Thrive

Our ideal candidate will bring strong product judgment and curiosity to grow into the rest:

  • Proven experience as a Product Manager on consumer-facing products - discovery, homepage, feed, or ranking-driven experiences are especially relevant.
  • You are a product manager more than a feature owner. Someone who finds the customer problems that matter most and makes the case for solving them.
  • You work backwards from the customer problem, and weigh it against what the business needs most right now.
  • You're comfortable holding several business objectives at once and making a call when they pull in different directions.
  • You work well with a wide range of stakeholders and build trust with people whose priorities differ from your own.
  • You think strategically and can move between long-term direction and what we should ship next.
  • You're comfortable with ambiguity and genuinely flexible (this industry is changing fast, AI most of all).
  • You're curious about what AI actually changes for customers, and can tell real value from hype.

Next steps

The position will be filled as soon as we find the right person, so make sure to apply as soon as you realize you really, really want to join us!

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. We'll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you!


Beware of recruitment scams: DASH Brands will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about DASH Brands' legitimate recruiting process at careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness.

What You'll Be Doing

You'll be joining a team working on one of the most-used surfaces in the app.

raw.title: Staff Product Manager, Generative AI Platform
raw.description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat. DoorDash, Deliveroo and Wolt now operate as one global company. Behind the AI experiences millions of people use every day, from shopping assistants to customer support agents, sits one shared Generative AI platform. Our team builds it.

We're looking for a Staff Product Manager in London to own major parts of that platform. Your customers are the engineers and ML researchers across all three brands who build AI products and agents. You'll work with engineering and product leaders in Europe and the US, and your decisions will shape how AI gets built across every market we operate in.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Set the strategy and roadmap for core parts of our GenAI platform: model access and routing, agent infrastructure, and evaluation and observability.
  • Build one platform for three brands. Spot the patterns across Deliveroo, Wolt and DoorDash teams and turn them into shared building blocks, so a capability built once reaches every market.
  • Shape our model portfolio across frontier and open-weight models. Decide where we build, buy or partner in an ecosystem that changes month to month.
  • Make agents production-ready. Give teams safe access to company knowledge, tools and systems, with the quality, latency and cost controls needed to run agents at scale.
  • Own the evaluation strategy so teams can prove quality before launch and keep improving it after.
  • Stay close to your customers. Work with the teams shipping AI experiences, measure adoption and time-to-production, and let real production use drive the roadmap.
  • Lead at a senior level,  presenting to senior technical leadership and influence strategy beyond your own roadmap.

What You'll Need to Thrive

Our ideal candidate brings deep expertise in some of these areas and curiosity to grow in others:

  • Significant product management experience (typically 8+ years, or equivalent), including owning a technical platform, developer product, or ML or data infrastructure.
  • Hands-on experience with LLM-based products or platforms in production, such as assistants, agents, evaluation or inference. GenAI platforms are a young field, so we care more about depth than years.
  • A platform mindset. You notice the problem five teams keep solving and turn it into one capability everyone can use.
  • The ability to go deep with engineers and ML researchers, then explain the trade-off in plain language to a senior leader.
  • A track record of leading large, ambiguous areas on your own and aligning stakeholders across companies, countries and time zones.
  • Comfort with regular overlap with US time zones, including some late-afternoon and evening calls.

What Success Looks Like

A team in any of our three brands can go from idea to a reliable AI product dramatically faster. That happens because the hard parts (models, inference, evaluation, tooling, observability, governance and agent infrastructure) are solved once at the platform layer and get better for everyone.

Why Join Us?

  • Real scale from day one. Your platform powers AI used by millions of consumers, merchants and couriers across three brands.
  • Frontier work, real constraints. You'll work with the latest models and agent patterns, then make them reliable, affordable and compliant in production.
  • Visible impact. Platform decisions here get reviewed by senior leadership and adopted across the company.

 

We're food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scale Work on a complex, always-on marketplace that impacts millions every day.

🌱 See your impact, fast Ship, test and improve ideas quickly in a low-hierarchy, high-ownership environment.

🧠 Grow through challenge and ownership Take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support.

🌎 A culture built for builders High standards, collaboration, flexible working and continuous learning.

💰 Share in the success you help create Competitive salary and equity options, so you're rewarded for the impact you make.

➡️ Want a deeper look at how we build? Check out our Tech Blog.

We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Find more about how we hire here.

At Funding Circle, we have the restless energy of a fintech start-up with the stability of a public company. It’s a unique mix that gives Circlers the autonomy to take ownership and the scale to make an impact that truly counts.

We’re a high-performing team that chooses to lift each other up. We challenge, we champion, and we have each other’s backs - because we know that when we stand together, we move faster and build better.

The impact is real: Last year alone, the businesses on our platform generated £7.2bn for the UK economy 📈 Come and join a mission that matters!

[Read our Impact Report] | [See our Trustpilot]

The role ⚡

📍 London (Hybrid) | 🤝 3 days in the office | 💰 Competitive Salary + Benefits

The Account Manager is a proven high performer within the Inbound Sales team. In this position you are the face (or voice) of Funding Circle to the customer dealing with inbound leads in the form of business loan applications. The focus of the role is to assist the customer with their queries and educate them on both the Funding Circle offering and wider business context. You will be targeted on your conversion of the value offered by these inbound leads to the value of accepted loans.

  • Establishing instant rapport with your customers via telephone & email to cultivate successful relationships

  • Knowledge and understanding of the wider lending market and Funding Circle’s direct competitors

  • Pitching the Funding Circle proposition against alternative funding options available

  • Managing a high-volume, fast-paced pipeline; supporting your clients through each stage of creating an application

  • Being responsible for your own monthly target and continuously developing & improving your approach to help you get there

  • Adding value through upsell and cross sell of Funding Circle products as well as partner lenders within the Marketplace.

What we’re looking for 🌱

  • Relevant experience in a high volume sales environment focused on closing deals - a background in lending/commercial finance is preferable

  • A strong communicator, confident to be able to engage with small business owners over the phone and via email

  • Ability to continually develop and maintain your pipeline whilst managing applications in progress

  • Able to proactively identify ways to use Generative AI to streamline your daily tasks and improve your personal productivity

  • Confident using approved AI tools safely and effectively to enhance your output and find a better way of working

  • Proactivity and a desire to develop your career and taking onboard feedback - continuous development is a key part of sales at Funding Circle and we are looking for people keen to grow!

We’re building a place where everyone truly feels they belong. Even if your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every requirement, we'd still love to hear from you.

Why join us? 💜

We back you to build an incredible career and by joining us, you'll be part of one of The Sunday Times Best Companies to Work For 2026! As a flexible-first employer, we use a "best of both" approach. We’ll see you in our London office to collaborate – with barista coffee and subsidised Just Eat lunches on us!

Our Circler Proposition focuses on five areas:

  • Flexibility: We provide a benefit allowance you can tailor to your own life and family.

  • Health: This includes private medical and dental, health assessments, and access to a digital GP.

  • Wealth: We offer life assurance, share schemes, and financial coaching.

  • Development: You get a dedicated annual learning allowance to help you level up.

  • Lifestyle: We have electric car and cycle-to-work schemes, plus season ticket loans.

We also have award-winning parental leave policies. We're here to support you through the big life moments, from fertility treatments to new additions to the family.

Ready to join a mission that matters? We’d love to chat!

We’re on a mission to back the UK’s small businesses like no one else 🚀

Small businesses are the backbone of the economy, and we’re here to help them win. We’ve built a platform that uses clever data to get them the funding they need in minutes, not weeks.

At Funding Circle, we have the restless energy of a fintech start-up with the stability of a public company. It’s a unique mix that gives Circlers the autonomy to take ownership and the scale to make an impact that truly counts.

We’re a high-performing team that chooses to lift each other up. We challenge, we champion, and we have each other’s backs - because we know that when we stand together, we move faster and build better.

The impact is real: Last year alone, the businesses on our platform generated £7.2bn for the UK economy 📈 Come and join a mission that matters!

[Read our Impact Report] | [See our Trustpilot]

The role ⚡

📍 London (Hybrid) | 🤝 3 days in the office | 💰 Competitive Salary + Benefits

 

This is a busy admin role where you will be reviewing and processing loan applications to provide fast, efficient funding to small businesses in the UK.

 

  • Reviewing financial accounts, bank statements and risk reports to process loan applications

  • Completing know your customer (KYC) checks during the borrowers on-boarding journey and referring cases to our AML and Fraud teams where required

  • Use third party systems to collect information on the applicant and their business

  • Perform rigorous quality assurance: Reconcile loan documents and internal system data for completeness and accuracy

  • Working in a collaborative team environment

  • Proactively problem solving, identifying and confidently mitigating any risks, issues or control weaknesses that arise in your day-to-day

 

What we’re looking for 🌱

We value deep expertise, but a growth mindset and good energy are what really make our team click. We’re a group that chooses to lift each other up and think smart every day.

 

  • At least 6 months experience in a high volume operations or administrative role

  • Ability to work to deadlines and business goals in a fast paced, dynamic environment

  • Excellent attention to detail, self motivation, strong organisational skills and ability to follow procedures

  • Ability to complete tasks that are repetitive in nature

  • Willingness to learn and adapt with ever evolving policies and procedures

  • It would be great, but not essential, if you had familiarity with financial documents, bank statements and identification documents

  • Able to proactively identify ways to use Generative AI to streamline your daily tasks and improve your personal productivity

  • Confident using approved AI tools safely and effectively to enhance your output and find a better way of working

We’re building a place where everyone truly feels they belong. Even if your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every requirement, we'd still love to hear from you.

Why join us? 💜

We back you to build an incredible career and by joining us, you'll be part of one of The Sunday Times Best Companies to Work For 2026! As a flexible-first employer, we use a "best of both" approach. We’ll see you in our London office to collaborate – with barista coffee and subsidised Just Eat lunches on us!

Our Circler Proposition focuses on five areas:

  • Flexibility: We provide a benefit allowance you can tailor to your own life and family.

  • Health: This includes private medical and dental, health assessments, and access to a digital GP.

  • Wealth: We offer life assurance, share schemes, and financial coaching.

  • Development: You get a dedicated annual learning allowance to help you level up.

  • Lifestyle: We have electric car and cycle-to-work schemes, plus season ticket loans.

We also have award-winning parental leave policies. We're here to support you through the big life moments, from fertility treatments to new additions to the family.

Ready to join a mission that matters? We’d love to chat!

Joining our newly expanded Marketing Technology & Operations team, you will unlock new capabilities for the Marketing department and CRM team using a suite of best-in-class, no-code/low-code marketing platforms and agentic AI solutions.

  • Act as an independent platforms expert for the Marketing domain collaborating with engineering teams to steer technical solution design and co-work on implementations

  • Roll out new platform features and enable adoption by self-service users incorporating them into new campaigns and operational processes

What we’re looking for 🌱

We value deep expertise, but a growth mindset and good energy are what really make our team click. We’re a group that chooses to lift each other up and think smart every day.

  • At least 4 years as an administrator/superuser of enterprise-level marketing systems - ideally a marketing automation platform (e.g. Braze, Iterable, Adobe Campaign) or customer data platform (e.g. Twilio Segment, Hightouch)

  • Comfort working on or around data integrations in frontend and backend contexts

  • Passionate about novel, multi-disciplinary problem-solving - you enjoy working with evolving technologies, bridging domains of expertise, and can demonstrate your success in solving for commercial objectives.

  • Experience with operations incorporating AI/agentic workflows, or use of AI agents inside marketing platforms

  • Comfort with complex spreadsheets or smartsheets using Excel/G-Sheet formulas

  • Excellent stakeholder communication skills and an enthusiasm for collaboration with both technical and non-technical colleagues

Skills we’d love to see:

  • Familiarity working with real-time data flows and event-driven decision-making in marketing platforms

  • Familiarity with common platform integration methods (website tag managers, API authentication, retry/error handling, JSON, webhooks)

  • Ability to interpret and edit JavaScript/Python code, and comfort articulating and discussing technical requests to engineers

  • Familiarity working with or around “big data”, using tools like AWS Athena, SQL/dbt

raw.title: Senior Creative Development Specialist
raw.description:
The Creative team provides customers with original, relevant, and contemporary visuals. Through an industry-unique combination of consumer research, proprietary data, and three decades of trend reporting experience, the team delivers actionable insights that guide customers to the visual content that connects with consumers. Closely collaborating with our contributor base of photographers, videographers, and illustrators around the world, the team develops market leading, authentic, and differentiated content.  
 

Who You Are: 

You have a strong creative vision and a deep understanding of videography and the visual landscape. You are an effective communicator with experience in creative industries, proficient at connecting with and influencing image and video-makers. You have a keen eye for identifying talented individuals and recruiting videographers who are well-suited for stock content. Passionate about Diversity & Inclusion, you bring diverse perspectives to your work. A self-starter, you work autonomously and collaboratively, leading and managing multiple projects effectively.  

As a Senior Creative Development Specialist specializing in Video, you will support the creator community by engaging, inspiring, and educating them to produce high-quality work that meets customer needs, while also supporting our global video strategy. Reporting to the regional creative lead, you will lead and manage your projects and collaborate with Creative Insights, Creator Relations, Custom Content, and Creator Engagement in EMEA, as well as Marketing, PR, and Sales teams, to deliver relevant local content. 


Your Next Challenge:
  • Cultivating and maintaining relationships with videographers to inspire and produce high-end regional commercial content. 
  • Regularly communicate content needs and provide creative direction to creators via email, Discord, and Zoom, guiding them from concept to execution. 
  • Identify and recruit new talent from within the Americas creator portfolios as well as from external sources. 
  • Collaborate with team members to brainstorm and develop new content ideas. 
  • Oversee multiple projects from planning to delivery, ensuring timely completion. 
  • Providing creative and technical feedback and support to creators, enhancing their skills, shoots, art direction, and overall content quality. 
  • Curate and review creative assets to meet differentiation standards and customer needs. 
  • Promote and showcase creative work internally and externally both verbally and written, including occasional customer meetings and presentations. 
  • Write creative briefs and shoot spotlight articles. 
  • Organize and run frequent webinars for creator engagement and video education. 
  • Support Curation & Promotion and Marketing teams with video highlights and showreels of best content. 
  • Analyze and interpret data/metrics to inform video creative strategy. 
  • Develop and implement a forward-thinking video strategy that aligns with overall business objectives, anticipating industry trends and positioning the team for long-term success. 
  • Serve as a thought leader for video within the organization, driving innovation by sharing insights, best practices, and emerging opportunities to elevate our creative approach and market presence.  

    • What You'll Need:
  • Relevant degree in visual or creative media. 
  • Expertise in videography, with experience in video production, art direction, and shoot management. 
  • 7+ years of experience in visual communications; advertising or production. 
  • Strong creative vision and ability to create compelling content. 
  • Experience leading or mentoring creative teams or individuals. 
  • Awareness of current trends in video production, content creation, and visual storytelling. 
  • Detail-oriented, with strong organizational and multitasking skills. 
  • Fluency in English, with excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills. 
  • Comfortable with public speaking and inspiring creators and customers. 
  • Experience in negotiation, relationship building, and community management. 
  • Knowledge of the visual market and content creation. 
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment. 
  • Proactive in sharing ideas and solutions. 
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to provide creative solutions. 
  • Proficiency with PC/Mac, MS Office, project management tools, and Adobe Creative Suite. 
  • Ability to independently manage projects from ideation to delivery. 
  • Familiarity with AI technologies.  

    •   

    There’s a story in every picture, a narrative in every frame. 
    We believe in the power of visuals. As a leading visual content creator, our three brands–Getty Images, iStock, and Unsplash–offer a full range of content solutions to meet the needs of any customer, whatever their size, location, or budget. Whether the goal is commercial or philanthropic, revenue-generating or society-changing, market-disrupting or headline-driving, our visuals help any brand, business, or organization communicate more effectively with their target audience and urge them to action. In other words, we know how powerful an image or video can be—and that it can move the world. 
     
    Working at Getty Images 
    Our goal is to be one of the best places to work globally, which means we’re dedicated to providing experiences and resources that allow you to do your best work. Foundational to our culture are our Leadership Principles, which are the shared values that guide how we come together to do our work. We raise the bar and collectively bring solutions while exercising trust, transparency, and care. We actively reject biased behavior and are inclusive of different voices, perspectives, and experiences. We focus on our customers and deliver on our commitments and commercial goals. 
     
    We foster a collaborative and supportive environment that prioritizes delivering results efficiently and using time wisely, so that all employees can achieve balance between commitments to the company and health and well-being in our lives. We value the importance of rest and recovery ranging from company-paid holidays to time away from work. 
     
    Our employees’ growth, development, belonging, and engagement are important investments. We offer learning experiences ranging from leadership development, diversity and inclusion training, mentoring programs, a high potential program, and professional and skills development. We prioritize staying connected in our hybrid-working world and encourage participation in global morale events and local gatherings, as well as finding community in one or more of our Employee Resource Groups. Learning about our business is paramount, and our open and transparent culture means you’ll have direct access to experts and senior leaders via open forums, all hands, and content hours. 
     
    Getty Images believes that diversity is critical to our success in moving the world and is committed to creating an inclusive, mutually respectful environment that celebrates diversity. We seek to hire based on merit, competence, performance, and business needs. Getty Images is an equal opportunity employer.
     
    All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances.
