raw.title: Treasury Operations Analyst
raw.description:
Role

Taptap Send is seeking a highly organised and motivated individual to join our Treasury Operations team and help us grow our business. In this role, you will report to the Director of Payments and touch all aspects of Taptap Send's payment operations, with an initial focus on stablecoin funding, working directly with our teams and partners across the world.

You'll own the full life cycle of payments, including creating, tracking and confirming crediting of funds, as well as troubleshooting payment issues across our growing Stablecoin operations. You'll also be involved in funding forecasts to ensure that our partners are well funded at all times.

You'll work directly with our trading team as well as collaborating with the wider team that spans the globe ( London, Abidjan, Lagos, Nairobi, Paris and New York, to name a few places), ensuring that Taptap Send is effectively supported in its growth and customer ambitions! There is plenty of room for professional progression and personal growth within our friendly and ever-growing Taptap community.

Responsibilities

  • Proactively managing treasury operations, initially for stablecoins, to ensure our accounts are funded and payments can be processed seamlessly

  • Working closely with partners to ensure that funding timelines are being delivered on time

  • Troubleshooting to find root causes of payment issues and working with internal and external partners to resolve

  • Assisting with onboarding new banks and trading partners for stablecoin, working closely with our business development team

  • Providing out-of-hours coverage when required

Requirements

  • Have at least 1 years’ experience, ideally in a payments or funding role and/or working with stablecoins

  • Are passionate about our mission and eager to do what needs to be done to achieve it

  • Are enthusiastic about treasury operations, solving unique problems, and optimizing processes

  • Enjoy challenges, are resourceful and think outside the box to find creative ways to tackle problems

  • Love working in teams and building meaningful relationships with key stakeholders

  • Don’t hesitate to place a call to promptly resolve issues or persevere to get a result

  • Have great organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple time-sensitive priorities in a fast-paced startup environment where no two days are the same

  • Have proven analytical skills (Excel); SQL a plus

  • Are proficient in English

About Us

 

We’re building the world’s leading cross-border fintech for emerging markets - empowering families, fuelling local economies, and changing how millions access financial services.

 

Since our launch in 2019, we have transformed how money moves across borders with our operations spanning 6 out of 7 continents and covering both the busiest and most underserved (remittance) corridors. We tapped into a massive shift - from banks to phones - bringing digital finance to places where traditional systems never reached. The next stage of growth will fuel a network of services and products especially designed to make money more accessible to diaspora communities including local cards, and additional savings and payments features.

 

We’re growing fast, backed by world-class investors, and scaling a product that blends real world impact with cutting edge fintech innovation.

 

Here’s a little more:

  • Founded by Harvard grads and 3-time founders who previously built Segovia (acquired) and GiveDirectly (>$300M revenue, fastest-growing NGO in the world)

  • Backed by top investors including Spark Capital, Canaan, Reid Hoffman, Breyer Capital, Unbound, Wamda, and more

  • Built by global top performers from Bain, Google, McKinsey, Uber, Checkout, Bolt, and beyond - we move fast, stay humble, and care deeply about our mission

  • Truly global team - 250+ people, 50+ nationalities, 50+ languages

  • Guided by our values - ownership, impact, humility, and heart - in deed, not just word

 

Taptap Values

Impact first

Team next

Accept reality

Propose solutions

Win with grit

Be proactively candid, with yourself and others

Love the particular

Own it

Create positive energy

Maybe, even have fun

 

Taptap Send is an equal opportunity employer dedicated to building an inclusive and diverse workforce. All employment decisions are decided on the basis of qualifications, experience and business need. We strongly encourage applications who are members of underrepresented communities to apply.

If you require reasonable adjustments to be made during the recruitment process, please do not hesitate to let us know. Any information you provide us in this respect will only be used to accommodate your requirements.

Note: we recognize imposter syndrome is real - any candidate that does not perfectly fit every characteristic of this role is still strongly encouraged to apply.

raw.title: Graduate Product Manager
raw.description:
Our mission is to enable everyone to build wealth.

We're reinventing how trading and investing work by building exceptional products people love.

We move fast, set a high bar, and expect excellence from everyone on the team.

The role

We're looking for exceptional graduates to join Trading 212 as Graduate Product Managers. You'll help shape products that make investing simpler and more accessible, turning complex problems into intuitive experiences.

This is a hands-on role with real ownership from day one. You'll work with engineers, designers and teams across the business to understand client needs, decide what matters most, and take ideas from problem to launch. You'll be expected to question assumptions, get into the details and measure whether what we build actually makes things better.

This is a highly demanding role for exceptionally ambitious people who want to accelerate their career growth. It requires sustained effort, discipline and a commitment to excellence. You'll face difficult problems, high expectations and a steep learning curve.

No prior work experience is required. We're looking for exceptional ability, sound judgment and the drive to turn ideas into results.

What you'll do

  • Understand client needs through research, feedback and product data, identifying problems worth solving.

  • Turn ambiguous problems into clear proposals, user journeys and product requirements.

  • Work closely with designers and engineers to build simple, reliable and intuitive solutions.

  • Prioritise improvements by weighing client value, business impact, effort and risk.

  • Define success metrics, analyse results and design experiments that help us make better decisions.

  • Take ownership of features from discovery through launch and iteration, with support from senior colleagues.

  • Spot confusing interactions, unnecessary steps and overlooked details, and drive improvements.

  • Use LLMs and prototyping tools to explore ideas, test assumptions and accelerate your work, checking the quality of their output.

What you need to have

  • Outstanding academic performance. An achieved First-Class degree in Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, Physics, Economics, Finance or another highly quantitative subject from a top university, placing you in the top 10% of your cohort.

  • Exceptional problem-solving ability. You can bring structure to ambiguous problems, identify root causes and develop simple, practical solutions. You reason from first principles, challenge assumptions and test your conclusions against evidence.

  • Uncompromising work ethic. You set demanding standards for yourself and are willing to put in exceptional, sustained effort to meet them. You're ambitious about your growth, embrace difficult challenges and take responsibility for improving quickly. You persevere, follow through on commitments and take pride in delivering excellent work.

  • A strong sense of ownership. You take responsibility for outcomes from start to finish. You act without waiting to be asked, anticipate obstacles, raise issues early and stay accountable until the problem is resolved.

  • Exceptional analytical reasoning. You work confidently with numbers, distinguish signal from noise and reach defensible conclusions from incomplete information.

  • Strong product judgment. You can explain what makes a product excellent, identify where an experience falls short and propose a simpler solution with clear trade-offs.

  • Evidence of exceptional initiative. You've taken a demanding idea beyond the brief and produced something tangible through an academic, personal or extracurricular project. You can explain your decisions, what you learned and what you would improve.

  • Outstanding written and verbal communication. You can turn a complex problem into a concise, structured explanation and defend your recommendation under questioning.

  • Technical fluency. You understand how software products work, can use SQL to answer questions from data, and can build a simple prototype to communicate or test an idea.

  • Proficient, critical use of LLMs. You use them effectively for research, analysis and prototyping, recognise their limitations and independently verify important outputs.

  • Fast learning and intellectual honesty. You get up to speed quickly, seek demanding feedback and change your mind when the evidence warrants it.

  • A strong interest in investing and financial products. You're curious about how they work and how to make them easier for people to understand and use.

  • Full-time availability and willingness to work in-office.

Nice to have

  • Distinction in a highly competitive academic competition, Olympiad, hackathon or research award.

  • A self-directed app, tool or other project that people have chosen to use, with evidence of how you improved it from feedback.

  • Strong foundations in statistics, probability and experimental design.

  • Ability to code in Python or JavaScript, or create interactive prototypes in Figma.

  • A thoughtful understanding of investing products and the trade-offs between simplicity, functionality and client protection.

What we offer

  • The chance to help shape products used by millions of investors to build wealth.

  • The opportunity for exceptionally fast career growth through demanding challenges, real responsibility and direct feedback, with progression driven by your performance and impact.

  • Real ownership, with direct feedback from experienced product, design and engineering colleagues.

  • Smart, ambitious, high-performing colleagues who share a common goal.

  • An environment where nothing is set in stone and good ideas win.

  • Appreciation for your talent and ideas.

  • A highly competitive package, including annual bonuses.

Bring your ambition to Europe’s fastest-growing mobile broker!

We thank all applicants, but only candidates selected for interview will be contacted. All personal data of applicants is protected by law and treated with strict confidentiality.

raw.title: Account Executive, EMEA (Germany)
raw.description:
Webflow is the agentic web marketing platform for modern marketing teams, helping organizations build, manage, and optimize high-performing web experiences that drive predictable growth and strengthen brand trust. Building at Webflow will need grit, because we move fast, without ever sacrificing craft or quality.

We’re looking for an Account Executive, EMEA to be responsible for driving the full sales cycle in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. You will play a pivotal role in launching and scaling our presence across Germany and the DACH market as we expand throughout the EMEA region.This is a unique opportunity to shape our go-to-market strategy from the ground up.

You will develop a strong outbound sales pipeline, engage key stakeholders, and manage the full B2B SaaS sales cycle from prospect to close. Working cross-functionally with Solutions Engineers, Sales Development, Marketing, Product, and Customer Success teams, you’ll ensure a seamless, consultative experience that addresses customer needs and drives long-term value. Your role will be integral in helping to scale Webflow's impact internationally with a focus on delivering creative solutions and accelerating business growth.

About the role:

  • Location: London, United Kingdom (Hybrid)

    • 3 days per week in-office

  • Full-time

  • Permanent

  • Our cash compensation amount for this role depends on the cost of labor of the geographic area and career levels at Webflow and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s market location, job related experience, knowledge, qualifications, and skills. Benefits/additional compensation for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; pension scheme; health benefits; and wellness stipends.

Please visit our Careers page for more information on which locations are included in each of our geographic pay zones. However, please confirm the zone for your specific location with your recruiter.

  • Application Information:

    • Application deadline: applications accepted on an ongoing basis until position is closed and filled

    • This posting is for a new position.

  • Reporting to the Director, EMEA Sales

As an Account Executive, EMEA you’ll … 

  • Engage deeply with potential customers to uncover pain points, assess needs, and help to refine our ideal customer profile primarily in Germany & Central Europe

  • Create and drive outbound opportunities through strategic account planning, compelling points of view (POVs), and effective collaboration between Sales Development and Marketing teams

  • Clearly articulate and champion Webflow’s vision, value proposition, and product differentiation tailoring messaging to resonate with EMEA audiences and market dynamics

  • Work closely with internal teams such as Solutions Engineering, Product, and Customer Success to drive a value-driven sales process 

  • Generate momentum in the partner ecosystem in EMEA which is crucial to successful pre-sales and post-sales experiences for our customers

  • Maintain clear, consistent communication with multiple stakeholders to drive momentum and reduce friction during the sales cycle

  • Share feedback from the field, help define best practices, and contribute to the foundation and culture of Webflow’s EMEA team

  • Travel up to 25% - primarily for onboarding, industry events, and internal offsites

About you:

Requirements:

  • 3+ years of experience managing and closing full-cycle B2B SaaS sales, preferably in a high-growth or startup setting

  • Skilled in working lead queues, outbound prospecting, and pipeline generation 

  • Strong ability to lead complex sales processes involving multiple stakeholders with varying priorities and technical understanding

  • Experience working with a robust partner ecosystem and navigating partner-sourced, partner-influenced, and reseller deals

  • BS / BA degree or relevant experience

  • Fluent in German with advanced proficiency in both spoken and written communications. 

You’ll thrive as an Account Executive, EMEA if you:

  • Confidently communicate and can tailor messaging to different audiences, from individual contributors to C-level executives

  • Have deep experience working cross-functionally with teams like Product, Engineering, Support and Marketing

  • Have a strong focus on understanding customer challenges through a consultative, solutions-oriented approach

  • Can comfortably navigate ambiguity, influence cross-functional teams, and contribute to the foundation of a new regional presence

  • Embrace continuous learning and growth by actively expanding knowledge in emerging technologies like AI to drive creativity, accelerate progress, and enhance impact

  • Stay curious and open to growth — demonstrating a proactive embrace of AI, and actively building and applying fluency in emerging technologies to elevate how we work, drive faster outcomes, and expand collective impact.

Our Core Behaviors

  • Build lasting customer trust. We build trust by taking action that puts customer trust first.

  • Win together. We play to win, and we win as one team. Success at Webflow isn't a solo act.

  • Reinvent ourselves. We don't just improve what exists, we imagine what's possible.

  • Own it all the way. We move fast because the moment demands it, and we hold ourselves accountable to deliver outcomes — for each other, and for customers.

 

Benefits

  • Ownership in what you help build. Every permanent Webflower receives equity (RSUs) in our growing, privately held company.

  • Health coverage that actually covers you. Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans for full-time employees and their dependents, with Webflow covering most premiums.

  • Support for every stage of family life. 12 weeks of paid parental leave for all parents and 6+ weeks of additional paid leave for birthing parents. Plus inclusive care for family planning, menopause, and midlife transitions.

  • Time off that’s actually off. Flexible vacation, paid holidays, and a sabbatical program to help you recharge and come back inspired.

  • Wellness for the whole you. Access to mental health resources, therapy and coaching.

  • Invest in your future. A 401(k) with 100% employer match (up to $6,000/year) in the U.S., and support for retirement savings globally.

  • Monthly stipends that flex with your life. Localized support for work and wellness expenses — from Wi-Fi to workouts.

  • Bonus for building together. All full-time, permanent, non-commission employees are eligible for our annual WIN bonus program.

 

Temporary employees may be eligible for paid holiday and time off, statutory leaves of absence, and company-sponsored medical benefits depending on their Fixed Term Contract and their country/state of employment.

 

Be you, with us

At Webflow, equality is a core tenet of our culture. We are an Equal Opportunity (EEO)/Veterans/Disabled Employer and are committed to building an inclusive global team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, beliefs, and experiences. Employment decisions are made on the basis of job-related criteria without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other classification protected by applicable law. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Webflow will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

 

Stay connected

Not ready to apply, but want to be part of the Webflow community? Consider following our story on our Webflow Blog, LinkedIn, X (Twitter), and/or Glassdoor.

 

Please note:

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Upon interview scheduling, instructions for accommodation requests will be administered.

To join Webflow, you'll need a valid right to work authorization depending on the country of employment.

If you are extended an offer, that offer may be contingent upon your successful completion of a background check, which will be conducted in accordance with applicable laws. We may obtain one or more background screening reports about you, solely for employment purposes.

Webflow uses AI tools to assist in screening and evaluating applications. AI does not make final hiring decisions. For details on how we process your personal information, see Webflow’s Applicant Privacy Notice.

raw.title: Senior Associate, Software Engineer
raw.description:
WisdomTree is seeking a Senior Associate, Full Stack Developer to join our fast-paced Software Engineering team and enhance our recently developed Trading and Pricing applications. The role spans front-end and back-end development, working closely with business stakeholders to translate needs into high-quality, maintainable and extensible solutions.

The Senior Associate will work independently on assigned projects while collaborating with the European Technology team and Software Engineering Lead. The role covers the full delivery lifecycle, from requirements and solution design through development, testing, release, deployment and post-deployment support.

The role will contribute to both Trading and Pricing applications, helping ensure they remain reliable, scalable and aligned with critical and evolving business needs.


Key Accountabilities and Scope
  • Business Partnership & Requirements: Work with business stakeholders to understand workflows, clarify needs and translate them into clear technical requirements, scope and acceptance criteria.
  • End-to-End Delivery: Own assigned tasks and projects from discovery and solution design through development, testing, release, deployment and post-release support, managing risks and dependencies throughout.
  • Trading & Pricing Applications: Develop, enhance and maintain business-critical features across both applications, with a focus on reliable workflows and maintainable solutions.
  • Solution Design: Contribute to technical design with the Software Engineering team, ensuring alignment with application architecture and engineering standards.
  • Front-End Development: Build and enhance user-facing features using React and Django.
  • Back-End Development: Develop Python services and APIs and integrate with Microsoft SQL Server and PostgreSQL.
  • Quality & Agile Delivery: Deliver secure, well-tested and high-performing solutions; participate in planning, estimation, demonstrations, code reviews and cross-functional collaboration.
  • Infrastructure & Deployment: Work with CI/CD pipelines, Azure and AWS services, Terraform and serverless functions to support reliable releases.

    • Essential Skills and Qualifications

    Business Partnership & Delivery

  • Experience working independently with business stakeholders to discover, analyse and document requirements.
  • Experience owning tasks or small projects through the full software delivery lifecycle, from requirements through deployment and post-release validation.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to explain business and technical requirements to different audiences.
  • Ability to manage priorities, dependencies and delivery risks while maintaining accountability for outcomes.

    • Front-End Expertise

  • Strong proficiency in React and Django, with experience in component-driven development and modern UI libraries.

    • Back-End Experience

  • Hands-on experience with Python and API development, including complex business logic and algorithms.
  • Experience with ORM and database integrations using Microsoft SQL Server and PostgreSQL.

    • Design Principles

  • Good knowledge of software architecture, design principles and maintainable coding practices.
  • Experience with automated testing, test-driven development and peer code review.
  • Ability to collaborate on solution design while independently progressing implementation work.

    • DevOps & Tooling

  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, Git workflows and automated testing.

    • Desirable Skills and Qualifications
  • Financial services or investment-platform experience.
  • Experience working with trading, market data, valuation or pricing applications.
  • Knowledge of Azure App Service, serverless functions such as Azure Functions or AWS Lambda, and infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform.

    • About Us:

    WisdomTree is a global financial innovator, offering a diverse suite of exchange-traded products (ETPs), models and solutions, private market investments and digital asset-related products. Our offerings empower investors to shape their financial future and equip financial professionals to grow their businesses. Leveraging the latest financial infrastructure, we create products that emphasize access and transparency and provide an enhanced user experience. Building on our heritage of innovation, we offer next-generation digital products and services related to tokenized real world assets and stablecoins, as well as our institutional platform, WisdomTree Connect™, blockchain-native digital wallet, WisdomTree Prime®*, and have expanded into private markets through the acquisition of Ceres Partners’ U.S. farmland platform.

     

    Work Smart:

    Headquartered in New York City, WisdomTree embraces a “Work Smart” philosophy that transcends physical workspace, aiming to optimize productivity, efficiency and effectiveness. Employee time in the office generally is not prescribed, and team leaders are empowered to determine how their teams work best, based on their roles, which may include in-person, in-office engagement.

     

    Mission, Vision & Values:

    WisdomTree is committed to delivering a better financial experience through the quality of our products, solutions and engagement, and to be the leader in delivering best structured access to global asset classes, empowering clients through innovative solutions and long-term performance. WisdomTree employees strive for excellence and innovation, work with transparency and accountability and support each other as a global team. We welcome the applications of qualified individuals who will support this mission and thrive in our collaborative and empowering work environment.

This is an opportunity to establish and expand WisdomTree's presence in one of the fastest-growing ETF markets, leveraging our existing UCITS platform, differentiated investment capabilities and established infrastructure.

Key Objectives

  • Generate net new assets from institutional and intermediary clients across Asia.

  • Provide high-quality coverage for existing clients while managing inbound enquiry opportunities across the region.

  • Develop and execute a focused distribution plan aligned with WisdomTree's growth ambitions.

  • Establish strong relationships with asset managers, private banks, wealth managers, family offices, distributors and institutional investors.

  • Deliver a consultative, client-centric sales approach by understanding investor needs and positioning WisdomTree's differentiated ETF and ETP capabilities.

  • Collaborate closely with internal stakeholders to develop scalable distribution opportunities and partnerships.

  • Minimum 5–7 years' experience in institutional or intermediary ETF/asset management sales.
  • Proven experience covering Asian institutional or wholesale markets.
  • Strong understanding of Asian distribution models and investor landscape.
  • Existing network across institutional investors, private banks, wealth managers, distributors and asset managers within Asia.

raw.description:
1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $500M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.

About 1Password

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.

If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.

As an Account Executive, you manage a territory that includes target-accounts and an existing book of business with companies up to 1,000 employees. Your primary focus is hunting new business opportunities, building sales pipeline, and driving growth within the SMB sector. You are also responsible for upselling into the existing account base, leveraging our Extended Access Management platform. You will own a specific geographical region or country within the EMEA market.

How we’re using AI today

Across GTM, we’re transforming the way we work with AI. We expect every seller, CSM, and team member to become a power user, using it daily to work smarter and move faster. AI is already embedded in how we operate – from real-time coaching that sharpens how we sell and interact with customers, to surfacing insights that help us anticipate needs – creating more time for meaningful customer engagement. If you’re excited to reshape how you think, make decisions, and drive growth with AI, you’ll feel right at home here.

Expectations of this role
This is a hybrid role. You will be expected to work from 1Password's London office 3 days per week, with the flexibility to work from the office up to 5 days based on business needs.

Note: All go-to market roles will have an in-person onboarding in Toronto.

What we're looking for:

  • 2+ years of SaaS sales experience, preferably in security with a focus on SMB or Mid Market accounts OR a top performing BDR with outbound experience and success ready to step up.

  • Fluent in German; written and spoken

  • Experience owning a geographical territory or country within EMEA.

  • Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales quotas and KPIs.

  • Experience upselling & cross-selling to both new customers and across a book of business

  • Solid skills in:

    • Prospecting, pipeline building, account planning, value-based selling, and territory management, with effective operating rigor in pipeline management, forecasting, and pacing to target

    • Business acumen, solution selling, negotiation, & presenting to company decision makers/stakeholders

    • Written and verbal communication skills across email and communication tools such as Slack, and Zoom, with the ability to make technical concepts accessible to non-technical parties.

  • Demonstrated ability to understand and articulate complex cybersecurity concepts, particularly in Identity and Access Management.

  • Resilient, self-motivated, and committed to achieving targets while thriving in a remote environment.

  • A proven team player, eager to collaborate and achieve shared goals rather than working in isolation.

  • Curious and coachable, with a proven ability to apply feedback, adapt, and continuously improve.

  • Preferred: Proficiency with Salesforce, Slack, Zoom, Linkedin Sales Navigator & Outreach

  • Willingness to travel within your region for client meetings and industry events.

What you can expect:

  • Own Your Territory: Manage and grow your designated geographical region or country within EMEA, focusing on acquiring new SMB clients and expanding existing accounts.

  • Manage Pipeline: Build and maintain a healthy sales pipeline through proactive prospecting, inbound leads, cold calling, and networking, utilizing our formalized sales process, MEDDPPICC.

  • Drive New Business Growth: Achieve or exceed sales targets and KPIs by:

    • Consistently meeting or exceeding monthly/quarterly sales quotas.

    • Maintaining a high level of outbound activity, including calls, emails, and meetings.

    • Developing and closing new business opportunities within your territory.

  • Drive Organic Growth: Identify opportunities to upsell 1Password solutions within existing accounts, leveraging your understanding of Extended Access Management.

  • Engage the Industry: Attend industry events, trade shows, and conferences to represent 1Password, build brand presence, and network with potential customers

  • Stay Informed: Stay up to date on cybersecurity trends and developments, particularly in Identity and Access Management, to effectively position 1Password solutions and communicate their value to prospects.

  • Collaborate Cross-Functionally:

    • Build collaborative relationships with internal teams (e.g. BDR, Solutions, Channels, Onboarding, Customer Success) to optimize client engagement and identify growth opportunities.

    • Engage in multi-threaded relationships within client organizations to enhance overall account health.

  • Focus on Solution Selling:

    • Implement selling strategies to align our solutions with client needs and objectives.

    • Demonstrate a deep understanding of client pain points and position our offerings as strategic solutions.

  • Present and Negotiate:

    • Confidently present to company decision makers/stakeholders, articulating the value proposition of our products and services.

    • Create mutual action plans to align the sales team and prospects on responsibilities, steps and timelines for closing deals.

    • Utilize effective negotiation skills to drive mutually beneficial outcomes.

UK-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between £44,000 GBP and £62,000 GBP, and is commission-eligible. This role is also eligible for immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, pension, and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.


At 1Password, we approach each individual's compensation with a promise of fair market value and internal equity commensurate with experience and specific skill set.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.


Our culture
At 1Password, we prioritize collaboration, clear and transparent communication, receptiveness to feedback, and alignment with our core values: keep it simple, lead with honesty, and put people first.

You’ll be part of a team that challenges the status quo, and is excited to experiment and iterate in search of the best solution. That said, 1Password is not for everyone. Our work is demanding, we strive for excellence, and the pace is fast. We need people who are keen to take on challenging problems, who seek feedback to grow, and who are driven to make an impact. If you're looking for a place where you can settle into a comfortable routine, this might not be the right fit for you. We’re looking for individuals who are proven experts in their fields, as well as those who are highly adaptable, can thrive in ambiguity and through change, are curious, and above all deliver results.

How we work with AI
We are committed to leveraging cutting-edge technology—including AI—to achieve our mission. We also understand that thinking critically about AI in its current forms will help us create better solutions for our customers and ourselves with its future forms, which will help us continue to close the gap between security and privacy and achieve our mission. We want team members at all levels to take the approach of actively learning AI best practices, identifying opportunities to apply AI in meaningful ways, and driving innovative solutions in their daily work. Embracing the future of AI isn't just encouraged—it's an essential part of how we will be successful at 1Password.

This approach extends to our hiring process—candidates are welcome to use AI tools responsibly and thoughtfully during the application process. We recognize the power of both in person collaboration and remote work. We recognize that certain roles benefit from regular, in-person connection to support collaboration, team cohesion, and customer engagement.

For all roles, occasional travel may be required. This includes things like: department-wide offsites, quarterly department meetings and periodic customer events. Note: All go-to market roles will have an in-person onboarding in Toronto.

Community

🌎 Remote-first work environment
*Some roles in our GTM team are currently being hired for in-person hybrid work in Toronto and Austin. These roles will specify on the posting.

You belong here.

raw.description:
About Us

At Axle Energy, we’re building the infrastructure that will underpin the decarbonised energy system. Our software moves energy usage to times when electricity is cheap and green, by controlling vehicle charging, heating systems, and home batteries. We control hundreds of thousands of energy assets.

We’re building in a legacy industry and moving gigawatt-hours of electrons in the real world, but we operate at lightning speed, and we’re growing the team to meet customer demand.

We’re proud to be supported by world-leading investors, including Energize Capital and Accel.

Read more about what we’re building here.

About the role

Axle has quickly become the leader in our operational markets, and we are looking for someone to help run and optimise the rhythms at the heart of the business.

We are looking for someone to develop a deep understanding of flexibility markets across the UK, who can collaborate cross-functionally, crunch numbers, and own critical daily and monthly operational processes.

Owning daily operations means sitting at the heart of the ‘Axle control room’. This involves running and optimising the most critical operations processes in the business: asset management, trading across UK flexibility markets, and ultimately ensuring our clients and end customers get paid for the flex they deliver.

A note on the job title: Analytics engineering is often closely associated with dbt. We don't use dbt at Axle because our data set up doesn't require a full ETL framework. Instead, this role is centred on the core analytics engineering skill set: developing a deep understanding of source data and building the data pipelines that power our analytics.

What you will be doing

  • Owning operations for our UK energy trading (e.g. daily trading processes, reviewing settlements)

  • Debugging complex edge cases across our trading, asset registration and settlement processes

  • Identifying risks to revenue and delivery and proactively mitigate them

  • Communicating insights and actions clearly to engineering and commercial teams

  • Building and maintaining relationships with key stakeholders in Distribution System Operators (DSOs) and UK market regulators

It would be great if you had

  • Strong SQL and Python skills for analysing data, investigating issues, and automating processes

  • Strong analytical skills: you’ll be speaking MW, kWh, and £ every day

  • A deep-seated motivation to combat climate change

  • Comfort operating in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment

Benefits

A meaningful slice of equity in Axle, alongside a competitive salary, with total compensation ranging from £75k–£200k (base salary + equity).

We operate with a deliberately flat structure and aim to keep pay equitable across the company, with a 1:1 median ratio between founder and team compensation.

Enhanced parental leave to support you through life's meaningful moments.

Bi-annual retreats to strengthen team connection & shared purpose.

Hybrid working - We have a dog-friendly office around Farringdon. To maximize collaboration, we ask that you spend 2-3 days a week in the office.

The opportunity to directly shape the future of energy markets and accelerate the transition to a low-carbon world.

We are extremely keen to build a diverse company, and we’re particularly eager to hear from candidates who don't fit the traditional role stereotypes. If you’re motivated by our mission, please do reach out, even if you feel you might not ‘check all the boxes’.

Interview process

  1. Initial interview

  2. Take-home exercise

  3. Final interview (in-person)

  4. Offer, references, and welcome to the team!

Compensation: £75K – £200K

  • • Total Compensation (salary + equity) £75K – £200K

We announced £75 million Series D funding in 2021 and that same year acquired bloomon in The Netherlands and Bergamotte in France. Together, we’ve fulfilled and delivered over 20 million orders (and counting!), making us the largest direct to consumer flower business in Europe.
 
Now home to a family of 3 beautiful brands, we’re driven by our vision to create the destination for making life a little more thoughtful and beautiful. And we won't stop at flowers and plants. Starting with the Bloom & Wild brand, we're expanding our gifting offering to other categories like cakes, candles and cocktails. This is all part of our ambition to build Europe's #1 direct to consumer gifting destination. 
 
 
🛠️ The Digital Marketing Team @ Bloom & Wild Group

The digital marketing team is responsible for driving sustainable growth in all of the markets we operate in through the execution of innovative, creative and measurable campaigns.

You’ll work on paid search campaigns targeting both new and existing customers, working across both our acquisition and retention teams to drive growth across multiple markets, brands and categories.

The wider team works collaboratively with internal stakeholders including brand, international, data, and product, while directly managing our external search agency to surface crucial insights and maximize campaign performance.


⚙️ What you'll be doing:

  • Own paid search strategy: lead paid search strategy, developing and executing campaigns across UK, DE, NL and other markets, ensuring alignment with wider marketing, brand and business goals – in particular, supporting Bloom & Wild Group's positioning as a gifting brand, not just selling flowers but also hampers, home, food & drink and more.

  • Own the budget: manage our search budget end-to-end, tracking CAC, LTV and retention costs (RC) to guide investment decisions.

  • Lead our agency partner: Oversee and manage third-party agency partner to execute high-performing campaigns and maximize ROI. Hold the agency accountable to performance targets, strict SLAs, and industry best practices, ensuring they continuously push the boundaries of modern search strategy by adopting cutting-edge tactics, beta programs, and new platform features.

  • Own App Campaigns: oversee Google App Campaigns and Apple Search Ads to drive installs and engagement, aligned to our retention and LTV goals.

  • Manage the Google relationship: work with our Google account manager to unlock alpha/beta opportunities, escalate issues and secure strategic support, along with our agency.

  • Own feed & process: own and continuously improve product feeds and backend processes for Google Shopping and Performance Max (PMax) campaigns.

  • Shape the roadmap: turn channel performance and data into clear, actionable insights that shape the wider paid media roadmap and forecasting, using Tableau and in-platform reporting.

  • Stay ahead of the platform: stay up to date with best practices and market insights, particularly with Google, to prepare for upcoming changes, test new features and champion the latest innovations.

  • Champion AI in search: maintain deep, practical knowledge of modern AI within search engine marketing – platform-level generative AI features, algorithmic updates and LLM-driven search behaviours – and share what you learn with the wider marketing team.

  • Be the go-to expert: act as the go-to person for paid search across the marketing team – mentoring junior colleagues, sharing learnings (e.g. through Lunch & Learns) and giving constructive feedback on paid search work outside your direct remit.

  • Protect share of voice: proactively monitor the competitor landscape, ensuring market share of voice, especially through peak trading moments.


    • ✅ You’ll love this role if you…

  • Are an expert in Google Paid Search: You have extensive, hands-on experience managing Google Search, Shopping, and Performance Max campaigns at scale (experience with Microsoft Advertising or App Campaigns is a bonus).

  • Are fluent in tracking and analytics: You are comfortable working with analytics tools, conversion tracking, and Google Merchant Center, and feel confident navigating privacy- and consent-driven changes to measurement.

  • Love data and reporting: You are a data-driven decision-maker who thrives on deriving insights. You are comfortable using both in-platform tools and Tableau to analyze performance across our custom-built, proprietary e-commerce stack (non-Shopify).

  • Have agency management experience: You have a proven track record of managing third-party agencies to drive results and maintain strategic alignment.

  • Are proactive and hands-on: You take full responsibility and initiative to get things done, with a willingness to roll up your sleeves and get stuck in.

  • Are structured and organized: You take a thoughtful approach to planning, organization, and prioritizing your work to deliver on key business goals.

  • Are curious and adaptable: You love figuring out new tech, testing, learning, and trying new things, often taking the initiative to optimize and improve existing processes.

Build a new kind of certification company

AI is changing how companies work. They still need independent assurance that their systems can be trusted.

Calibre is building a global certification business for that world, combining rigorous assessment with AI-powered operations.

Founded by two former Palantir engineers and backed by a $3.3m pre-seed round, we are starting with information security and expanding into AI management systems and further ISO standards. You will work directly with the founders to build the policies, processes and evidence that make that expansion possible.

What you will own

You will be the hands-on execution owner for new accreditation programmes, with an initial focus on ISO 42001 and expansion into other ISO standards. Gautham, CEO will manage you, and you will report directly to the founders.

- Write the substance. Translate standards and accreditation requirements into clear policies, procedures, responsibilities and records that reflect how Calibre actually operates.

- Find gaps and close them. Run and coordinate internal audits of Calibre's own systems, with appropriate independence and technical support. Identify missing evidence, test whether processes work, and build or improve them when they do not.

- Carry the accreditation process through. Maintain the requirements map and evidence trail; coordinate specialists, accreditation bodies and assessments; track findings, corrective actions and deadlines through to closure.

- Make the work compound. Turn each programme into reusable templates, clause mappings, evidence libraries, AI workflows and quality checks. Improve these with every assessment, then apply them to the next standard.

Support will be provided by our founders, technical specialists and commercial team, with commercial handoffs where needed. You will own making the work happen and ensuring it stands up to scrutiny.

What success looks like

A working set of internal processes that gives us confidence the next standard will be faster to add than the last: clearer requirements, stronger evidence, less repeated work and fewer avoidable gaps, while preserving the rigour of each assessment.

Rigour. Ownership. Good judgment with AI.

Who we are looking for

- 2-5 years of experience in consulting, clinical trials or medical device certification processes. You have learned to navigate complex requirements, demanding reviews and work where details matter.

- Strong writing and structured thinking. You can turn an ambiguous requirement into a precise policy, a workable process and evidence that it is being followed. You can explain and defend what you have written.

- A record of getting things finished. You have personally delivered complex work, coordinated stakeholders and resolved gaps. You follow up, raise blockers early and create a process when one is missing.

- Practical AI fluency. You are comfortable working with Codex, Claude Code or equivalent agents on substantive tasks and building reusable workflows around them.

Knowing when to stop using AI is essential

We want someone who knows where AI helps, how to give it useful context and how to verify its work against the source. Just as importantly, you must recognise when it is adding noise, missing the point or weakening the writing - and stop using it, think the problem through and write the answer yourself. You remain accountable for every output.

Experience with ISO management systems, internal audits, accreditation assessments, external assessors or workflow automation would be useful. Deep knowledge of every standard is not expected; the ability to learn carefully and execute is.

Why join Calibre

- Work directly with the founders on a central part of the business, with substantial ownership and visible impact.

- Build capability that lasts. Your policies and workflows will become the foundation for expansion across standards, with scope to grow as the business grows.

- £40,000-£60,000 salary and 0.1%-0.3% equity.

- 22 days of annual leave plus bank holidays.

We work together in our Aldgate East, London office five days a week. We are looking for someone who can start as soon as possible. Candidates must already have the right to work in the UK; this role does not offer visa sponsorship.

Are you a driven, energetic sales professional looking for your next big adventure? Do you thrive on taking ownership, unlocking strategic accounts, and closing complex, high-value deals? Are you excited by cutting-edge technology in a dynamic industry, and motivated by the opportunity to make a measurable impact—not just on your career, but on the world?

If so, we want to hear from you.

Where You’ll Make an Impact:

As an Enterprise Sales Executive, you’ll join our high-performing EMEA sales team, reporting to the Head of Sales, EMEA. You'll take full ownership of your territory and become a trusted advisor to stakeholders across the Crypto and Financial Services landscape.

You’re not just here to sell, you’re here to transform how leading enterprises combat crypto crime with Elliptic’s industry-leading compliance and investigation solutions. You’ll gain deep product expertise and apply your understanding of evolving global and regional regulations to build compelling business cases that speak directly to our customers’ pain points.

This is an exciting opportunity for someone looking for a role where you can make an impact not just on the company you work for but also on the market you work in. Fascinating and challenging work is the norm - working at Elliptic is never boring!

Key Responsibilities

  • Run the full enterprise sales cycle, from pipeline generation to deal closure, across a territory with massive potential and that has considerable inbound interest.

  • Identify, engage, and convert strategic enterprise accounts (including pre-defined targets and new prospects).

  • Develop and execute multi-threaded sales strategies to engage diverse stakeholders (compliance, legal, risk, procurement, tech, C-level).

  • Handle 5-, 6- and 7-figure deal cycles with skill, creativity, and precision leveraging persuasion, influence, and insight-based selling techniques.

  • Drive account expansion through timely up-sell and cross-sell opportunities, maximizing value delivered to our customers.

  • Partner with global peers to collaborate on multi-region and strategic global accounts with long-term growth potential.

  • Collaborate with internal sales engineers, product experts, customer success, and marketing, as well as partner channels, to expand your reach and velocity.

  • Stay ahead of industry shifts and translate emerging challenges into opportunities for Elliptic’s solution suite.

  • Be an ambassador of the Elliptic brand, living our values of curiosity, trust, and action in every interaction.

Skills, Knowledge & Expertise

  • A driven, tenacious “hunter” who thrives on owning their number and finding creative ways to exceed it.

  • Experienced in B2B enterprise SaaS and/or DaaS sales within RegTech, FinTech, and/or Crypto.

  • A proven track record of consistently closing successful enterprise deals across multiple years and companies.

  • Comfortable leading complex, long-cycle and large deals involving multiple stakeholders, but also agile enough to take on quick-close 5-figure deals.

  • Commercially curious, you ask smart questions, seek to understand the "why" behind a customer’s problems, and use those insights to tailor impactful solutions.

  • Confident, consultative, and persuasive, able to build strong stakeholder relationships at all levels, from mid-level managers to C-suites.

  • A collaborative team player, independent yet never “lone wolf.” You value and engage support from your pack.

  • Agile, resourceful, and fearless, you see opportunity where others see blockers and know how to create inroads where none appear to exist.

  • Familiarity with the MEDDPPICC methodology

  • Experience using AI to assist in creating pipeline and leveraging it within your sales methodology

Bonus Points for:

  • An existing network of connections across the Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance (BFSI) space

  • French, Spanish, or Italian

Ultimately we are looking to hire those who want to be the future leaders in the industry, super intrigued by Crypto and have an awesome mindset to learn so if you don’t meet all the criteria still do apply!


How we work:

  • Hybrid working and the option to work from almost anywhere for up to 90 days per year

  • £500 Remote working budget to set up your home office space

Learning & Development:

  • $1,000 Learning & Development budget to use on anything (agreed with your manager) that contributes to your growth and development

Vacation/ Leave:

  • Holidays: 25 days of annual leave + bank holidays

  • An extra day for your birthday

  • Enhanced parental leave: we provide eligible employees, regardless of gender or whether they become a parent by birth or adoption, 16 weeks fully-paid leave and leave.

Benefits:

  • Private Health Insurance - we use Vitality!

  • Full access to Spill Mental Health Support

raw.title: CRM & Revenue Operations Analyst
raw.description:
About the Role

We're looking for a curious, commercially sharp CRM & Revenue Operations Analyst to join our growing RevOps function. This is a dual-natured role: on one side, hands-on CRM administration and data stewardship within a collaborative team; on the other, a broader remit that spans the full commercial journey — from Marketing through Sales to Customer Success — ensuring the processes, tools, and data that connect them are coherent, reliable, and built to support business growth.

You'll work closely with our Revenue Operations Manager, based in Copenhagen, and collaborate with market teams, sales and marketing stakeholders, and internal IT across all 14 markets. This isn't a role for someone who wants to execute instructions in isolation. We want someone who understands the commercial context behind what they're building — and who takes ownership of making sure it actually works for the people using it.

What You'll Do

CRM Administration & Development

– Support the maintenance and ongoing development of our HubSpot CRM in collaboration with the RevOps team — covering data quality, property management, workflow logic, and pipeline integrity across all markets

– Assist in building, testing, and documenting automation workflows, lifecycle stages, and custom data structures

– Act as a reliable point of contact for CRM-related queries from market teams, escalating where needed and closing the loop on issues

Reporting & Market Intelligence

– Build and maintain dashboards and reports in HubSpot to support sales leadership and country managers across all 14 markets

– Translate reporting requests into structured, actionable outputs — not just visualisations, but insights that inform decisions

– Monitor data health proactively and flag inconsistencies before they compound

Revenue Operations — Marketing to Customer Success

– Support the design, documentation, and continuous improvement of processes that span the full commercial funnel — from marketing acquisition through sales pipeline management to customer success handoffs

– Help ensure that tools, data flows, and operational logic work coherently across functions, reducing friction and improving visibility at every stage

– Contribute to ICP qualification frameworks, segmentation models, lead management logic, and pipeline hygiene practices

– Collaborate with internal IT to support integrations between internal systems and the broader commercial toolstack, helping bridge technical and business requirements

Stakeholder Management & Cross-functional Collaboration

– Work alongside sales, marketing, customer success, and IT stakeholders to understand needs, gather requirements, and translate them into operational solutions

– Communicate clearly across functions and markets — managing expectations, flagging dependencies, and keeping the right people informed

– Represent the RevOps function as a reliable, solutions-oriented partner rather than a bottleneck

Training Materials & Process Documentation

– Develop clear, structured training materials covering tools, processes, and operational frameworks — ensuring teams across all markets have what they need to work effectively

– Maintain process and system documentation as a living resource, updated as workflows evolve

– Work across our training infrastructure (including Supered and Sana) to publish and distribute materials to the right audiences

– Identify knowledge gaps through stakeholder engagement and translate them into practical, usable guidance

What We're Looking For

– 1–2 years of experience in revenue operations, sales operations, marketing operations, CRM administration, or a closely adjacent role

– Solid working knowledge of CRM systems — HubSpot experience is a significant advantage and will be strongly prioritised

– Analytically capable, with the ability to turn raw data into clear, usable business insights

– Sharp commercial instinct — you understand how operational decisions connect to revenue outcomes across Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success

– Comfortable working cross-functionally, including with technical stakeholders such as IT, and translating between business needs and system capabilities

– Detail-oriented and process-driven, without losing sight of the bigger picture

– Excellent written and spoken English; additional languages are a genuine bonus — Danish, Swedish, Norwegian, German, French, Dutch, Portuguese, or Polish

– Proactively curious — you ask questions before you build, and you build things that last

Nice to Have

– Hands-on HubSpot experience beyond basic CRM use — workflows, reporting, custom properties, or integrations

– Familiarity with sales intelligence tools such as LinkedIn Sales Navigator or Evergrowth

– Experience supporting tool integrations or working alongside IT on system connectivity

– Exposure to multi-market or international business environments

– A track record of creating structured training content or process documentation

– Background in B2B services, IT staffing, or professional consultancy

What We Offer

– A central role in emagine's revenue infrastructure, with genuine cross-market scope from day one

– Direct mentorship from an experienced Revenue Operations Manager with deep HubSpot and systems expertise

– Broad exposure to a modern RevOps toolstack and clear room to grow — technically and strategically

– A hybrid working setup with real autonomy and flexibility, based in one of our office locations across our 14 markets

– The opportunity to grow alongside a function that is actively expanding its influence across the business

We empower companies with high-end IT services

emagine is a high-end business, engineering & IT consulting company. Enabled by an extensive network of experts, emagine powers progress, solves challenges and delivers real results through tailored high-end consulting services. emagine is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with departments in France, Germany, Ireland, the Netherlands, Norway, Poland, Portugal, Sweden, United Kingdom, United Arab Emirates as well as India. Over the last couple of years, the company has grown extensively, increasing its international footprint to become one of the biggest consultancies in its segment in Europe and beyond. emagine A/S is owned by private equity company Axcel and a group of senior staff and board members.

Are you our new colleague?

At emagine, we value diversity immensely. Both when it comes to backgrounds and competences, but also in relation to personality and individual ambition. We are a diverse and well-rounded group made up of experienced specialists, generalists, recent graduates and self-taught people. We are generally curious, helpful and happy to share knowledge with our colleagues.

We are proud of our values that are based on honesty, kindness, helpfulness and solidarity. We nurture a strong community culture, where cooperation is paramount – not just locally but also across borders with our international departments. Only in unison can we provide the best service to our clients and affiliated consultants – and that is our goal. As an employee of emagine, you will experience a close-knit culture in which people stand side by side and where there is an emphasis on building close relationships. Going to work must be a fun and enriching experience yet still provide a challenge. That is why we take several steps to ensure that work is motivating and engaging. Finally, we also strive to create the right conditions for physical and mental wellbeing.

Want to know more about what it is like to work at emagine?

Visit our Instagram to get a better idea of who we are or get in contact with our HR department.

raw.description:
Why Faculty?


We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

 


About the Team

Our Energy, Transition and Environment business unit is pioneering meaningful change in the clean energy revolution. Our vision is to accelerate the transition to net-zero emissions and drive efficiencies for a new era of utility companies.

 

We believe that the responsible, and intelligent, deployment of AI is critical to the success of this mission. We partner with a wide range of clients - from major energy operators, to GreenTech startups, and national infrastructure providers - to build solutions which return measurable impact and move us towards a smarter, cleaner, and more sustainable world.

 


About the role:

As a Data Scientist II at Faculty, you will lead the design of end-to-end analytical approaches, developing high-quality models that solve complex, multi-faceted business problems. Joining our Applied AI division, you will leverage advanced programming to turn high-level client needs into rigorous mathematical frameworks.

This role is for an ambitious practitioner ready to own the delivery of robust, scalable model components while ensuring every solution is mathematically sound and ethically responsible. You will play a vital part in pushing our technical boundaries and mentoring others.

 
 

What you'll be doing:

  • Designing and implementing core data science approaches for project workstreams, including the selection of optimal algorithms and validation strategies.

  • Combining deep domain expertise with advanced machine learning techniques to solve unique and complex business challenges.

  • Owning the end-to-end delivery of specific model components, ensuring they are scalable, robust, and mathematically precise.

  • Developing innovative algorithms or adapting existing frameworks to meet bespoke client requirements and technical constraints.

  • Building the software architecture required to wrap models and agentic workflows into production-grade, reliable environments.

  • Supporting Level 1 Data Scientists by providing technical guidance and conducting rigorous peer reviews on modeling tasks.

  • Managing personal delivery timelines while proactively identifying and mitigating technical risks or data limitations within projects.

 
 

Who we're looking for:

  • You possess expertise in statistical modeling and deep learning frameworks, such as PyTorch or TensorFlow, to implement complex paradigms.

  • You are disciplined in extracting valid insights from messy or incomplete datasets, ensuring solutions remain robust under uncertainty.

  • You have the ability to translate high-level, ambiguous client needs into actionable data science requirements and mathematical frameworks.

  • You promote a culture of shared best practices, ensuring all AI development is transparent, ethical, and held to high peer-reviewed standards.

  • You are a clear communicator who can manage technical discussions with customers and articulate project feasibility and delivery timelines.

  • You are highly proficient in advanced Python and harness frameworks, capable of building the architectures necessary for production-grade AI.

Our Interview Process

 

  1. Talent Team Screen (30 minutes)

  2. Take Home Technical Assessment

  3. Technical Interview (90 minutes)

  4. Commercial Interview (60 minutes)

Our Recruitment Ethos

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.

If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours.

A note on AI: we're happy for you to use it for research and interview prep, but please don't use it to generate answers during live interviews. We also use an AI note-taker (Metaview) in interviews so interviewers can stay present (which you can opt out of just let us know,) and every application is reviewed by a human, never decided by AI.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

About the role

As a Lead Data Scientist at Faculty, you will drive the scientific direction and architectural rigour of upstream AI safety and evaluation standards. Partnering directly with Frontier Labs, you will lead the design of novel experiment frameworks, mentor technical teams, and ensure delivery excellence across high-stakes engagements.

Bridging deep scientific research with client strategy, you will champion robust methodologies, guide cross-functional teams, and advance Faculty’s thought leadership in practical AI safety.

What you'll be doing:

  • Directing project teams to deliver cutting-edge upstream AI safety solutions and evaluation standards to Frontier Labs

  • Architecting core scientific experiment designs and robust software infrastructure for high-impact safety engagements

  • Guiding and mentoring data scientists, nurturing technical capabilities, and fostering an inclusive, high-performing team culture

  • Partnering with commercial leads and executive stakeholders to scope technical work, assess feasibility, and translate complex challenges into rigorous scientific frameworks

  • Advancing Faculty’s industry leadership by innovating novel evaluation methodologies, speaking at key forums, or publishing open-source research

  • Establishing and upholding scientific methodology, rigour, and engineering best practices across the full project lifecycle

Who we're looking for:

  • You bring extensive leadership experience in quantitative data science, upstream AI safety research, or academic research with exemplary experiment design methodology.

  • You possess advanced Python expertise alongside deep familiarity with scientific stacks (NumPy, Pandas), AI evaluation frameworks (e.g., Inspect AI), and agentic harnesses and sandboxing environments.

  • You demonstrate a passion for advancing evaluation standards across complex, specialised domains, including the application of novel research avenues, with exceptional technical rigour.

  • You excel at empowering others, sharing technical knowledge, and cultivating a collaborative environment where team members thrive.

  • You combine strong commercial acumen with the ability to articulate complex scientific strategies clearly to senior clients and external partners.

  • You drive strategic execution, scoping high-impact projects effectively to meet structured timelines without compromising quality.

The Interview Process

  1. Talent Team Screen (30 minutes)

  2. Introduction to the team (30 minutes)

  3. Take Home Technical Assessment

  4. Technical Interview (90 minutes)

  5. Commercial Interview (60 minutes)

Our Recruitment Ethos

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.

raw.title: Research Scientist - Control & Machine Learning
raw.description:
At Gigaton, we’re on a mission to cut gigatonnes of carbon emissions from the world’s biggest emitting industries (like cement, steel and glass), by building autonomous AI control and optimisation systems that learn and leverage the physics of manufacturing. Our products run heavy industrial plants more efficiently, more stably, and with lower emissions in real time - laying the foundation for the next industrial revolution.

We are a team of scientists, engineers, builders, and operators who love hard problems, have high standards, and want to make change happen in the physical world. We care about deep tech, but we care even more about whether it delivers cost and carbon impact in a live plant, with real people, under real constraints.

With Gigaton, you’ll solve really tough problems in places few people ever get close to, and build something that actually helps the planet. Are you up for the challenge?

Research questions you could initially work on

  • Learning dynamics from operational data. How can we identify useful models of a plant from noisy, partially observed data collected during closed-loop control?

  • Optimising under uncertainty. How can Bayesian optimisation improve plant performance when experiments are expensive, samples are noisy, and operating constraints must be respected?

  • Learning while controlling. How can we use dual control and active learning to choose actions that improve performance while gathering information about uncertain dynamics?

  • Learning across plants. Which parts of a model or control strategy can transfer between plants, and how can we adapt them efficiently to a new site?

These are meant as examples rather than an exhaustive list. We’re looking for someone who can bring depth to a relevant area, identify promising connections, and help us decide which problems to tackle next.

Your main responsibilities

As a Research Scientist, you’ll:

  • Help shape our research and development agenda, turning challenges from live plants into well-defined research problems.

  • Develop and implement methods for modelling, identification, optimisation and control of complex physical systems.

  • Design rigorous experiments, establish strong baselines and understand when and why a method works.

  • Work with process engineers to incorporate plant physics, operating knowledge and constraints into models and algorithms.

  • Work with machine learning and deployment engineers to evaluate promising methods and bring them into production.

  • Follow deployed performance, investigate failures, and use what you learn to guide further research.

  • Communicate your findings clearly and contribute to the team’s scientific understanding.

What a great fit looks like

  • A PhD in control, machine learning, applied mathematics, engineering, physics or a related field, or equivalent research experience.

  • A strong research background in one or more of control theory, data-driven control, system identification, Bayesian optimisation, probabilistic modelling, physics-informed machine learning, imitation learning or model-based reinforcement learning.

  • Evidence that you can formulate a research question, develop a method and evaluate it carefully, through publications, open-source work or applied research.

  • Strong Python skills and experience implementing machine learning models using tools such as Pandas, NumPy, SciPy, PyTorch.

  • An interest in working closely with engineers and taking responsibility for how your methods perform in practice.

  • Practical experience deploying machine learning and control algorithms.

  • A strong interest in climate mitigation.

You don’t need to know about cement. You do need to get excited about the physics, willing to learn from operators and process engineers, and keen to understand why a plant behaves the way it does.

We don’t expect you to tick every box. If you bring depth in a relevant area and these problems excite you, we’d like to hear from you.

In return for your hard work, we’ll give you

📈 Equity in the company: When we win, you win. You’ll get share options, so you’re part of our journey from the inside.

🕰️ Flexible working We trust you to know how and when you work best and to work that out with your team.

🌴 30 days of holiday (plus bank holidays). Rest is productive. Take the time you need to recharge

🪙 A generous pension scheme. We’re planning for the future in more ways than one.

Our Operating Principles

↗️ Go Gig or Go Home: High Bar, All In. What we do matters to humanity, to our customers and to each other. We hold ourselves to an extraordinarily high bar and bring the urgency this mission requires.

🏭 Concrete Honesty: Be honest. As concrete forms the foundation of our world, genuine honesty and transparency are the bedrock of our culture.

🦾 Autonomous Ownership: High agency, high ownership. We build systems that take control and make things better. We do the same: see it, own it, drive it.

😄 Cement it with Kindness & Fun: Have fun, be kind. We're here to extend Earth's life, but ours is still limited. We want to enjoy the ride. To see these in full, go to Gigaton’s Operating Principles Notion page.
